Brand: East Crane E&C
Product Range: Value Line
Material: Nylon Receiver, Metal Gearbox and Gears plus Metal Handguard
Gearbox: Reinforced Metal gearbox: Metal Gears, 7075 CNC Alloy Piston Head, 7075 CNC Alloy Cylinder Head, PA66+ Reinforced Nylon Piston Body with Metal Ladder, Stainless Steel Cylinder, CNC 7075 Alloy Nozzle, Metal Shell

products.description:
E&C Tan Colt M4A1 Value Line AEG Gel Blaster

The E&C Tan Colt M4A1 Value Line AEG Gel Blaster combines classic Colt M4A1 styling with lightweight construction and reinforced internals. As part of E&C’s Value Line, this electric Gel Blaster offers an affordable alternative to heavier full-metal models.

Featuring a reinforced nylon receiver and CNC aluminium handguard, the M4A1 balances durability with manageable weight. Furthermore, its reinforced metal gearbox incorporates metal gears, CNC alloy components and a stainless steel cylinder.

The gearbox also features a reinforced nylon piston with a metal tooth rack. Consequently, this model offers substantial internal construction without requiring a full-metal receiver.

Additionally, the retractable stock allows users to adjust the overall length for personal comfort. Meanwhile, the functional bolt release, iron sights and traditional M4A1 styling provide familiar handling features.

Powered by an electric AEG system, the blaster supports both semi-automatic and fully automatic firing modes. The manufacturer also lists an approximate muzzle velocity of 345 FPS, although actual results may vary.

Finished in tactical black and Tan/FDE, the E&C Colt M4A1 Value Line Gel Blaster suits enthusiasts seeking classic military-inspired styling and reinforced construction.

E&C Tan Colt M4A1 Value Line AEG Gel Blaster Features

  • Classic Colt M4A1 Styling: Traditional military-inspired design in Tan/FDE.
  • Lightweight Construction: Reinforced nylon receiver reduces overall weight without sacrificing structural strength.
  • CNC Aluminium Handguard: Durable metal construction with accessory mounting options.
  • Reinforced Metal Gearbox: Features metal gears and CNC aluminium internal components.
  • Dual Firing Modes: Supports semi-automatic and fully automatic operation.
  • Adjustable Stock: Retractable nylon stock allows personalised length adjustment.
  • Functional Bolt Release: Adds practical functionality and authentic M4-style handling.
  • Traditional Iron Sights: Provides a familiar aiming system.
  • 14mm CCW Barrel Thread: Supports compatible muzzle accessories.
  • Value Line Design: Combines reinforced components with affordable M4-style construction.

products.description:
E&C HK417 A2 Tan Ultra Line AEG Gel Blaster

The E&C HK417 A2 Tan Ultra Line AEG Gel Blaster combines realistic battle rifle styling with E&C’s upgraded Ultra Line technology. Inspired by the Heckler & Koch HK417 A2, this full-metal replica features a reinforced V2.5 gearbox and programmable electronic trigger control.

Furthermore, its distinctive tan finish recreates the appearance of modern military rifle configurations. The aluminium-alloy receiver, slimline handguard and adjustable stock also contribute to its substantial construction.

As a result, the EC-202-TAN-U appeals to enthusiasts seeking realistic HK417 styling and upgraded electric gel blaster components.

Authentic HK417 A2 Battle Rifle Styling

The original Heckler & Koch HK417 A2 uses a larger 7.62 mm platform than the familiar HK416 rifle. Consequently, its receiver and magazine feature distinctive proportions associated with modern battle rifles and designated marksman rifles.

E&C recreates these characteristics through an aluminium-alloy receiver, slimline handguard and telescoping rear stock.

Moreover, the tan finish gives this model a contemporary military-inspired appearance. Its combination of metal and polymer components also provides the familiar ergonomics of the original rifle platform.

The HK417 A2 styling includes several distinctive external features:

  • Full-metal aluminium-alloy receiver and external construction
  • HK417 A2-style low-profile handguard
  • Slimline multi-position telescoping stock
  • Ambidextrous safety selector, magazine release and bolt release
  • Polymer pistol grip and adjustable rear stock
  • Realistic magazine with decorative dummy-round detailing
  • Tan finish inspired by modern HK417 configurations

Together, these features recreate the recognisable appearance of the HK417 A2. Additionally, the ambidextrous controls provide convenient access from either side of the replica.

A Distinctive HK417 A2 Replica for Collectors

The Heckler & Koch HK417 A2 remains a recognisable design among modern military rifle enthusiasts. Its larger receiver, 7.62 mm platform and distinctive furniture separate it visually from the smaller HK416.

Consequently, the E&C HK417 Tan A2 Ultra Line AEG Gel Blaster offers considerable appeal to collectors interested in modern battle rifle replicas.

The tan finish provides an alternative to traditional black configurations. Moreover, the full-metal construction and realistic magazine detailing complement its contemporary military-inspired appearance.

For enthusiasts familiar with E&C products, the Ultra Line designation also identifies this model’s upgraded internal component package.

Furthermore, its reinforced V2.5 gearbox and electronic MOSFET distinguish it from conventional entry-level electric gel blasters.

Whether selected for display, collection or lawful recreational use, the EC-202-TAN-U combines recognisable HK417 A2 styling with E&C’s upgraded AEG technology.

The HK417 A2 styling includes several distinctive external features:

  • Full-metal aluminium-alloy receiver and external construction
  • Low-profile HK417 A2-style handguard
  • Slimline multi-position telescoping stock
  • Ambidextrous safety selector, magazine release and bolt release
  • Polymer pistol grip and adjustable rear stock
  • Magazine featuring realistic dummy-round detailing
  • Tan finish inspired by contemporary HK417-style configurations

Together, these features make the E&C HK417 Tan A2 an appealing choice for replica collectors and modern military equipment enthusiasts.

E&C HK417 A2 Tan Ultra Line AEG Gel Blaster Features

  • HK417 A2-inspired design: Larger 7.62-style receiver proportions and modern battle rifle appearance.

Use-Case SEO Optimisation, Frequently Asked Questions

Is the E&C HK417 A2 Tan a full-metal gel blaster?

Yes. It features aluminium-alloy external construction with polymer components, including the pistol grip and telescoping stock.

What gearbox does the E&C HK417 A2 Tan Ultra Line use?

This model features a reinforced metal Version 2.5 gearbox with steel gears, a full-steel-tooth piston and CNC-machined internal components.

Does the EC-202-TAN-U include a programmable MOSFET?

Yes. It includes an ESHOOTER V2 Basic programmable MOSFET. However, this version does not support app connectivity.

How many gel balls does the E&C HK417 magazine hold?

The supplied magazine has an advertised capacity of approximately 150 gel balls. It also supports magazine priming.

What is the difference between the HK416 and HK417 designs?

The original HK416 is based around a 5.56 mm rifle platform, while the HK417 uses a larger 7.62 mm platform. Consequently, the HK417 features distinctive receiver and magazine proportions. These differences are reflected in their respective replica designs.

What is the muzzle velocity of the E&C HK417 A2 Tan Ultra Line?

The supplier advertises approximately 290–320 FPS. Actual velocity depends on gel ball preparation, battery condition and individual unit tolerances.

Is the E&C HK417 A2 officially manufactured by Heckler & Koch?

No. E&C manufactures this gel blaster as a replica inspired by the HK417 A2 rifle platform. Official Heckler & Koch licensing is not applied to this product.

products.description:
E&C LaRue Tactical PredatOBR AEG Ultra Line Gel Blaster

Inspired by the 18-inch LaRue Tactical PredatOBR 7.62 seen in The Fate of the Furious, the PredatOBR Gel Blaster is a great choice for movie fans and DMR collectors.

The E&C LaRue Tactical PredatOBR AEG Ultra Line Gel Blaster combines the distinctive appearance of a modern 7.62 mm designated marksman rifle with upgraded electric gel blaster internals. Inspired by the LaRue Tactical PredatOBR platform, this full-metal replica delivers an impressive combination of realistic styling, solid construction and electronic gearbox control.

Built around E&C’s reinforced Version 2.5 metal gearbox, the PredatOBR Ultra Line features steel gears, CNC-machined internal components and a programmable ESHOOTER V2 Basic MOSFET. Consequently, it offers an appealing foundation for enthusiasts seeking a modern AR-10-style gel blaster.

The original LaRue Tactical PredatOBR 7.62 combines the appearance of a precision rifle with a distinctive modern sporting rifle design. E&C recreates these features through its elongated handguard, full-metal construction and adjustable rear stock. Furthermore, the handguard features characteristic elongated cut-outs, which give the PredatOBR its recognisable appearance. Removable Picatinny rail sections along the sides and underside provide additional mounting positions for compatible accessories.

The aluminium-alloy receiver and external components give the gel blaster a substantial feel. Meanwhile, the polymer pistol grip and adjustable buttstock provide familiar ergonomics. Its metal M110-style magazine also reinforces the appearance of the larger-calibre AR-10 and SR-25 rifle family.

For collectors, the PredatOBR design offers another point of interest. The original rifle platform appeared in the 2017 action film The Fate of the Furious, making this E&C model particularly appealing to movie-inspired replica enthusiasts.

E&C LaRue Tactical PredatOBR AEG Ultra Line Gel Blaster Features

  • LaRue Tactical PredatOBR-inspired design: Based on the distinctive 18-inch 7.62 mm rifle platform.
  • E&C Ultra Line construction: Aluminium-alloy external components with polymer furniture.
  • Reinforced V2.5 gearbox: Extended gearbox configuration with steel internal gears.
  • Upgraded internal components: CNC-machined cylinder head, piston head and nozzle.
  • ESHOOTER V2 Basic MOSFET: Programmable electronic firing control without app connectivity.
  • Selectable firing modes: Safe, semi-automatic and fully automatic.
  • Metal M110-style magazine: Approximately 210 gel ball capacity with magazine priming.
  • Modular handguard: Distinctive elongated cut-outs and removable Picatinny accessory rails.
  • Adjustable stock: Overall length ranges from approximately 98 to 106 cm.

  • Collector appeal: Inspired by the PredatOBR rifle platform featured in The Fate of the Furious.

Reinforced E&C V2.5 Metal Gearbox

At the heart of the E&C PredatOBR Ultra Line Gel Blaster sits a reinforced Version 2.5 metal gearbox.

Unlike a conventional V2 gearbox, the V2.5 configuration uses an extended gearbox and cylinder arrangement associated with larger AR-10 and SR-25-style platforms.

E&C equips this model with several upgraded internal components:

Together, these components form the mechanical foundation of the PredatOBR’s electric drive system.

Additionally, the extended V2.5 gearbox architecture makes this model particularly interesting to enthusiasts familiar with SR-25-style AEG platforms.

The E&C LaRue Tactical PredatOBR AEG Ultra Line Gel Blaster brings together authentic 7.62-style DMR aesthetics, full-metal construction and a reinforced V2.5 gearbox with electronic MOSFET control.

For enthusiasts seeking an imposing AR-10-style gel blaster with distinctive LaRue-inspired styling, the EC-909-U makes an impressive addition to any collection.

ACX Grey Gel Blaster – Apex Force Ultra Line (AF-S002-Grey)

The ACX Grey Gel Blaster – Apex Force Ultra Line (AF-S002-Grey) combines a compact modern layout with an upgraded electric drivetrain and extensive metal construction. Consequently, it provides a premium option for Gel Blaster enthusiasts who want something beyond a basic polymer-bodied AEG.

Apex Force uses a CNC-machined aluminium-alloy exterior to create the main body of the ACX platform. This construction gives the blaster a substantial metal feel while maintaining the detailed styling associated with the ACX design. products.description:
CowCow Rainbow A01 Suppressor Adaptor

The CowCow Rainbow A01 Suppressor Adaptor is a CNC-machined stainless steel thread adaptor designed for compatible Hi-Capa outer barrel setups. It converts an 11 mm positive thread to a 14 mm negative thread, allowing compatible muzzle accessories to be fitted.

CowCow specifically designed the A01 adaptor to fit its OB1 5.1 Stainless Steel Outer Barrel. The resulting 14 mm negative (CCW) thread suits many commonly used mock suppressors, tracer units and other compatible threaded accessories.

The stainless steel construction provides a strong, precisely machined mounting point. In addition, CowCow includes a knurled thread protector, which can help protect the exposed external thread when no accessory is installed.

This Rainbow version features CowCow’s Titanium Nitride (TiN) Rainbow finish and forms part of a four-colour range that includes Titanium Black, Raw Silver, Titanium Gold, and Titanium Rainbow.

  • Model: CCT-TMHC-120

  • CNC-machined stainless steel construction
  • Titanium Rainbow finish
  • Converts 11 mm positive to 14 mm negative
  • Designed to fit the CowCow OB1 5.1 SS Outer Barrel
  • Compatible with many 14 mm negative threaded accessories
  • Includes knurled thread protector
  • Suitable for compatible Hi-Capa builds
  • Professional fitting may be required

products.description:
AUSGEL Hardened Glow Gels

AUSGEL Hardened Glow Gels are glow-in-the-dark Gel Balls designed for compatible Gel Blasters and tracer units.

These hardened gels grow to an average size of approximately 7.38 mm and have an average weight of around 0.23 g. AUSGEL also lists an approximate 3.33 mm crush threshold, providing a useful manufacturer specification for comparing gel hardness.

Designed for 7.2–7.5 mm barrels, these gels suit compatible setups that require a firmer gel. When paired with a suitable tracer unit, they illuminate during firing to produce a visible tracer-style effect. As a result, they are particularly suited to night games, indoor games and other low-light Gel Blaster use.

For preparation, AUSGEL recommends adding approximately 2.5 cups of water per teaspoon of dry gels and allowing them to grow for around four hours. Drain the gels once fully hydrated and prepare only the amount you intend to use at the time.

AUSGEL specifically recommends not growing large quantities for long-term storage. Growing only what you need helps ensure freshly prepared gels are available when required.

products.description:
E&C Colt AR15 MK12 SPR Mod 0 AEG Gel Blaster

The E&C Colt AR15 MK12 SPR Mod 0 AEG Gel Blaster – EC-322 recreates the distinctive appearance of the famous MK12 Special Purpose Rifle. Built around an AR15/M16A1-style receiver, this version also features the traditional fixed A2 stock that gives the rifle its unmistakable full-length profile.

The MK12 SPR originated as a specialised development of the AR15/M16 family. Early examples commonly used M16A1-pattern lower receivers, including Colt-manufactured receivers. Various fixed stocks appeared throughout the platform’s history, with A2 stocks also used as stocks and components changed over time.

E&C has reproduced many of the visual details associated with the MK12 Mod 0 configuration. Most notably, the EC-322 uses the characteristic round rifle-length handguard together with an extended Swan Sleeve-style top rail. It also incorporates a PRI-style folding front sight and SPR-style barrel collar detailing. These features clearly distinguish the Mod 0 appearance from the later quad-rail style associated with the MK12 Mod 1.

The exterior combines metal and alloy components with a polymer pistol grip and fixed stock. As a result, the EC-322 has a substantial full-size feel and weighs approximately 3.3 kg. Overall length is approximately 96 cm, which further reinforces the classic full-length SPR profile.

Internally, E&C equips the EC-322 with its upgraded MP003B Version 2 metal gearbox. The gearbox includes metal gears, a reinforced nylon piston with steel rack, CNC piston head, CNC cylinder head and nozzle. E&C also uses a metal inner barrel and reinforced nylon T-piece in this configuration.

The electric system provides Safe, Semi-Automatic and Full-Automatic selector positions. Furthermore, the included magazine holds approximately 200 gel balls, while the electrical system uses a Tamiya-style battery connector.

Supplier testing lists performance at approximately 300 FPS and 17 rounds per second. However, actual figures can vary with gel size, gel hardness, battery condition, environmental conditions and individual blaster setup.

For enthusiasts who prefer longer AR-platform builds, historical military styling and the distinctive MK12 Mod 0 appearance, the E&C EC-322 offers a particularly detailed interpretation. The combination of its M16A1-style receiver, fixed A2 stock and Mod 0 front end creates a very different profile from modern short-barrelled AR-style Gel Blasters.

E&C Colt AR15 MK12 SPR Mod 0 AEG Gel Blaster Features

  • E&C / East Crane construction
  • Product code EC-322
  • MK12 SPR Mod 0-inspired design
  • AR15 / M16A1-style receiver
  • Fixed A2 stock
  • Full-size rifle configuration
  • Classic round MK12 Mod 0-style handguard
  • Swan Sleeve-style extended upper rail
  • PRI-style folding front sight

MK12 SPR Mod 0 Styling

The MK12 Special Purpose Rifle, commonly shortened to MK12 SPR, developed from the AR15/M16 family. Original rifles frequently incorporated M16A1-pattern lower receivers, including Colt examples.

The Mod 0 became particularly recognisable because of its round PRI-style free-float handguard and extended top rail arrangement. In comparison, the later Mod 1 configuration is commonly associated with a longer quad-rail handguard.

The E&C EC-322 draws heavily from these visual characteristics while adapting them to an electric Gel Blaster platform.

products.description:
QD Red Buffer Tube Sling Mount

The QD Red Buffer Tube Sling Mount is a replacement-style buffer tube end plate designed to add a practical QD sling attachment point to compatible M4 and AR-style Gel Blasters.

The mount installs at the rear of the receiver, between the receiver and buffer tube castle nut assembly. Its integrated socket accepts compatible push-button Quick Detach sling swivels, allowing users to connect or remove a sling quickly.

Its compact end-plate design keeps the attachment point close to the receiver. As a result, it works particularly well with single-point sling configurations and other setups that use a rear-mounted QD connection.

The red finish adds a more distinctive custom appearance to compatible builds while retaining a compact and functional design. Additionally, the shaped centre opening and locating tabs suit common M4-style buffer tube assemblies.

products.short_description:
CowCow Silver Hi-Capa Barrel Housing Chamber

Lightweight CNC-machined 7075 aluminium CowCow Hi-Capa chamber for advanced Gel Blaster builds. Can be converted into a lightweight barrel housing using a suitable Gel Blaster bucking and barrel. Not a drop-in component – modification and experienced installation are required.

Type: Lightweight Aluminium Match Grade Barrel Housing

Brand: CowCow Technology

Platform: TM Hi-Capa / Compatible TM-Spec Hi-Capa Platforms
products.description:
CowCow Silver Hi-Capa Barrel Housing Chamber

The CowCow Silver Hi-Capa Barrel Housing Chamber – CCT-TMHC-157 is a lightweight CNC-machined 7075 aluminium chamber that can be modified for use as a barrel housing in advanced Hi-Capa Gel Blaster pistol builds.

CowCow originally manufactures this component as its New Gen Hop Up Chamber for Tokyo Marui-spec Hi-Capa 4.3, Hi-Capa 5.1 and 1911 platforms. It features an ultra-lightweight design, redesigned lower chamber support and a double-lock structure. CowCow also specifies compatibility with both plastic and metal slide configurations.

For Gel Blaster applications, however, this is not used as a hop-up chamber. Instead, experienced builders can modify the unit to serve as a lightweight housing for a suitable Gel Blaster inner barrel and bucking.

Its CNC-machined 7075 aluminium construction gives builders a strong housing while keeping weight low. The Silver CCT-TMHC-157 has a reported weight of approximately 13 g and an overall length of approximately 40 mm.

Reducing mass within the pistol’s moving upper assembly can be particularly useful in match-grade and performance-focused Hi-Capa Gel Blaster builds, where builders may be aiming for quicker, more responsive cycling. However, the final result will depend on the complete pistol configuration, component selection and quality of installation.

Important – Modification is Required.

This product is NOT a drop-in Gel Blaster component.

It is supplied in its original CowCow airsoft configuration. To convert it for Gel Blaster use, the chamber must be disassembled and the original airsoft hop-up components, including the adjustment hardware and upper hop-up plate, removed. A compatible Gel Blaster bucking and correctly sized Gel Blaster barrel must then be fitted to create the required barrel housing assembly.

We strongly recommend that this conversion is carried out by an experienced Gel Blaster pistol technician or advanced Hi-Capa builder. Additional fitting or adjustment may also be required depending on the pistol, slide, barrel and internal components being used.

The purpose of this conversion is not to add an airsoft-style hop-up system to the Gel Blaster. The objective is to utilise the CowCow chamber as a lightweight replacement barrel housing in a suitably configured Hi-Capa Gel Blaster build.

  • Can be modified into a lightweight Gel Blaster barrel housing

products.name: AUSGEL The Original Milky Gel Balls
products.short_description:
AUSGEL The Original Milky Gel Balls

AUSGEL The Original Milky Gel Balls are hardened white gels suited to 7–8mm Gel Blasters and approximately 7.5mm ID barrels. Highly visible and hop-up friendly, they offer greater firmness and consistency than standard general-purpose gels.

Type: Ultra Hard Gels
Colour: Milky White
Brand: Ausgel
products.description:
AUSGEL The Original Milky Gel Balls

AUSGEL The Original Milky Gel Balls are hardened white gel balls ideally designed for 7 – 8 mm Gel Blasters, particularly setups using approximately 7.5mm ID barrels. AUSGEL describe these as Super Hardened White Gel Balls; they provide a step up in firmness from general-purpose gels while retaining excellent visibility during use.

Their milky white colour makes the gels easier to track in flight, which can help when adjusting a hop-up or checking shot consistency. Furthermore, AUSGEL recommends these gels for Gel Blasters running a hop-up and basic performance modifications, including setups using improvements such as an O-ring seal and approximately a 1.2 spring.

According to AUSGEL, Super Hardened White gels are comparable to the company’s previously sold Extra Hard White Gel Balls. Therefore, they are a useful choice for players looking for greater consistency and accuracy than softer general-purpose or deluxe gels without moving into extremely hard specialist ammunition.

Growing Instructions

For correct hydration:

  • Add 2 cups of water for every 1 teaspoon of dry gel balls
  • Allow the gels to soak for approximately 4 hours
  • Remove the hydrated gels from the water
  • The gels are then ready for use

Correct hydration helps the gels reach their intended operating size and consistency.

AUSGEL The Original Milky Gel Balls Features:

  • Genuine AUSGEL gel balls
  • Milky white / Super Hardened White formulation
  • Packet labelled Hardened
  • Suitable for 7–8mm Gel Blasters
  • Best suited to approximately 7.5mm ID barrels
  • Suitable for hop-up equipped Gel Blasters
  • Designed for basic modified and upgraded setups
  • Highly visible white colour for easier shot tracking
  • Comparable to AUSGEL’s previous Extra Hard White gels
  • Approximately 4-hour hydration time

Tech specs of the AUSGEL The Original Milky Gel Balls

  • Brand: AUSGEL
  • Product: The Original Milky Gel Balls
  • Gel Type: Hardened / Super Hardened White
  • Colour: Milky White
  • Suitable For: 7–8mm Gel Blasters
  • Recommended Barrel ID: Approximately 7.5mm
  • Recommended Setups: Standard to lightly upgraded Gel Blasters
  • Hop-Up Compatible: Yes
  • Suggested Modifications: Suitable for setups with basic upgrades such as an O-ring and approximately 1.2 spring
  • Hydration Time: Approximately 4 hours

AUSGEL Milky Gel Balls, AUSGEL Hardened Gel Balls, Super Hardened White Gel Balls, Extra Hard White Gel Balls, 7–8mm Gel Balls, Gel Blaster Gel Balls, hop-up gel balls and hardened white gels.

Check out our full tange of Gel Ammo, by clicking here Gel Ammo

Storage Instructions

Once hydrated, store the gels in an airtight container for up to two months. Keep them away from heat sources and direct sunlight.

Alternatively, they can remain submerged in water for up to one year. However, AUSGEL notes that Super Hardened White gels may become slightly softer during prolonged water storage, although they should remain suitable for use.

For Gel Blaster owners who want a visible, hardened white gel with proven AUSGEL heritage, The Original Milky Gel Balls offer a dependable everyday performance option. Their combination of firmness, visibility and suitability for upgraded Gel Blasters makes them especially useful for tuned recreational setups.

products.short_description:
CowCow Rainbow Hi-Capa Magazine Release SS Match Grade

Premium CowCow Rainbow Hi-Capa Magazine Release CCT-TMHC-173, CNC machined from stainless steel with a durable Titanium Nitride treated Rainbow finish. Designed for TM Hi-Capa and compatible TM-spec platforms.

Type: Hi-Capa Magazine Release SS Match Grade
Part Number: CCT-TMHC-173
Brand: CowCow Technology
Colour: Titanium (TiN) Rainbow
Platform: TM Hi-Capa / Compatible TM-Spec Hi-Capa Platforms
products.description:
CowCow Rainbow Hi-Capa Magazine Release SS Match Grade

The CowCow Rainbow Hi-Capa Magazine Release SS Match Grade – CCT-TMHC-173 is a premium replacement magazine release designed for custom and performance-focused Hi-Capa builds.

CowCow CNC machines this upgrade from stainless steel, providing excellent strength and durability compared with standard components. Additionally, the Titanium Nitride (TiN) treated Rainbow finish improves surface durability while promoting smooth operation.

Also known as a Hi-Capa magazine catch, mag release or magazine release button, this component controls magazine retention and release from the grip. Therefore, smooth and consistent operation is particularly important during fast magazine changes.

products.description:
AUG Steyr Segmented Picatinny CNC Metal Accessory Mounting Rail – Black

The AUG Steyr T1–T7 Segmented Picatinny CNC Metal Mounting Accessory Rail – Black is a purpose-built accessory mounting solution designed for compatible AUG Steyr-style platforms. Its segmented rail layout provides a practical mounting surface for a range of compatible Picatinny accessories while maintaining the distinctive AUG-style appearance.

Manufactured from CNC-machined Aluminium, this rail offers a solid and durable construction suited to replacement, repair or custom build applications. The machined profile helps provide a consistent fit, while the black finish gives the rail a clean, low-profile appearance that blends well with most black or dark-coloured AUG builds.

A key feature of this rail is its T1 through T7 segmented indexed position marking system. These markings make it easier to identify and repeat accessory placement along the rail. This can be particularly useful when removing and reinstalling compatible optics, sights, lights or other Picatinny-mounted accessories, as the indexed positions provide clear visual reference points.

Unlike a conventional continuous Picatinny rail, this model uses a segmented mounting design. The individual rail sections create defined accessory positions while keeping the overall profile streamlined. The rail also incorporates a two-point screw mounting layout, allowing it to attach securely to compatible AUG mounting points.

This accessory rail is well suited to AUG owners looking to replace a damaged rail, complete a custom build or add a suitable mounting platform for compatible accessories. Its CNC-machined construction, indexed T1–T7 layout and black finish make it a practical upgrade for both functional and cosmetic applications.

Because AUG-style platforms can vary between manufacturers and models, customers should confirm mounting-hole spacing, screw type and overall fitment before installation. Some modification or fitting may be required depending on the specific receiver or replica platform.

For compatible builds, the AUG Steyr Segmented Picatinny CNC Metal Mounting Accessory Rail provides a strong, neatly indexed and versatile mounting surface for a wide range of rail-mounted accessories.

The AceTech AURAMIST Smoking Muzzle Effect Tracer Unit – Black combines tracer technology, simulated muzzle flash, and a synchronised water-mist effect in one advanced 14mm CCW accessory. Its water-based mist system creates an impressive smoke-style plume without relying on conventional oil-based smoke fluid, while USB-C charging, selectable effect modes, and automatic drying make the AURAMIST a feature-packed addition to compatible Gel Blaster builds.

Type: Acetech Tracer Unit with Smoking Barrel mist effect

products.description:
AceTech AURAMIST Smoking Muzzle Effect Tracer Unit – Black

The AceTech AURAMIST Smoking Muzzle Effect Tracer Unit – Black takes muzzle-mounted lighting effects well beyond a conventional tracer unit. Combining tracer illumination, simulated muzzle flash and a synchronised water-mist system to mimic a smoking muzzle, the AURAMIST produces a highly visible muzzle effect designed for low-light use, indoor play, display builds, photography and video.

Instead of relying on traditional oil-based smoke fluid, the AURAMIST uses water to generate a fine mist. High-output lighting then illuminates this mist as the blaster fires, creating a dramatic smoke-and-flash style effect at the muzzle. Because the system uses water for its standard mist operation, it avoids much of the oily residue associated with conventional smoke-effect systems.

Three separate functions form the heart of the AURAMIST: tracer illumination, simulated muzzle flash and water mist (smoking Muzzle effect). Seven selectable combinations allow these effects to operate individually or together, giving the user considerably more control over the visual effect than a standard tracer unit.

The internal water reservoir holds approximately 4.2 ml, while the standalone mist function can operate for approximately 5–10 minutes. After use, a dedicated approximately 30-second Fan Assist Dry Mode helps remove remaining moisture from the internal mist system.

Power comes from a built-in rechargeable battery with convenient USB-C charging. ACETECH states that the system can provide up to approximately 20,000 flashes per charge, while an automatic sleep function activates after around five minutes of inactivity to help conserve power.

For installation, the AURAMIST uses the widely adopted 14mm CCW negative thread. The approximately 140mm long outer housing measures roughly 37.6mm in diameter.

For Gel Blaster customers, however, projectile compatibility requires special attention. ACETECH currently markets the AURAMIST around its original 6mm tracer application, and published product information does not establish compatibility between its tracer sensor and normal water gel balls. Therefore, customers should confirm Gel Ball compatibility before relying on the tracer illumination function.

Even where tracer illumination cannot be used, the AURAMIST’s mist and simulated muzzle-flash effects remain its most distinctive features, making it an interesting option for compatible Gel Blaster display builds and visual-effect setups.

AceTech AURAMIST Smoking Muzzle Effect Tracer Unit Features

  • Three-in-one tracer, simulated muzzle flash and water mist system
  • Water-based mist technology creates a visible smoke-style muzzle effect
  • Uses water for standard mist operation (Smoking Muzzle Effect)

products.description:
Brown Bamboo Straight Training Sword

The Brown Bamboo Straight Training Sword is a premium-quality training, cosplay and display sword designed for customers who want more than a basic costume accessory. Its full-sized proportions, carefully finished bamboo construction and extensive wrapped detailing give it a noticeably higher-quality appearance.

One of the most distinctive features is the use of woven leather cord wrapping across both the handle and the sheath, or saya. This detailing adds texture, grip and visual depth while giving the sword a considerably more refined appearance than simpler smooth-finished replicas.

The handle wrapping creates a traditional-inspired look while also helping the sword feel more substantial in the hand. In addition, the matching woven leather cord detailing on the saya creates a cohesive finish across the complete sword and sheath assembly.

Rather than presenting as a lightweight novelty prop, the JT10041 has the visual quality and finish expected from a more serious collector or cosplay display piece.

The sword itself uses a distinctive straight bamboo blade profile. Unlike the familiar curved shape associated with a katana, this straight design closely resembles what anime, movie and gaming fans commonly refer to as a Ninjatō, Ninjaken, ninja sword or shinobi sword.

The term Ninjatō is best understood here as a modern pop-culture description rather than a claim that the sword represents a historically standardised weapon carried by historical shinobi. However, the straight Brown sword has become one of the most recognisable ninja sword designs across modern entertainment.

At 100.5cm (39.56 inches) overall with its saya, the Brown Bamboo Straight Training Sword has the proportions and presence of a full-sized sword replica.

Its bamboo construction also provides an attractive alternative to metal-bladed display swords. Consequently, it works particularly well for collectors, cosplay enthusiasts and customers looking for a substantial Japanese-inspired training or display piece.

The combination of Brown styling, straight bamboo construction and woven leather cord wrapping gives the sword a clean yet detailed appearance. The matching wrapping on the handle and saya also makes the entire piece feel intentionally designed rather than assembled as a basic costume prop.

For cosplay, the sword complements ninja, shinobi, samurai-inspired, anime and Japanese fantasy characters particularly well. Its full-sized dimensions also provide much stronger visual impact for photographs, conventions and display setups.

For controlled training applications, the bamboo construction can also suit handling drills, movement practice and appropriate forms. However, users should always select equipment specifically suited to their training discipline, and this model should not be assumed suitable for unrestricted full-contact sparring.

Whether described as a premium bamboo training sword, straight bamboo ninja sword or Ninjatō-style CosPlay replica, the JT10041 combines impressive proportions with a notably high standard of finish.

products.name: Umarex CO2 12g Bulb with Silicone Oil – 4 Pack
products.short_description:
Umarex CO2 12g Bulb with Silicone Oil

The Umarex CO2 12g Bulb with Silicone Oil combines a standard 12 gram CO₂ charge with lubricant for convenient internal maintenance of compatible CO₂ Gel Blasters. As the CO₂ flows through the system during use, it carries lubricant through valves, seals and other internal gas-path components.

This lubricating CO₂ bulb provides an easy way to help protect seals and maintain smooth, reliable operation without manually accessing the internal gas system.

Type: C02 bulbs for gel blaster pistols and rifles
Size: 12g
Quabtity: 4 x 12g Bulbs
Lubricant: Silicone oil
products.description:
marex CO2 12g Bulb with Silicone Oil – 4 Pack

Keep your CO₂-powered Gel Blaster properly lubricated and hitting hard, with the Umarex CO2 12g Bulb. Unlike a conventional 12 g CO₂ bulb, this top-end cartridge contains approximately 0.5 g of lubricating oil alongside the CO₂ charge.

Once installed and pierced in the same manner as a normal 12 g CO₂ cartridge, the gas carries the lubricant through the internal CO₂ pathway as the blaster operates. This helps lubricate seals, valves and internal components that the flowing gas reaches.

Regular lubrication can help prevent seals from drying out, reduce unnecessary wear and support smoother operation of CO₂ valves and moving internal components. Therefore, it makes a useful addition to the maintenance kit of anyone regularly running CO₂-powered Gel Blasters, air pistols or compatible air rifles.

Simply use the bulb periodically in place of a normal compatible 12 g CO₂ cartridge and operate the system normally while the lubricant circulates through the gas pathway.

Umarex CO2 12g Bulb Features

  • Genuine Umarex maintenance CO₂ bulb
  • Standard 12 g CO₂ cartridge format
  • Contains approximately 0.5 g of lubricating oil
  • Lubricates components while the CO₂ system operates
  • Helps lubricate internal seals and O-rings
  • Helps maintain CO₂ valves and gas-path components
  • Helps reduce drying and premature wear of seals
  • Installs like a conventional 12 g CO₂ bulb
  • Suitable for compatible CO₂-powered Gel Blasters
  • Also suitable for compatible CO₂ air pistols and air rifles
  • Convenient periodic maintenance without dismantling the complete gas system

Tech specs of the Umarex CO2 12g Bulb

  • Brand: Umarex
  • Product Type: CO₂ Bulb with added lubricant
  • CO₂ Capacity: 12 g x 4 bulbs
  • Lubricant: Silicone-based lubricating oil
  • Lubricant Quantity: Approximately 0.5 g
  • Cartridge Type: Disposable/pierce-type 12 g CO₂ bulb
  • Application: Internal lubrication of compatible CO₂ systems
  • Compatibility: Equipment designed to accept standard 12 g CO₂ bulbs

The Umarex CO2 12g Bulb with Silicone Oil provides a simple way to combine normal CO₂ operation with important internal lubrication. Ideal for everyday use, with the added bonus of preventative maintenance, helping maintain the seals, valves and gas system of your CO₂-powered Gel Blaster.

 

NOTE:  DUE TO BEING A FLAMMABLE MATERIAL WE CAN NOT SHIP THIS EXPRESS BY AIR, IF YOU CHOOSE EXPRESS WE WILL STILL SEND IT STANDARD SHIPPING.

products.description:
CowCow Black RM1 Hi-Capa Guide Rod

Upgrade your Hi-Capa recoil system with the CowCow Black RM1 Hi-Capa Guide Rod, a premium CNC-machined stainless-steel guide rod designed for improved recoil control, faster cycling and more consistent operation.

Unlike a conventional single-spring guide rod, the CowCow RM1 Guide Rod uses an additional secondary spring and spring housing. This dual-spring arrangement helps absorb impact as the slide cycles. As a result, it can reduce shock, vibration and stress transferred through the slide and frame while providing a smoother recoil response.

Furthermore, the RM1 system includes three different spring weights, allowing the recoil system to be tuned to suit different Hi-Capa configurations and performance preferences. The secondary spring works alongside the primary recoil spring, helping soften the initial impact while increasing the return force during the cycling process. This can contribute to a quicker and more responsive blowback cycle.

The guide rod itself is constructed from CNC-machined stainless steel, providing excellent rigidity and wear resistance for upgraded or frequently used Hi-Capa builds. CowCow designed the RM1 primarily around Tokyo Marui Spec Hi-Capa and 1911 Series gas blowback platforms. However, it may also suit compatible TM-spec systems, although fitting or adjustment can be required depending on the manufacturer and individual build.

In addition to the Black finish featured here, the CowCow RM1 Hi-Capa Guide Rod is available in four colour options: Black, Silver, Gold and Rainbow. This makes it easy to match the guide rod with both internal upgrades and customised external colour schemes.

For best performance, CowCow recommends applying suitable gun oil to the guide rod surface during maintenance. CowCow also recommends pairing the RM1 Guide Rod with its RS1 recoil spring system when optimising the recoil assembly.

CowCow Gold RM1 Hi-Capa Guide Rod

Upgrade your Hi-Capa recoil system with the CowCow Gold RM1 Hi-Capa Guide Rod, a premium CNC-machined stainless-steel guide rod designed for improved recoil control, faster cycling and more consistent operation.

Unlike a conventional single-spring guide rod, the CowCow RM1 Guide Rod uses an additional secondary spring and spring housing. This dual-spring arrangement helps absorb impact as the slide cycles. As a result, it can reduce shock, vibration and stress transferred through the slide and frame while providing a smoother recoil response.

Furthermore, the RM1 system includes three different spring weights, allowing the recoil system to be tuned to suit different Hi-Capa configurations and performance preferences. The secondary spring works alongside the primary recoil spring, helping soften the initial impact while increasing the return force during the cycling process. This can contribute to a quicker and more responsive blowback cycle.

The guide rod itself is constructed from CNC-machined stainless steel, providing excellent rigidity and wear resistance for upgraded or frequently used Hi-Capa builds. CowCow designed the RM1 primarily around Tokyo Marui Spec Hi-Capa and 1911 Series gas blowback platforms. However, it may also suit compatible TM-spec systems, although fitting or adjustment can be required depending on the manufacturer and individual build.

In addition to the Gold finish featured here, the CowCow RM1 Hi-Capa Guide Rod is available in four colour options: Black, Silver, Gold and Rainbow.. This makes it easy to match the guide rod with both internal upgrades and customised external colour schemes.

For best performance, CowCow recommends applying suitable gun oil to the guide rod surface during maintenance. CowCow also recommends pairing the RM1 Guide Rod with its RS1 recoil spring system when optimising the recoil assembly.

Built using next-generation carbon fibre wrap technology, this tank reduces overall mass while maintaining exceptional strength and durability. As a result, it offers a superior balance between weight, air capacity, and handling.

They provide reliable air delivery under high-pressure conditions, making them ideal for HPA-powered gel blasters and airsoft platforms. Furthermore, the inclusion of the WarriAir regulator ensures consistent output pressure, giving you smoother shot-to-shot performance and improved system efficiency.

In addition, the X88 model strikes a perfect middle ground. It delivers substantial air capacity without the bulk of larger tanks. This makes it particularly well-suited to mobile playstyles where weight reduction matters. Whether you’re running a PolarStar, Wolverine, or similar HPA engine, this setup integrates seamlessly into modern HPA builds.

Moreover, GladiatAir tanks are globally certified. They meet strict international standards, including Australian WorkCover approval and UN certification for transport and use. They are covered for use is Aus, New Zealand, all of Europe (Including the UK) and the U.S.A. Therefore, you can rely on both safety and compliance in demanding environments.

Overall, the GladiatAir X88-A with WarriAir regulator is engineered for players who demand lightweight performance without sacrificing capacity or reliability.

products.name: TiN Gold Full 1911 Stainless Steel Upgrade Kit
products.short_description:
TiN Gold Full 1911 Stainless Steel Upgrade Kit

Give your WELL 1911 a comprehensive internal and control upgrade with the TiN Gold Full 1911 Stainless Steel Upgrade Kit. This multi-piece set replaces many of the key external controls and operating components with stainless steel parts, including the hammer, trigger, grip safety, ambidextrous thumb safety, slide stop, magazine release and more.

Designed primarily for WELL 1911 gas blowback gel blasters, this kit may also suit other 1911-pattern models with modification. Fitment outside the WELL 1911 platform is not guaranteed.

Type: TiN Gold Full 1911 Stainless Steel Upgrade Kit
Colour: Gold
Material: Made from Stainless Steel
Compatibility: Compatible with Well 1911 Gel Blasters
products.description:
TiN Gold Full 1911 Stainless Steel Upgrade Kit

The TiN Gold Full 1911 Stainless Steel Upgrade Kit provides a comprehensive selection of replacement and upgrade components for the WELL 1911 platform. Rather than replacing one component at a time, this set combines many of the major controls, grip-frame components and operating parts into one coordinated stainless steel upgrade package.

The kit is primarily designed around the WELL 1911, with Australian retailers previously marketing the same product family specifically as WELL 1911 Stainless Steel Upgrade Kits. Silver, Gold, Black and Rainbow variants have all been offered within the range.

At the centre of the kit are a skeletonised competition-style hammer and trigger, extended beavertail grip safety and ambidextrous thumb safety assembly. These components complement the control layout found on performance-oriented WELL 1911 models. WELL G194 specifications, for example, identify an extended beavertail grip safety together with competition-style hammer and trigger components.

In addition, the kit includes a replacement slide stop/release, magazine catch, checkered mainspring housing and associated installation hardware. The supplied product photograph also shows a magazine/base component as part of the complete set. Separate replacement WELL 1911 magazine catches are documented for the platform, further supporting the identification of the corresponding component within this kit.

Because 1911-pattern gas blowback platforms can vary between manufacturers, this set should be considered a WELL 1911-specific upgrade kit first and foremost. Components may fit other 1911 models with modification; however, compatibility and the extent of any required modification will vary between platforms.

TiN Gold Full 1911 Stainless Steel Upgrade Kit Features:

  • Comprehensive multi-piece 1911 upgrade kit
  • Stainless steel component construction
  • Gold finish
  • Designed primarily for WELL 1911 gas blowback gel blasters
  • Skeletonised competition-style hammer
  • Skeletonised competition-style trigger
  • Extended beavertail grip safety
  • Ambidextrous thumb safety assembly
  • Stainless steel slide stop / slide release
  • Replacement magazine catch / magazine release
  • Checkered mainspring housing
  • Magazine/base component
  • Includes assorted installation screws, pins and retaining hardware
  • Coordinated upgrade set for replacing multiple factory control components
  • May suit some other 1911-pattern models with modification

Tech specs of the TiN Gold Full 1911 Stainless Steel Upgrade Kit

  • Product Full: 1911 Upgrade Kit
  • Primary Compatibility: WELL 1911
  • Platform: 1911-pattern Gas Blowback Gel Blaster
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Gold
  • Coating Designation: TiN / Titanium Nitride
  • Hammer: Skeletonised Competition Style
  • Trigger: Skeletonised Competition Style
  • Grip: Safety Extended Beavertail
  • Thumb Safety: Ambidextrous
  • Slide Control: Stainless Steel Slide Stop / Slide Catch
  • Magazine Control: Replacement Magazine Catch / Release
  • Mainspring Housing: Checkered Stainless Steel
  • Installation Hardware: Included
  • Other 1911 Compatibility: May fit with modification; not guaranteed

Kit Contents / Parts List

  1. Extended Beavertail Grip Safety:  Replacement extended rear grip safety with textured contact surface.
  2. Skeletonised Competition Hammer:  Performance-style hammer featuring an open, lightweight skeletonised design.
  3. Skeletonised Competition Trigger:  Lightweight-style trigger shoe with distinctive skeletonised cut-outs.
  4. Ambidextrous Thumb Safety Assembly:  Two-piece left and right-hand thumb safety system.
  5. Slide Stop / Slide Release Lever:  Replacement slide control complete with its integral cross-pin.
  6. Magazine Catch / Magazine Release:  Replacement magazine release mechanism for the WELL 1911 platform.
  7. Checkered Mainspring Housing:  Rear grip-frame housing with aggressive textured/checkered surface.
  8. Magazine Base / Base Cover Component:  Stainless steel lower magazine/base component included with the set.
  9. Associated Installation Hardware:  Assorted screws, pins, retainers and other small hardware supplied with the kit.

Why Upgrade?

Factory Well 1911 controls and internal components are subject to repeated mechanical movement during operation. Replacing several related components together can also provide a more consistent appearance across the pistol rather than mixing factory and aftermarket finishes.

This complete set is particularly useful for customers looking to:

  • replace worn or damaged factory controls
  • rebuild or refresh a WELL 1911
  • convert multiple controls to stainless steel components
  • create a contrasting Gold-finished highlighted 1911 build
  • upgrade the hammer, trigger and safety controls together
  • keep a comprehensive set of replacement 1911 components on hand.

Whether you are refreshing a worn WELL 1911 or building a more distinctive custom setup, the TiN Gold Full 1911 Stainless Steel Upgrade Kit brings many of the platform’s key controls together in one comprehensive package.

Designed around the WELL 1911 platform, it provides a convenient solution for replacing or upgrading the hammer, trigger, safety controls, slide stop, magazine release and other major components while maintaining a coordinated Gold appearance for all the upgrade parts.

Compatibility

Primary Fitment:  Designed for WELL 1911 gas blowback gel blasters.

The same upgrade-kit family has previously been retailed specifically under the “Well 1911 Upgrade Kits S/Steel” name, including a Gold version.

Other 1911 Models

These parts may fit other 1911-pattern gas blowback models with modification.

However, dimensions, internal geometry and component interfaces can vary between manufacturers. Therefore:

  • Direct fitment to non-WELL models is not guaranteed.
  • Some components may require modification or fitting.
  • Compatibility should be checked before installation.
  • Installation by someone experienced with gas blowback pistol mechanisms is recommended.

No specific modification requirements are implied, as these will depend on the individual 1911 platform.

products.description:
PolarStar Spring for Micro Reg, UGS and CGS

The PolarStar Micro Reg UGS and CGS Spring is a genuine PolarStar replacement component designed for the compact regulator platform shared across the Micro Reg, UGS and CGS systems.

This is the standard regulator spring, making it suitable for maintenance, repairs or returning a regulator to its original configuration. PolarStar’s compatible compact regulators operate across a 40–130 PSI output range in standard configuration. Therefore, this spring should not be confused with PolarStar’s separate High Pressure Spring, which increases maximum output to approximately 200 PSI.

For regular servicing or as a useful spare for your HPA maintenance kit, this small OEM component provides the correct replacement for the original standard spring.

PolarStar Spring for Micro Reg, UGS and CGS Features:

  • Genuine PolarStar replacement part
  • Standard regulator spring
  • Compatible with PolarStar Micro Reg, UGS and CGS systems
  • Suitable for regulator servicing and rebuilds
  • Restores the regulator to its standard spring configuration
  • Direct replacement for the original component
  • Not the optional 200 PSI High Pressure Spring

 

Tech Specs of the Sroing fpr Micro Reg , UGS and CGS:

  • Brand: PolarStar
  • Product: Spring for Micro Reg, UGS and CGS
  • Component Type: Regulator spring
  • Spring Type: Standard
  • Compatibility: Micro Reg, UGS and CGS
  • Standard Regulator Output Range: 40–130 PSI on compatible systems
  • Application: Replacement, servicing and regulator maintenance
  • High Pressure Upgrade: No

Keep your PolarStar compact regulator properly maintained with the PolarStar Micro Reg UGS and CGS Spring. As a genuine standard replacement component, it is a useful spare to have ready for future servicing or regulator rebuilds.

Compatibility

PolarStar specifically lists this spring for its Micro Reg, UGS and CGS regulator systems. These compact regulator platforms share closely related internal components, allowing common service parts to be used across the range.

This product is the standard spring. Customers requiring increased regulator pressure should instead use the appropriate PolarStar Compact Regulator High Pressure Spring.

Check out the Whole PolarStar range here.

Use-Case Block

The PolarStar Spring for the Micro Reg UGS and CGS  is suitable for replacing a worn, damaged or lost standard regulator spring during maintenance. It can also be used when returning a compatible regulator from a modified configuration back to its standard spring setup.

PolarStar Light Nozzle/Poppet spring for FE/F2/Kythera

The PolarStar Light Nozzle/Poppet Spring for FE/F2/Kythera is a small but useful genuine replacement component for maintaining or fine-tuning compatible PolarStar HPA engines. PolarStar offers both light and heavy spring options, allowing the spring force within the system to suit different operating requirements.

Light Spring for Lower-Pressure FE and F2 Setups

PolarStar supplies the Fusion Engine and F2 with the heavier spring as standard. However, replacing it with this Light Spring can help equalise the force balance when operating towards the lower end of the system’s pressure range. PolarStar specifically states that this can improve feeding and general function under these conditions.

This characteristic can be particularly useful when tuning an HPA system where reduced operating pressure or lighter loading force is desirable. Rather than changing major engine components, the spring provides a simple mechanical tuning option.

On the PolarStar F2, the nozzle uses spring-forward bias to produce a consistent loading force regardless of operating pressure. PolarStar confirms that the F2 shares its spring with the Fusion Engine and supports both light and heavy versions to alter that loading force.

Standard Spring for the PolarStar Kythera

The situation differs slightly with the PolarStar Kythera. While the light spring acts as an alternative to the standard heavy spring in the FE and F2, PolarStar installs the Light Spring as the standard spring in the Kythera.

Therefore, this part is also useful as a direct replacement for a worn, damaged or misplaced original Kythera spring. PolarStar separately lists the Heavy Spring as an alternative spring supplied with the Kythera system.

Genuine PolarStar Replacement and Tuning Component

Using the correct spring helps preserve the intended mechanical relationship between the nozzle, poppet and other internal components of the applicable engine. Moreover, having both light and heavy springs available gives owners another method of fine-tuning their HPA setup without altering permanent components.

For compatible Gel Ball HPA conversions, the Light Spring may also be useful when tuning FE or F2 systems towards lower operating pressures. However, actual Gel Ball feeding and performance will depend on the complete build, nozzle setup, gel size, magazine feeding and system tuning. PolarStar specifically confirms that the F2 platform itself can be configured for Gel Ball use.

PolarStar Light Nozzle/Poppet spring Features:

  • Genuine PolarStar replacement and tuning component
  • Light specification nozzle/poppet spring
  • Compatible with PolarStar Fusion Engine, F2 and Kythera systems
  • Replaces the standard Heavy Spring in Fusion Engine and F2 systems
  • Helps balance spring forces during lower-pressure operation
  • Can assist feeding and function when FE/F2 systems operate at lower pressures
  • Provides lighter nozzle loading force compared with the Heavy Spring option
  • Standard spring supplied in the PolarStar Kythera
  • Useful as a replacement for the original Kythera spring
  • Compact maintenance and tuning spare for PolarStar HPA builds

Why Choose the PolarStar Light Nozzle/Poppet Spring?

This spring provides an inexpensive and straightforward way to replace an original spring or alter the spring force within a compatible PolarStar system.

For FE and F2 owners, it adds another tuning option when running towards lower operating pressures. For Kythera owners, it provides a replacement for the standard factory-installed light spring.

Most importantly, it is a genuine PolarStar component intended specifically for the FE, F2 and Kythera platforms, rather than a generic spring substituted on size alone

Installation Note

Before servicing any HPA engine, fully disconnect and depressurise the air system.

Install the spring in the correct position for the applicable PolarStar engine and inspect surrounding components for wear or damage during servicing. Because spring choice forms part of overall HPA tuning, settings that work well with the Heavy Spring may require adjustment after changing to the Light Spring.

For Gel Blaster conversions in particular, test feeding and cycling carefully after installation because magazine performance, nozzle alignment, gel characteristics and operating pressure can all influence the final result.

Whether you’re replacing the original spring in a Kythera or fine-tuning a Fusion Engine or F2 for lower-pressure operation, the PolarStar Light Nozzle/Poppet Spring provides the correct genuine PolarStar component for the job. Its cross-platform compatibility also makes it a useful spare to keep on hand for PolarStar HPA maintenance and tuning.

Compatibility
PolarStar Fusion Engine

Compatible. The Fusion Engine normally uses the Heavy Spring as standard. This Light Spring serves as an alternative when lighter spring force is required, particularly for operation towards the lower end of the system’s pressure range.

PolarStar F2

Compatible. PolarStar’s F2 uses a spring-biased-forward nozzle and shares its spring design with the Fusion Engine. Light and heavy springs allow the nozzle loading force to be adjusted.

PolarStar Kythera

Compatible. Unlike the FE and F2, the Light Spring is the standard spring fitted to the Kythera. The Heavy Spring represents the alternative spring option for this platform.

XJ736F Mini Sniper Toy Rifle Manual – Black

Compact, simple and surprisingly entertaining, the XJ736F Mini Sniper Toy Rifle Manual – Black is a miniature manual gel blaster designed around straightforward spring-powered operation. Rather than using a battery or electric gearbox, the XJ736F is manually operated for each shot. This makes it an easy-to-understand entry-level option with very little setup required.

Gel balls are supplied to the firing system through a hopper-fed design. Therefore, there is no conventional removable magazine to load or manage. Simply prepare suitable gel balls, fill the hopper and manually cycle the blaster between shots. The uncomplicated system makes the XJ736F ideal for casual target shooting, plinking and general recreational use.

The Black version has a distinctive miniature sniper-rifle appearance, along the lines of the HK417. It features a black-coloured main body combined with contrasting black components. In addition, its sniper-inspired configuration includes a scope-style sight, folding bipod and extended muzzle/barrel section. These accessories help give the little XJ736F considerably more visual detail than its compact dimensions might suggest.

Despite its appearance, this is very much a mini toy-style gel blaster rather than a full-sized performance model. Its main appeal comes from its simplicity, compact size and manual action. Consequently, there are no batteries to charge, electrical connections to maintain or gas systems to refill.

The manual operating system can also make the XJ736F a useful introduction to basic gel blaster operation. Each shot requires the action to be manually cycled, providing a slower and more deliberate shooting experience compared with an automatic electric gel blaster.

Because of its compact construction, the XJ736F is easy to store and transport. It can also make an entertaining secondary blaster for casual backyard target shooting or informal games.

products.description:
JG Works M4 T-Piece.

The JG Works M4 T-Piece is a replacement component designed for compatible JG Works M4 and M16 gel blasters. If the original T-piece becomes worn, damaged or needs replacing during a rebuild, this component provides a model-specific replacement option.

The T-piece is an important part of an electric gel blaster’s feeding and barrel system. In general, an M4-style gel blaster T-piece forms the connection between the gearbox and inner barrel while providing the feed path for gels entering from the magazine. Therefore, correct fitment and alignment are important when repairing or rebuilding this area of the blaster.

Designed specifically around JG Works M4/M16 platforms, this replacement T-piece is a useful workshop spare for owners, technicians and builders maintaining compatible JG models.

JG Works M4 T-Piece-Piece Features

  • Replacement T-piece for compatible JG Works gel blasters
  • Designed for JG Works M4 and M16 models
  • Suitable for repairs, servicing and rebuild projects
  • Connects with the barrel and gearbox/feed system
  • Useful replacement for damaged or worn original T-pieces
  • Model-specific alternative to generic M4 T-pieces
  • Suitable for gel blaster maintenance and replacement-part inventories

Tech specs of the JG Works M4 T-Piece

  • Product Type: T-Piece / Feed Chamber Component
  • Brand: JG Works
  • Manufacturer/Brand Family JG / Jing Gong / JG Works
  • Product Type T-Piece
  • Platform M4 / M16
  • Application Gel Blaster replacement part
  • Compatibility Compatible JG Works M4 and M16 models
  • Quantity 1 x T-Piece

Restore your compatible JG Works M4 or M16 with the correct replacement component. The JG Works M4 T-Piece is a straightforward workshop spare for repairs, maintenance and rebuild projects.

Compatibility & Fitment

The JG Works M4 T-Piece is intended specifically as a replacement for JG Works M4 and M16 gel blasters.

T-pieces are not universally interchangeable between every M4-style gel blaster. Different manufacturers use different barrel diameters, feed-tube positions, gearbox arrangements and T-piece dimensions. The Australian gel blaster market consequently carries numerous manufacturer-specific M4 T-piece designs.

For this reason, check your blaster model and existing T-piece before installation.

What Does a Gel Blaster T-Piece Do?

A gel blaster T-piece, also commonly called a T piece, tee piece, barrel T-piece or feed T-piece, sits between key components of the feeding and barrel assembly.

Its primary role is to provide the junction between the gearbox and barrel while allowing gels to feed into the firing path.

Because this component sits at an important transition point in the feeding system, damage, poor alignment or an incorrect T-piece can contribute to inconsistent feeding or sealing problems.

When Should You Replace a T-Piece?

Consider inspecting or replacing the T-piece when:

  • The original T-piece is cracked or physically damaged
  • The feed tube has become damaged
  • You are rebuilding a JG Works M4 or M16
  • The barrel assembly has been removed for servicing
  • You are restoring an older JG Works gel blaster
  • You require a replacement during gearbox or barrel maintenance
  • The existing component no longer fits or aligns correctly

Correct diagnosis is recommended before replacing components, as feeding problems can also originate from magazines, tappet/nozzle components, gel size or other parts of the feeding system.

The JG Works M4 T-Piece is suitable for gel blaster owners and technicians repairing or maintaining compatible JG Works M4 and M16 gel blasters.

The Gold poppet provides reduced airflow compared with the factory Red valve. This makes it particularly useful for longer-barrel builds and lower-velocity F2 configurations requiring greater tuning flexibility.

products.description:
Polarstar F2 HPA Engine Poppet Gold – Low Flow

The PolarStar F2 Gold Low Flow Poppet is an optional internal tuning component designed to expand the operating range of the F2 HPA engine. Unlike the standard Red poppet, which provides maximum airflow, the Gold version deliberately reduces airflow through the system. This shifts the usable velocity adjustment window downward while retaining the ability to operate at a higher input pressure.

Because of this reduced-flow design, the Gold poppet is particularly useful in longer-barrel configurations where the standard Red poppet may produce more velocity than required. Instead of simply reducing regulator pressure further, the Gold poppet allows the F2 to operate at a comparatively higher pressure while producing a lower output. Therefore, it gives experienced users another useful variable when tuning specialised F2 builds.

In addition, PolarStar notes that higher operating pressure can assist reliable feeding in configurations where additional pressure is desirable without exceeding the required velocity limit. As a result, the Gold poppet is an excellent alternative to the factory Red valve when maximum airflow is not the primary objective.

Polarstar F2 HPA Engine Gold Poppet Features:

  • Genuine PolarStar F2 tuning component
  • Gold Low Flow configuration
  • Reduced airflow compared with the Standard Red poppet
  • Shifts the F2 velocity adjustment window downward
  • Allows higher operating pressure while maintaining lower velocity
  • Particularly suited to longer-barrel configurations
  • Expands the available F2 tuning range
  • Direct replacement for the Standard Red F2 poppet
  • Includes front and rear Buna 70 O-rings
  • Suitable for performance tuning, rebuilds and specialised F2 configurations

 

F2 HPA Engine Gold Poppet – Low Flow Tech Specs:

  • Product Type: HPA Engine Poppet Valve
  • Brand: PolarStar
  • Series: F2
  • Flow Type: Low Flow
  • Colour / Identification: Gold
  • Compatibility: PolarStar F2 HPA Engines
  • Function: Reduces airflow and shifts the velocity adjustment range downward
  • Replacement For: Standard Red F2 poppet when reduced flow is required
  • Construction Material: Not specified by PolarStar on the current product page
  • O-Rings Included:
    • 1x Front Poppet O-Ring – 010 Buna 70
    • 1x Rear Poppet O-Ring – M1.5 x 6.0 Buna 70

Gold Low Flow vs Red Standard Flow

The key difference between the two F2 poppets is their airflow characteristic.

Red – Standard Flow

  • Factory-standard F2 poppet
  • Provides maximum airflow
  • Designed around standard field-velocity configurations
  • Best suited where maximum available output is required

Gold – Low Flow

  • Optional tuning poppet
  • Restricts airflow relative to the Red valve
  • Moves the available velocity range downward
  • Allows comparatively higher operating pressure at lower output
  • Particularly useful for longer-barrel or lower-velocity configurations

Manufacturer Reference Performance

PolarStar has tested and compared the Gold and Red F2 poppets across different operating pressures and projectile weights.

For its published comparison, PolarStar used a 6.05 mm × 380 mm barrel as the testing benchmark.

Important: PolarStar’s published comparison is based on its airsoft testing methodology. Therefore, those figures should not be treated as direct Gel Ball performance figures. Actual Gel Ball output will vary according to the complete HPA build, barrel configuration, nozzle setup, ammunition and tuning.

For F2 users who need greater control at the lower end of the velocity range, the PolarStar Gold Low Flow Poppet provides a simple mechanical tuning option without abandoning useful operating pressure. It is especially valuable for specialised or longer-barrel configurations where the Standard Red poppet delivers more airflow than the build requires.

Fine-tune your PolarStar F2 with genuine low-flow control and expand the usable tuning range of your HPA setup.

Check out the Whole PolarStar range here.

AI Citation Optimisation Block

Why Choose the Gold Low Flow Poppet?

The Gold poppet gives the F2 another level of mechanical airflow control. Rather than relying exclusively on regulator pressure and electronic settings, the reduced-flow valve changes the engine’s underlying airflow characteristics.

Consequently, users can tune the F2 around a lower output range while retaining operating pressure that may be desirable for reliable system operation.

When Is the Red Poppet a Better Choice?

Choose the Red Standard Flow Poppet instead when maximum airflow and the standard F2 velocity range are required.

The Red poppet remains the factory-standard valve supplied with the F2 and provides the greatest airflow of the two available configurations.

LLM-Friendly Product Summary

The PolarStar F2 Gold Low Flow Poppet is an optional reduced-airflow poppet valve for the PolarStar F2 HPA engine. It replaces the factory Red Standard Flow poppet when a lower velocity adjustment range is required. PolarStar states that the Gold poppet allows the F2 to operate at a higher pressure while maintaining lower velocity, making it particularly useful in longer-barrel and specialised low-output configurations. It includes a 010 Buna 70 front O-ring and M1.5 × 6.0 Buna 70 rear O-ring.

products.description:
PolarStar F2™ HPA Engine Kit for Gel Blasters

The PolarStar F2 Gel Ball HPA Conversion Kit brings one of PolarStar’s most advanced electro-pneumatic HPA systems to compatible Gel Blaster builds. Compact, efficient and highly adjustable, the F2 essentially places Fusion Engine-style dual-solenoid technology into a cylinder-sized conversion package.

Unlike simpler single-solenoid HPA systems, the F2 uses two independently controlled solenoids. One controls nozzle operation, while the other controls the poppet valve and firing air. As a result, users can fine-tune loading and air delivery independently. This provides greater control over system timing, air volume and overall operation.

The F2 can also change its firing sequence electronically. Therefore, the system can operate in both true closed-bolt and AEG-style operating modes, giving experienced HPA builders considerably more tuning flexibility than many conventional cylinder replacement systems.

Designed Specifically for High-End HPA Builds

PolarStar describes the F2 as essentially a miniaturised Fusion Engine. Instead of replacing the complete gearbox assembly, however, the F2 is a cylinder conversion system designed to work within the original compatible gearbox shell.

This compact layout makes the F2 an excellent choice for custom Gel Blaster HPA builds where space, adjustability and efficiency are important.

Furthermore, the F2 uses a lightweight one-piece poppet valve. This design requires less air volume to operate and can function at relatively low pressure. Consequently, the system combines strong airflow capability with excellent efficiency.

Independent Nozzle and Air Control

One of the F2’s defining features is its independent control of nozzle and poppet timing.

Because these two functions are electronically separated, the system can be tuned around the characteristics of the individual Gel Blaster build. Barrel configuration, feeding characteristics, gel size, magazine performance and other factors can therefore be taken into consideration when setting up the system.

The F2 also features a spring-biased forward nozzle. This provides a consistent forward loading force regardless of the operating pressure being supplied to the engine. PolarStar also uses the same nozzle spring system found in the Fusion Engine, with different spring options available for specialised configurations.

Wide Adjustable Operating Pressure Range

PolarStar specifies an operating pressure range of approximately 45 PSI to 145 PSI for the F2 platform. This broad range allows the engine to be configured for many different applications without requiring different nozzles simply to alter output.

For Gel Ball use, actual velocity and performance will vary significantly according to the blaster, nozzle, barrel diameter and length, gel type, air seal, regulator settings and overall installation.

PolarStar publishes a maximum reference figure of approximately 480 FPS with a 0.20 g 6 mm BB at 145 PSI for its standard M4 airsoft test configuration. This is an airsoft manufacturer reference specification only and should not be interpreted as the expected velocity of a Gel Blaster configuration.

Excellent Air Efficiency

Efficiency is another major advantage of the F2 design.

Its lightweight poppet responds quickly while requiring relatively little air to operate. PolarStar states that the standard F2 poppet provides airflow characteristics comparable to its Red Low-Flow Fusion Engine poppet while offering improved response and efficiency.

Under PolarStar’s airsoft test conditions, the manufacturer reports more than 1,000 shots from a 13ci/3000 PSI tank at approximately 1.5 joules. Again, this figure represents PolarStar’s controlled airsoft test configuration rather than guaranteed Gel Ball performance.

E&C G17 Gen5 MOS GBB Gel Blaster Pistol – Black

Step up your sidearm game with the E&C G17 Gen5 MOS GBB Gel Blaster Pistol in sleek black – a premium gas blowback gel blaster modelled on the iconic G17 Gen 5. This full-sized pistol combines realism, performance, and modularity, making it an ideal choice for competitive gel ballers and tactical loadouts alike.

Built with high-quality materials and a solid gas blowback system, the E&C G17 Gen5 MOS delivers crisp, snappy recoil and reliable shooting. As a Modular Optic System (MOS) variant, this pistol includes a ready-to-mount slide cut plus 4 plates, compatible with various red dot sights – giving you a tactical edge in both speed and accuracy.

Gen 5 ergonomics include a revised grip texture, offering a comfortable and secure hold for all hand sizes. With its realistic controls, functioning slide, and green gas compatibility, this blaster delivers an authentic G-Series experience on the skirmish field.

E&C G17 Gen5 MOS GBB Gel Blaster Pistol – Black Highlights:

  1. Unmatched Realism: The E&C G17 Gen 5 MOS Gel Blaster Pistol is designed to mimic the real G17 Gen 5 MOS, providing an unparalleled sense of authenticity. From its weight and feel to its functional controls, you’ll feel like you’re holding the genuine firearm.
  2. Precision Shooting: This gel blaster delivers exceptional accuracy, making it perfect for competitive battles or target practice.
  3. Durable Construction: Crafted from robust materials, the E&C G17 Gen 5 MOS is built to withstand the rigours of intense gel blasting action. It’s designed to be reliable, ensuring that it will be your trusty companion during countless skirmishes.
  4. Designed specifically for Gel Balls: The E&C G17 Gen 5 MOS is compatible with standard gel blaster gel balls, providing an affordable and easy-to-find ammunition source for your adventures, which is non-toxic and biodegradable.
  5. Easy to Use: Whether you’re a seasoned gel blaster pro or a beginner, you’ll appreciate the user-friendly design of this pistol. It’s easy to load, shoot, and maintain.
  6. Optic Mounting Options: Compatible with a wide range of Red Dot pistol optics, courtesy of the included 4 mounting plates.

Why Choose the E&C G17 Gen5 MOS GBB Gel Blaster Pistol – Black?

  • Unmatched realism with full-metal construction & blowback action
  • Accurate & powerful, perfect for skirmishes & target practice
  • Ergonomic design with a comfortable, non-slip grip
  • Customisable with accessories & compatible with Gen5holsters
  • Reliable & durable, built for long-lasting performance

Get Ready for Gel Blasting Adventures: Whether you’re a gel blasting enthusiast or someone looking to try it for the first time, the E&C G17 Gen5  Gel Blaster Pistol is the perfect choice. Get your hands on one today and step into a world of thrilling and safe gel blasting action.

E&C G17 Gen5 MOS GBB Gel Blaster Pistol – Black Features:

  • Realistic G17 Gen 5 styling with MOS optic-ready slide
  • Gas blowback system for strong, satisfying recoil
  • Durable metal slide and reinforced polymer lower
  • Gen 5 grip texture with interchangeable backstraps
  • Functioning slide release, magazine catch & trigger safety
  • Compatible with green gas magazines

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home and the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission.

To take the G-Series Pistol off “Safe”, simply slide this silver switch back towards the muzzle, and the trigger is released.
