products.description:
[vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

E&C Colt AR15 Gel Blaster with M203 Grenade Launcher (EC-703-Grey-Ultra) – Black

The E&C Colt AR15 XM16E1 Gel Blaster with M203 Grenade Launcher recreates the unmistakable profile of an early full-length AR15-pattern service rifle. Its fixed stock, carry-handle upper receiver, long barrel assembly and M203-style launcher produce a distinctive period-inspired appearance.

E&C has paired this classic external design with the upgraded internals of its Ultra Line range. Therefore, the EC-703-Grey-Ultra offers more than display appeal. It also provides a strong foundation for regular gel-blaster gameplay. The receiver and key exterior components use aluminium alloy, while selected furniture components use fibre-reinforced polymer. As a result, the blaster offers a solid and realistic feel without relying entirely on metal construction. At approximately 1,000 mm long and 3.6 kg with the launcher fitted, this is a substantial full-sized gel blaster. Its weight and fixed-stock configuration suit players who prefer a traditional rifle platform rather than a compact carbine.

Classic Colt AR15 XM16E1 Styling

The XM16E1 was an important transitional development within the early Colt AR15 and M16 family. This replica draws heavily from that early rifle profile, including its fixed stock, carry handle, forward-assist-style receiver and traditional front sight assembly. The attached M203-style under-barrel grenade launcher gives the blaster an even more imposing appearance. It also creates a recognisable rifle-and-launcher configuration suited to themed collections, historical displays and field loadouts. Although commonly associated with later M16-family rifles, the M203-style launcher complements the long AR15 platform and gives this model its distinctive silhouette.

Why Choose the E&C M16 Gel Blaster with M203 Grenade Launcher?

  • Unleash your tactical prowess with this remarkable combo.
  • Whether you’re a collector or a player, the authentic design will impress.
  • Take advantage of the M203 grenade launcher for exciting gameplay strategies.
  • Experience reliable and precise performance in every battle.

With its imposing full-length profile, M203-style launcher and upgraded E&C Ultra Line internals, the Colt AR15 XM16E1 is an outstanding centrepiece for serious players and collectors alike.

The AUSGEL 1.18 Un-Equal Gel Blaster Spring is an excellent choice for players looking to refresh, repair, or fine-tune their AEG gel blaster gearbox. Designed with a variable-pitch (un-equal) coil pattern, this spring delivers smooth compression characteristics while maintaining consistent return force throughout the firing cycle. As a result, it can help improve gearbox efficiency and provide dependable operation in compatible electric gel blaster platforms.

Unlike traditional equal-pitch springs, an unequal spring features varying coil spacing along its length. Consequently, the spring compresses progressively during operation, which can contribute to smoother cycling and reduced stress on internal components. Furthermore, the spring incorporates flat-ground ends to promote even contact with the spring guide and piston assembly. This helps reduce uneven wear over time while supporting reliable performance.

With an approximate 1.18mm wire diameter rating, the AUSGEL 1.18 spring is often selected for balanced performance builds where reliability and consistency are prioritised over maximum spring tension. Therefore, it is suitable for gearbox servicing, preventative maintenance, replacement of worn springs, and general performance upgrades.

products.description:
POKER Silicone Gun Oil Lubricant – Brush Type Dispenser

Proper maintenance plays a major role in the performance and longevity of any gel blaster or airsoft platform. The POKER Silicone Gun Oil Lubricant – Brush Type Dispenser from BeistOutdoor makes routine servicing quick, clean, and precise. Unlike traditional squeeze bottles or aerosol lubricants, the integrated brush applicator allows you to place lubricant exactly where it is needed. As a result, you can minimise waste while achieving consistent coverage on critical components.

Furthermore, silicone-based lubricants are widely recognised for their compatibility with rubber seals, O-rings, plastic parts, and internal assemblies. Because silicone oil does not dry out as quickly as many petroleum-based alternatives, it helps maintain lubrication over extended periods. In addition, it can assist with preserving the flexibility of seals and reducing wear on moving components. Similar silicone gun oils are commonly used to protect against moisture, corrosion, and dirt build-up while maintaining smooth operation of mechanical systems.

The brush-style dispenser also offers greater control when working on precision components. products.short_description:

Type: Spring Powered Manual Mag-Fed Gel Blaster Pistol

Material: ABS Plastic

Uses: 7 -8 mm ammo
products.description:
BingBao G26 Manual Mag Fed Gel Blaster Pistol

  • Magazine Fed
  • Distance up to 18 m
  • Uses 7-8 mm gels
  • ABS Plastic
  • Please note this toy is manual, and there is no need for a battery or for green gas

BingBao G26 Manual Mag Fed Gel Blaster Pistol Included in each Box:

  • 1 x BingBao G26 Manual Mag Fed Gel Blaster Pistol
  • 2 x Factory 7.0-8.0 mm Dehydrated gels (Really poor Quality, best to buy some decent Gels, such as X-Force Orange Gels)

Operation of this blaster

  • Always use 7-8 mm gels that have been well hydrated for at least 6 hours, fresh out of water and not too dry.
  • Different brands of gels will vary in the performance of this product.
  • Load the fully hydrated gels into the magazine, and insert them into the handle.
  • When you first load the blaster, it may take a few times to fire the blaster before gels are fired out of the blaster.
  • The blaster will not fire a gel for every shot (pull of the trigger), this is common and normal for this type of blaster.
  • At times, the Gel Blaster may fire two gels during one shot, again this is common and normal for this blaster.
  • Before purchasing, please ensure you understand the above points and understand that this blaster is a budget, manual item and not perfect.
  • It may not fire a gel every time you pull the trigger, and gel firing distance and accuracy will vary with every shot.
  • Two gels may be fired with one shot. This is how most manual gel blasters function and is normal for them and this type of product.

BATTERY?

This Product is a manual spring-powered item and so requires no batteries.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

Finally, the T-Eagle T-3S delivers the ideal combination of compact size, powerful illumination, lightweight construction, and practical functionality. products.description:
Ghillie Suit – Arctic Warfare

The Ghillie Suit – Arctic Warfare is designed for snow-themed environments, winter camouflage loadouts and cold-weather MilSim styling. Or, purely for CosPlay, as we don’t have many places that get snow, here in Australia. Featuring a lightweight white mesh construction with woven white camouflage strands, this over-suit delivers an aggressive winter-concealment appearance while maintaining flexibility and breathability in use.

Unlike heavier traditional ghillie systems, this Arctic Warfare version uses a highly breathable and very see-through white mesh base. As a result, the colour and style of the clothing worn underneath remain clearly visible through the suit. So, if you can, wear white items under the Ghillie Suits. This creates a lighter overall profile and allows players to customise the appearance by layering white, grey or winter camouflage clothing beneath the outer mesh.

The woven camouflage strands are also more widely spaced than those in denser desert-style ghillie suits. Consequently, the suit offers a lighter and less bulky feel while still helping to break up the wearer’s outline in snowy terrain, frosted vegetation and winter-style environments. The loose strands move naturally with the user and the surrounding environment, enhancing the irregular camouflage effect during movement.

Elasticated cuffs and ankle sections help keep the suit comfortably positioned while preventing excessive loose movement during gameplay or outdoor activity. Furthermore, the lightweight construction allows improved mobility for crawling, kneeling and prone positioning without the heavy weight associated with traditional full-fibre ghillie systems.

The oversized over-suit design allows it to fit over tactical clothing, jackets, chest rigs or lightweight load-bearing equipment. Whether you are building a winter sniper loadout, preparing for themed MilSim events or creating a striking tactical costume setup, the Arctic Warfare Ghillie Suit provides a highly recognisable snow camouflage profile.

The clean white appearance makes this suit ideal for winter-themed photography, cosplay, display setups and outdoor tactical games. Additionally, the lighter strand density creates a more breathable and comfortable option for extended wear compared to heavier camouflage suits.

Perfect for Gel Blaster players, MilSim enthusiasts, airsoft users and tactical costume applications, the Ghillie Suit – Arctic Warfare combines lightweight comfort, visual concealment styling and a distinctive winter camouflage aesthetic.

Ghillie Suit – Arctic Warfare Features

  • Lightweight Arctic Warfare style ghillie suit
  • White breathable mesh construction
  • Very see-through mesh allows underlayers to remain visible
  • Widely spaced camouflage strands for a lighter feel
  • Woven white camouflage fibres create 3D texture
  • Elasticated cuffs and ankle sections
  • Oversized design fits over tactical clothing and gear
  • Flexible lightweight construction improves mobility
  • Suitable for Gel Blaster, airsoft and MilSim use
  • Ideal for winter camouflage and snow-themed loadouts

products.description:
GladiatAir HPA Regulator O-Ring – RASP18

Replacement Black Nitrile O-ring for the neck of the HPA Cylinder, where the regulator sits on top of the HPA tank.

Black Nitrile O-rings are made of general-purpose polyurethane rubber, which is known for its combination of hardness and elasticity. These O-rings have excellent abrasion resistance and high breaking strength. O-rings of Nitrile are resistant to oils, ageing, ozone, heat, electricity, and many chemicals.

GladiatAir O-rings perform well at low temperatures, but are not recommended for extremely high temperatures or superheated steam.

When installing your O-ring and any time you remove and replace the regulator, we recommend using a good-quality silicone grease to help the O-ring seat properly and seal properly.

Such as the Abbey Silicone Grease.

Abbey Silicone Grease

 

Sold individually.

 

Special Note: Only fill HPA cylinders from filtered “breathing Air” Scuba compressors. Contamination to the cylinder from oil, dust or any dirt, by filling using compressors that are not specifically designed to pump out clean “Breathable” quality, high pressure air, will void the warranty on your cylinder. This will also potentially void the warranty, and damage, the HPA gun that your cylinder is powering.

products.description:
XYL ZP2 Red Camo Hopper Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol – Futuristic Power & Precision

The XYL ZP2 Red Camo Hopper-Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol delivers a bold, futuristic design combined with a highly practical feeding system that sets it apart from traditional gel blaster pistols. Built for fast-paced backyard play and casual skirmishing, the ZP2 blends eye-catching sci-fi styling with simple, dependable operation.

At the heart of the ZP2 is its top-mounted hopper feed system, allowing multiple gel balls to be loaded at once and fed directly into the firing mechanism. This eliminates the need for standard stick magazines, reduces reload interruptions, and keeps the pistol lightweight and easy to handle. The result is a smooth, user-friendly gel blaster that’s ideal for beginners, younger players, or anyone looking for something a little different from conventional pistol designs. Note: Top mount hopper can feed a little irregularly, as gravity is the only force feeding the gels. If you get misfires, with no gel balls being fired, turn the unit upside down and shake gently to ensure that two gels aren’t caught next to each other in the loading neck.

The ZP2’s compact frame and ergonomic grip make it comfortable to use for extended sessions, while its clean Red Camo finish enhances the futuristic aesthetic. Whether you’re plinking targets in the backyard, introducing new players to gel blasting, or adding a unique sidearm to your collection, the XYL ZP2 offers a fun, accessible, and visually distinctive experience. Another super cool feature is the included tactical torch, which can be mounted into the front of the blaster. Simply remove the dome-shaped blanking cap, and push the torch in. Once in place, push the end of the torch to turn it on, then push it again to turn it off (1 x AA battery required, not included)

While originally designed for WM GBBR rifles, its versatility knows no bounds. This exceptional inner barrel can also be effortlessly integrated into other platforms, such as directly fitting into an AEG’s T-piece. Elevate your precision and versatility with our Adjustable Hop-up Inner Barrel today.

Grey Wolf 550 mm Integrated Hop-up Stainless Steel Inner Barrel Features:

products.description:
YOUSUN 1400 Round MaxFeed Gel Blaster Magazine – UltraCap Spring Feed M4 / HK416 High Capacity Magazine

If you are running high rates of fire, then a standard magazine simply will not keep up. The YOUSUN 1400 Round MaxFeed Magazine solves that problem immediately. It delivers massive capacity and consistent feeding in one purpose-built unit.

Unlike traditional mags, this design uses a spring-driven Gel pressure combined with a high-speed electric worm drive feeding system. As a result, it maintains steady gel delivery even during sustained full-auto bursts. This means fewer dry shots and far fewer interruptions mid-game.

In addition, the oversized reservoir allows you to carry up to 1400 rounds in a single magazine. Therefore, you can stay in the fight longer without constant reloads. This is especially valuable in high-pressure skirmishes or support roles. Plus the clear cylinder, allows you to see exactly how full your magazine is, at any given time.

Moreover, the internal structure is designed for stability under load. Many standard magazines struggle at higher RPS, however this MaxFeed system is built to handle demanding setups. It can support high-speed builds while maintaining reliable feeding performance.

Construction is equally robust. The durable nylon shell keeps weight manageable while ensuring long-term durability. At the same time, the design remains practical for field use, offering a balance between capacity and usability.

Compatibility is centred around M4 and HK416-style gel blasters. This makes it an ideal upgrade for popular platforms such as E&C, LDT, and similar AR-based builds. However, some models may require minor fitting adjustments depending on brand tolerances. Please note, this unit is designed to be extremely tight fitting, so much of the magazine weight is supported by the magwell, rather than just the release catch.

Overall, this is a performance-driven upgrade. It is built for players who want uninterrupted firing, fewer reloads, and maximum efficiency from their setup.

YOUSUN 1400 Round MaxFeed Gel Blaster Magazine Features

  • Ultra-high capacity 1400 round magazine
  • MaxFeed spring-worm driven feeding system
  • Consistent gel feeding under sustained fire
  • Supports high rate-of-fire builds (up to approx. 55 RPS)
  • Large reservoir design reduces reload frequency
  • Durable nylon construction for long-term use
  • Stable internal structure minimises feeding issues
  • Designed for M4 / HK416 gel blaster platforms

Tech Specs of the YOUSUN 1400 Round MaxFeed Gel Blaster Magazine

  • Brand: Yousun
  • Capacity: 1400 rounds
  • Material: Nylon polymer
  • Feeding System: Spring-fed, plus electric worm-drive (MaxFeed)
  • Compatibility: M4 / HK416 gel blasters (some modification of the magazine may be required, for some brands of blaster)
  • Max Supported RPS: ~55 rounds per second
  • Dimensions: Approx. 7.4cm diameter × 24cm height
  • Weight: Approx. 320g

Low-profile tactical goggles designed for Gel Blaster eye protection. Ideal for modular setups using separate lower face gear.

Type: Tactical Tan Goggle Mask
Colour: Tanwith smoke lenses
Materials: Nylon PC Lens with attached protective sleeve
Product gross weight: 0.46 kg
products.description:
Tactical Tan Goggle Mask with Protective Sleeve

The Tactical Tan Goggle Mask with Protective Sleeve is a streamlined eye protection solution designed specifically for Gel Blaster players who prefer a lightweight and low-profile setup. Unlike full-face systems, this design focuses purely on protecting the eyes, making it ideal for players who pair goggles with separate lower face protection or run minimalist loadouts.

Because of its compact design, these goggles allow for greater flexibility when building your gear setup. You can easily combine them with mesh masks, balaclavas, or other lower face options depending on your preference. As a result, they suit both casual players and more experienced users who want to customise their protection without being locked into a full-face system.

The included and connected protective sleeve adds a clean and practical finish to the goggles. It helps create a more cohesive look while also improving comfort around the edges of the frame. In addition, the sleeve can assist with reducing harsh contact points, which is particularly useful during extended play sessions or when worn with helmets and headgear.

Moreover, the Tan tactical styling ensures these goggles integrate seamlessly into most loadouts. Whether you are running a modern tactical kit or a simple backyard setup, the neutral finish makes them easy to match with existing gear. Consequently, they are a versatile addition to any Gel Blaster kit.

For players who already use separate face protection, this goggle-only configuration keeps things simple and efficient. It reduces bulk while still covering one of the most critical safety areas during gameplay, the eyes. Therefore, it is a smart choice for those who prioritise mobility, comfort, and modular gear setups.

At X-Force Tactical, we supply practical Gel Blaster gear suited to Australian players and field conditions. If you need reliable eye protection that works with your existing setup, the Tactical Tan Goggle Mask with Protective Sleeve delivers a clean, flexible solution that fits straight into your loadout.

Tactical Tan Goggle Mask with Protective Sleeve

  • Dedicated eye protection goggle design (no lower face coverage)
  • Lightweight and low-profile for improved mobility
  • Includes protective sleeve for enhanced comfort and finish
  • Ideal for pairing with separate mesh masks or balaclavas
  • Tactical Tan colour suits most gear setups
  • Flexible solution for modular loadouts
  • Suitable for casual and regular Gel Blaster players
  • Easy to integrate with helmets and headwear

Tech Specs of the Tactical Tan Goggle Mask

  • Product Name: Tactical Tan Goggle Mask with Protective Sleeve
  • Colour: Tan with Black lenses
  • Protection Type: Eye protection only (goggles)
  • Design: Low-profile goggle frame
  • Full-time Attached Accessory: Protective sleeve
  • Compatibility: Helmets, caps, mesh masks, balaclavas
  • Primary Use: Gel Blaster eye protection

A simple, effective choice for players who want reliable eye protection without the bulk of full-face systems.

For the best performance of the Wosport Tactical Anti-Fog Fan Glasses Goggle Style Mask, we suggest also adding our Abbey Anti-Fog spray. As the lenses may fog up a little, if you get really warm running around playing Gel Ball.

Constructed from durable 1000D nylon, this sleeve provides a rugged outer layer that resists scuffs, scratches, and abrasion during use. While suppressor covers on real firearms are used for heat management, that function does not apply to gel blasters. Instead, this cover serves as a visual upgrade and protective wrap, making it ideal for players who want a more refined and realistic-looking loadout.

In addition, the internal lining adds structure and helps the sleeve maintain its shape once fitted. The adjustable shock cord and hook-and-loop closure system allow for a snug and secure fit across a wide range of suppressor-style accessories. As a result, installation is quick and straightforward, with no tools required.

Furthermore, the Black colourway blends well with Spec Ops and tactical setups for, urban terrain. It complements a wide range of builds, from M4-style platforms through to DMR-inspired configurations. This makes it a versatile option for players looking to standardise or elevate their gear’s aesthetics.

Overall, this is a simple and effective cosmetic upgrade. It protects your suppressor, improves the visual consistency of your build, and adds a professional, finished look without adding unnecessary weight.

All Aussie stock and we post Australia-wide.

  • Durable 1000D nylon outer construction
  • Protects suppressor from scratches, knocks, and wear

The E&C Black Colt MK16 Value Plus M-LOK URGI AEG Gel (EC-633NY) brings battlefield realism and dependable performance to gel blaster skirmish arenas. Built on the iconic MK16 URGI M-Lok Handguard platform with an enhanced M-LOK tactical handguard, this AEG-powered rifle strikes the perfect balance between rugged construction and competitive play capability.

Finished in a striking Tactical Black colourway, the EC-633NY-DE delivers standout aesthetics while blending seamlessly with milsim-style loadouts. Featuring a full-metal receiver and barrel assembly, combined with durable polymer furniture, this gel blaster maintains structural integrity while remaining comfortable to handle during prolonged use.

Powered by a reliable Automatic Electric Gun (AEG) system, with MOSFET, the MK16 URGI runs on standard gel blaster batteries (sold separately) and offers smooth semi- and full-auto firing modes with a safety selector. The M-LOK rail system allows easy attachment of optics, lights, grips and other accessories — giving you the edge in customisation and tactical versatility.

The Value Plus series shares the same external setup as our Value Line, featuring a reinforced nylon receiver paired with metal external parts. This keeps the blaster lightweight, durable, and affordable. Internally, the Value Plus series uses the same gearbox as the Ultra Line. It comes with a pre-installed MOSFET, providing faster trigger response with a smoother, more consistent feel and less delay between trigger pulls.

Whether advancing through urban fields, battling in the CQB arena or holding objectives in outdoor sites, the E&C Value Plus Colt MK16 URGI AEG Gel Blaster delivers solid performance, ergonomic comfort, and the tactical flexibility to match your playstyle.

products.description:
PolarStar MCU Wire Harness – Mag Terminal Wire | FCU Box Magazine Control Lead for HPA Systems

The PolarStar MCU Wire Harness – Mag Terminal Wire is a purpose-built solution for integrating box magazine feeding into advanced HPA systems. Designed specifically for REV3 FCUs with built-in MCU functionality, this harness enables direct trigger-based magazine control. As a result, your system feeds only when required, improving efficiency and reducing unnecessary motor strain.

Unlike standard plug-and-play harnesses, this version is configured for custom wiring applications. One end features a ZH-series connector that interfaces cleanly with your FCU. Meanwhile, the opposite end is left as a bare lead, allowing you to solder or splice directly into your magazine motor, or attach a plug if needed, or directly into your existing wiring loom. Therefore, it offers maximum flexibility for builders working on custom HPA or Gel Blaster platforms.

Additionally, this harness is particularly suited to support Gel Blaster platforms such as M60, PKM, and M240-style builds. These systems rely on controlled feeding rates, so MCU-triggered activation ensures consistent performance. However, for high-speed box mags with independent switches (e.g. M249-style), using the original wiring method remains recommended to avoid excessive wear or damage.

For Gel Blaster users running HPA conversions, this harness provides a clean pathway to synchronised feeding and firing cycles. Consequently, it improves reliability under sustained fire and eliminates the need for manual magazine activation. When paired with a PolarStar FCU, it becomes an essential component in any serious HPA build.

Polarstar PolarStar MCU Wire Harness Features:

  • Designed for PolarStar REV3 FCUs with MCU functionality
  • Enables trigger-activated box magazine feeding
  • ZH-series connector for direct FCU integration
  • Bare lead end for custom soldering or splicing
  • Ideal for support weapon builds (M60, PKM, M240 platforms)

products.description:
Polarstar F2 HPA Engine Poppet Red – Standard (Red Flow Valve)

The PolarStar F2 Standard Poppet (Red) is a critical internal component that directly controls airflow within your HPA engine. As a factory-spec replacement valve, it ensures your system maintains optimal performance, reliability, and consistency. Whether you are rebuilding, maintaining, or fine-tuning your setup, this OEM poppet restores the original operating characteristics of your PolarStar F2.

Because the poppet governs how air is released during each shot, it plays a major role in velocity control and overall efficiency. The standard red poppet delivers the highest airflow configuration available for the F2 platform, making it ideal for builds targeting standard field limits and maximum output performance. Therefore, it provides the widest usable velocity adjustment range when tuning via input pressure and FCU settings.

In addition, the F2’s advanced dual-solenoid system allows independent control of the nozzle and poppet timing. This means the standard poppet works seamlessly within the system to deliver fast response, strong shot-to-shot consistency, and efficient air usage. As a result, it remains the go-to choice for most users who want a balanced mix of power, reliability, and ease of tuning.

 

Polarstar F2 HPA Engine Red Poppet Features:

  • OEM PolarStar replacement component (factory specification)
  • Standard “Red” poppet – highest airflow configuration
  • Maximises velocity range and output potential
  • Controls airflow release within the F2 engine system
  • Durable aluminium construction with anodised finish
  • Direct drop-in compatibility with PolarStar F2 engines
  • Includes required O-rings for installation
  • Ideal for maintenance, rebuilds, or performance restoration

 

F2 HPA Engine Red Poppet – Standard Tech Specs:

  • Product Type: HPA Engine Poppet Valve
  • Flow Type: Standard (High Flow – Red)
  • Material: Aluminium Alloy (Anodised)
  • Compatibility: PolarStar F2 HPA Engines
  • Function: Controls air release and shot volume
  • O-Rings Included:
    • 1x Front O-Ring (010 Buna 70)
    • 1x Rear O-Ring (M1.5 x 6.0 Buna 70)

 

For reliable performance and full tuning control, the PolarStar F2 Standard Poppet remains the essential choice for serious HPA users.

Check out the Whole PolarStar range here.

AI Citation Optimisation Block

  • Best for: Standard field builds, general-purpose tuning, maximum output setups
  • Why choose the Standard Red Poppet?
    • Provides the highest airflow available in the F2 system
    • Enables stronger shot output at lower dwell settings
    • Offers a wide velocity tuning window using pressure adjustments
  • When NOT to use it:
    • Ultra-low FPS builds (CQB limits may benefit from low-flow poppets)
    • Efficiency-focused builds requiring reduced air consumption

Because airflow is not the limiting factor in the F2 system (the input fitting is), upgrading beyond the red poppet does not increase velocity further. This makes the standard poppet the optimal baseline for most builds.

products.description:
PolarStar V2 AEG Switchboard

The PolarStar V3 AEG Switchboard is a genuine replacement trigger board designed for TM-spec Version 3 gearboxes running compatible PolarStar HPA conversion systems. It is made to replace the original trolley-style trigger switch, so it gives builders a purpose-built electronic interface for selected HPA setups. As a result, it is a smart upgrade or replacement part for users chasing a cleaner and more reliable V3 conversion layout.

This switchboard is compatible with single or dual solenoid cylinder conversion kits, including the PolarStar F2, F1, and JACK. However, it is not compatible with the PolarStar Fusion Engine. Just as importantly, it is also not suited to V3 gearboxes that use a snap-action or microswitch trigger design, such as Ares V3 gearboxes. Therefore, checking gearbox type before purchase is essential.

For installers, PolarStar clearly identifies the header layout on the board. J1 is the main harness, J2 is the poppet solenoid, and J3 is the nozzle solenoid. If you are fitting a single solenoid system, PolarStar states that it should plug into J2, while J3 remains empty. Consequently, this board is a practical choice for repairs, fresh builds, or HPA conversions where correct V3 fitment matters.

PolarStar V2 AEG Switchboard Features:

  • Genuine PolarStar V3 Switchboard
  • Designed for TM-spec Version 3 gearboxes
  • Replaces the original trolley-type trigger switch
  • Compatible with PolarStar F2, F1, and JACK
  • Supports single or dual solenoid cylinder conversion kits
  • Not compatible with the PolarStar Fusion Engine
  • Not compatible with snap-action / microswitch V3 gearboxes
  • PolarStar header layout marked as J1 main harness, J2 poppet solenoid, J3 nozzle solenoid
  • For single solenoid systems, the connection goes to J2, with J3 left empty

V2 AEG Switchboard Tech Specs:

  • Product Name: PolarStar Switchboard, V3
  • Brand: PolarStar
  • Gearbox Fitment: Traditional TM-spec V3 gearbox
  • Primary Function: Replacement switchboard for the original trolley-type trigger switch
  • Compatible Systems: PolarStar F2, F1, JACK
  • Solenoid Support: Single or dual solenoid cylinder conversion kits
  • Fusion Engine Compatibility: No
  • Ares V3 / Microswitch V3 Compatibility: No
  • Header Identification:
    • J1 = Main Harness
    • J2 = Poppet Solenoid
    • J3 = Nozzle Solenoid
  • Single Solenoid Setup Note: Plug into J2 and leave J3 empty

For V3 HPA builders who need the correct electronic trigger interface, the PolarStar V3 Switchboard is a genuine fitment-focused solution for compatible F2, F1, and JACK builds

products.description:
PolarStar MRS HPA Regulator – Compact Modular Air Regulator for HPA Setups

The PolarStar MRS HPA Regulator is a compact, high-performance regulator designed for players who want a cleaner, lower-profile HPA setup without sacrificing adjustability or flow. Standing at roughly 7.62 cm (3 inches) tall, the MRS threads directly onto the HPA on-tank reg, keeping the overall air rig more streamlined. One of its standout features is the integral on/off valve, which allows the system to be safely depressurised before removal from the tank, reducing wear on threads and O-rings over time.

Built for reliable pressure control and strong refresh performance, the PolarStar MRS offers an adjustable output pressure range from 40 PSI (2.75 Bar) to 145 PSI (9.99 Bar) in standard configuration, with an optional high-pressure spring raising the maximum to approximately 200 PSI (13.78 Bar). It also uses an oversized 4mm piston bore for strong airflow and rapid refresh even at lower operating pressures, making it suitable for a wide range of HPA builds that demand consistency shot after shot.

The regulator is also designed with field practicality in mind. It includes an integral tournament lock that can be secured with a standard zip tie, and it is compatible with both standard HPA and SLP tanks. The unit supports a maximum input pressure of 62.05 Bar (900 PSI) and provides 4 x 1/8 NPT outputs, giving users flexibility when configuring their HPA system. PolarStar also lists the MRS with a 1-year limited warranty, adding confidence for buyers investing in a premium air system component.

PolarStar MRS HPA Regulator Key Features:

  • Compact tank-mounted design, approximately 7.62 cm (3 inches) tall
  • Threads directly onto the HPA tank for a lower-profile setup
  • Integrated on/off valve helps safely depressurise the system before removal
  • Adjustable output pressure from 40 PSI (2.75 Bar) to 145 PSI (9.99 Bar) in standard configuration
  • Optional high-pressure spring can raise output to around 200 PSI (13.78 Bar)
  • Oversized 4mm piston bore for high flow and fast refresh rate
  • Integral tournament lock compatible with standard zip-tie locking
  • Works with both standard HPA and SLP tanks
  • Maximum input pressure of 900 PSI (62.05 Bar)
  • Provides 4 x 1/8 NPT outputs
  • Suitable for custom HPA builds and compact air rig setups
  • Backed by a 1-year limited warranty

A compact half-size manual gel blaster with simple trigger-only operation and easy top-loading hopper design – perfect for players of all ages.

Type: Manual Gel blaster pistol.
Material: Nylon Polymer.
Uses: 7-8 mm gels.

products.description:
SKD Mini G19 Manual Gel Blaster

The SKD Mini G19 Manual Gel Blaster is an extremely compact, fun-sized blaster designed for players of all ages and backyard mucking around. At approximately half-life-size, this small-format gel blaster offers easy handling, lightweight construction and simple operation, making it ideal for beginners or casual backyard fun. Its reduced size means smaller hands can grip it comfortably, while still delivering the satisfying feel of a classic G-Series style design.

Unlike most manual gel blaster pistols that require you to rack the slide before each shot, the SKD Mini G19 operates directly from the trigger mechanism. Simply load your gels, pull the trigger and fire. This streamlined system makes it quicker and easier to use, especially for younger players who may struggle with stiff slide actions on traditional springer pistols.

The hopper-fed design adds another layer of convenience. Gels are loaded through a sliding opening on the top of the blaster, eliminating the need for a removable magazine. This keeps the design simple, reduces moving parts and makes reloads fast and straightforward. For safe, lightweight backyard plinking and entry-level gel ball fun, the SKD Mini G19 is an excellent choice.

SKD Mini G19 Manual Gel Blaster Features:

  • Compact half-size design – ideal for younger players (Can only be sold to persons over 18 years of age, but can be used by persons 14+ years, under direct adult supervision)
  • Manual trigger-operated firing system – no slide racking required
  • Hopper-fed system for simple loading
  • Sliding top hatch for quick gel refills
  • Lightweight and easy to handle
  • Low-powered manual operation for backyard target shooting
  • G-Series inspired styling (Labelled as a G19, though it has a mock selector switch, like a G18 has)

Technical Specifications:

  • Model: SKD Mini G19
  • Operation: Manual (trigger-activated spring system)
  • Feed System: Internal hopper (top loading)
  • Loading Method: Sliding top opening
  • Approximate Size: Half life-size format
  • Recommended Gel Size: 7–8mm hydrated gel balls
  • Use Case: Backyard target practice / entry-level play

The SKD Mini G19 Manual Gel Blaster delivers simple, safe and lightweight gel ball fun in a compact package that’s easy for anyone to pick up and enjoy.

 

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” even when using a tiny Gel blaster like this one, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

products.short_description:

Type: Electric Gel blaster pistol.
Material: Metal Slide on a Nylon Polymer Lower.

products.description:
New Galaxy G19x Metal Slide Electric Gel Blaster / Laser Pistol

The “New Galaxy” G19x Metal Slide Electric Gel Blaster / Laser Pistol is a smart, next-generation toy blaster designed to deliver two play styles in one compact platform. Built for versatility and ease of use, this electric pistol allows younger players and casual users to enjoy Electric Blow Back Gel Blasting outdoors, then switch quickly to laser shooting mode for indoor target practice or safe skill-based games. Just like real-world G-Series items, this little beauty features a Metal Slide on a polymer lower.

In gel blaster mode, the G19x fires standard 7–8mm gel balls using a smooth electric blowback system, simulating real pistol action, making it easy to use with minimal effort compared to manual springer pistols. When gels aren’t practical, laser mode transforms the pistol into an electronic shooting toy, ideal for backyard targets, training drills, or friendly competitions—without mess or cleanup. This dual-purpose functionality makes the G19x an excellent all-rounder for families, beginners, and players aged 14+.

Designed as an exact replica electric Gel Blaster, the New Galaxy G19x focuses on fun, accessibility, and adaptability rather than raw power. Its compact pistol form, modern styling, and innovative hybrid design make it a standout choice for players looking for something different from a standard gel blaster pistol.

New Galaxy G19x Metal Slide Electric Gel Blaster / Laser Pistol Features:

  • Dual-purpose design: Gel Blaster + Laser Shooting Pistol.
  • Electric gel feeding system for easy, consistent firing.
  • Laser shooting mode for indoor play and target practice.
  • Compact, lightweight pistol format.
  • Designed for younger and entry-level players
  • Uses standard 7–8mm Gel Balls
  • Excellent option when gel use isn’t practical.

New Galaxy G19x Metal Slide Electric Gel Blaster / Laser Pistol Specs:

  • Brand: New Galaxy
  • Model: G19x
  • Power Type: Electric
  • Construction: Metal Slide on a Polymer lower.
  • Function Modes: Semi Auto Gel Blaster Mode or Laser Shooting Mode
  • Ammo Type: 7–8mm Gel Balls (in gel mode)
  • Feed System: Electric
  • Recommended Age: 14+
  • FPS: Averaging around 155 fps (With Dragon Orbz)
  • Ammo Capacity: Approximately 20 Gels
  • Range: 20 to 25 meters
What’s in the box?
  • 1 x G19x Metal Slide Electric Gel Blaster / Laser Pistol
  • 1 x NG G19x Electric Magazine (Battery included)
  • 1 x USB Charger
  • 1 x Replacement Electric Geared Blowback (2 pieces)
  • 1 x Laser Shooting inner barrel (inner barrel + USB charging cable)
  • 1 x Bottle of Milky White Gels (need to be soaked in water for 4 hours, to grow to the required size)
  • 1 x Pistol Speed loader
  • 1 x Pair white gloves (Who knows why lol)

By combining gel blasting and laser target shooting into one clever platform, the New Galaxy G19x delivers flexibility, fun, and value—making it a standout choice for players who want more ways to play from a single blaster.

 

We recommend the Dragon Orbz, as the best performing Gel, to use with this blaster.

Add some Dragon Orbz to your order, click image above.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

products.description:
GW Notus Red HPA Adaptor for GBB Gel Balster Pistols

The GW Notus Red HPA Adaptor is a high-performance conversion solution for Gel Blaster players looking to run their GBB pistols on a High Pressure Air (HPA) system with large-capacity M4-style magazines. Designed for competitive skirmishing and high-volume gameplay, this adaptor significantly increases consistency, shot count, and reload efficiency compared to standard gas magazines.

This versatile adaptor system supports both G-Series GBB pistols and Hi-Capa-style pistols, using your existing pistol magazines rather than relying on proprietary mags. The kit includes two interchangeable magazine-to-hose adaptors, allowing one configuration for G-Series magazines and the other for Hi-Capa magazines, making it ideal for players who run multiple pistol platforms. A quick top-end rebuild of the Notus adaptor would be necessary to swap between Hi-Capa and G-Series, and vice versa.

Finished in an attractive metallic Red coating, the GW Notus adaptor is built for reliability under sustained HPA pressure. Depending on the pistol brand and internal tolerances, minor modification (shortening) of the magazine’s central bolt may be required to achieve optimal fitment. Once installed, the system allows seamless feeding from standard M4 HPA magazines, delivering extended playtime and consistent performance throughout long skirmish sessions.

Designed with function in mind, the M4 Mag battery is easily accessible via the magnetic battery hatch on the side of the Notus housing.

GW Notus Red HPA Adaptor Key Features:

  • Brand: Grey Wolf
  • Converts GBB Gel Blaster pistols to HPA operation
  • Compatible with G-Series and Hi-Capa style pistols
  • Uses standard M4 AEG-style magazines for high capacity
  • A custom 7,4v Grew Wolf 300mAh battery, provides power for the M4 magazines Gel Ball motor.
  • Supplied with two magazine-to-hose adaptors (G-Series & Hi-Capa)
  • Designed to utilise your existing pistol magazines (some slight modification may be required)
  • Durable, attractive, metallic Red finish for skirmish use
  • Improved consistency over green gas operation
  • Ideal for competition and high-rate gameplay
  • Minor magazine modification may be required on some brands

  • Compatibility: G-Series & Hi-Capa pistols
  • Magazine: Type M4-style HPA magazines
  • Colour: Metallic Red
  • Power Source: External HPA air system
  • Modification Required: Possible minor shortening of magazine centre bolt, depending on brands
  • Intended Use: Gel Blaster skirmish/competition

Notus Red HPA Adaptor, what’s in the box?

  • 1 x Red Notus CNC Adaptor Housing
  • 2 x magazine-to-hose adaptors (1 G-Series, 1 Hi-Capa)
  • M$ Magazine terminal plate with circuit board trigger computer
  • 1 x Grey Wolf mini 7.4v M4 motor battery
  • 2 x Gel Feed tubes
  • 2 x Pistol Mag central bolts
  • 4 x Notus adaptor housing securing bolts

products.description:
SLR-T4 Translucent M4A1 CQB Gel Blaster – V4 Rifle

🔥 The SLR-T4 Translucent M4A1 CQB Gel Blaster – V4 is a modern, feature-rich CQB platform designed for players who want something visually distinctive without sacrificing performance or durability. Built around a striking translucent receiver set, the T4 V4 allows you to see the internals at work while delivering solid out-of-the-box functionality that feels far more premium than its price point suggests.

One of the standout features is the MagPrime system, allowing you to prime the magazine directly via the charging handle — a simple but hugely appreciated upgrade that improves feeding reliability and speeds up reloads during fast-paced CQB play. Internally, the T4 is equipped with a metal inner barrel for improved accuracy and consistency, while the textured outer barrel and metal components throughout give it a reassuringly solid feel in the hands.

This V4 (Version4)  variant is almost fully ambidextrous, featuring a functional ambidextrous bolt release and ambidextrous fire selector, making it equally comfortable for left- or right-handed players. The only ambidextrous thing that could be added would be an ambidextrous magazine release, which is right-hand only. The included metal Picatinny iron sights mount securely and provide a rugged backup aiming solution, while the metal thumb-stop style foregrip enhances weapon control during aggressive cornering and close-quarters engagements.

SLR-T4 Translucent M4A1 CQB Gel Blaster – Inclusive extras.

A particularly clever design detail is the included suppressor, which offers ample internal clearance beyond the inner barrel, making it ideal for adding and concealing a hop-up unit in the future without altering the external appearance. Combined with M-LOK mounting points, two included metal 5-slot Picatinny plates, and quick-release sling mounting holes, the SLR-T4 is a highly adaptable platform that’s ready to be customised to suit your playstyle.

Whether you’re building a lightweight CQB setup or a visually unique showpiece that still performs on the field, the SLR-T4 Translucent M4A1 CQB Gel Blaster – V4 is a seriously compelling option.

Key Features of the SLR-T4 Translucent M4A1 CQB Gel Blaster – V4:

  • Translucent M4A1-style CQB gel blaster design
  • MagPrime system – prime the magazine using the charging handle
  • Metal inner barrel for improved accuracy and consistency
  • Textured outer barrel for enhanced appearance and durability
  • Functional ambidextrous bolt release
  • Ambidextrous fire selector – left- and right-hand friendly
  • Right-hand only magazine release.
  • Metal Picatinny-mounted iron sights included
  • Metal “thumb-stop” style foregrip fitted
  • Suppressor with ample internal space for concealed hop-up installation
  • Includes 2 × metal 5-slot Picatinny M-LOK rail plates
  • M-LOK compatible handguard for accessories
  • Quick-release sling mounting points on the hanguard assembly

SLR-T4 Translucent M4A1 CQB Gel Blaster – V4 Specs:

  • Model: SLR-T4 M4A1 CQB – V4
  • Material Construction: Polymer receiver with metal internal and external components
  • Inner Barrel: Metal
  • Outer Barrel: Textured metal outer barrel
  • Fire Modes: Safe / Semi / Auto
  • Ambidextrous Controls: Fire selector & bolt release
  • Rail System: M-LOK handguard with included Picatinny plates
  • Sights: Metal Picatinny iron sights
  • Grip: Metal thumb-stop foregrip
  • Suppressor: Included (hop-up compatible space)
  • Gel Type: 7–8mm standard gel balls
  • FPS: 235 fps (Using Predator V2 Ultra Hard Gel Ball)

Package Includes:

  • 1 x SLR-T4 Translucent M4A1 CQB Gel Blaster
  • 1 x Translucent SLR Magazine
  • 1 x 10 cm Suppressor (already attached)
  • 1 x Pair Iron Sights
  • 2 x 5 Slot, M-Lok Picatinny Rails

  • 1 x Pair Safety Glasses
  • 1 x 11.1v Battery
  • 1 x USB Battery Charger
  • 1 Pack sample Gels (Usually poor quality, we recommend using these in a greande, rather than this Blaster)
Chosen by X-Force Tactical for its clever design touches, upgrade-friendly layout, and standout aesthetics, the SLR-T4 V4 is proof that a CQB gel blaster can look different and still perform where it counts.

⚠️ NOTE: Just so you know, gels included with blasters are generally of low quality and can often cause feeding issues. We highly recommend you purchase our high-quality hard gels for the best performance, such as our Predator V2 Ultra Hard Gel Ball

products.description:
XYL ZP2 Green Camo Hopper Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol – Futuristic Power & Precision

The XYL ZP2 Green Camo Hopper-Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol delivers a bold, futuristic design combined with a highly practical feeding system that sets it apart from traditional gel blaster pistols. Built for fast-paced backyard play and casual skirmishing, the ZP2 blends eye-catching sci-fi styling with simple, dependable operation.

At the heart of the ZP2 is its top-mounted hopper feed system, allowing multiple gel balls to be loaded at once and fed directly into the firing mechanism. This eliminates the need for standard stick magazines, reduces reload interruptions, and keeps the pistol lightweight and easy to handle. The result is a smooth, user-friendly gel blaster that’s ideal for beginners, younger players, or anyone looking for something a little different from conventional pistol designs. Note: Top mount hopper can feed a little irregularly, as gravity is the only force feeding the gels. If you get misfires, with no gel balls being fired, turn the unit upside down and shake gently to ensure that two gels aren’t caught next to each other in the loading neck.

The ZP2’s compact frame and ergonomic grip make it comfortable to use for extended sessions, while its clean Green Camo finish enhances the futuristic aesthetic. Whether you’re plinking targets in the backyard, introducing new players to gel blasting, or adding a unique sidearm to your collection, the XYL ZP2 offers a fun, accessible, and visually distinctive experience. Another super cool feature is the included tactical torch, which can be mounted into the front of the blaster. Simply remove the dome-shaped blanking cap, and push the torch in. Once in place, push the end of the torch to turn it on, then push it again to turn it off (1 x AA battery required, not included)

XYL ZP2 Green Camo Hopper Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol Features:

  • Futuristic sci-fi–inspired gel blaster pistol design
  • Hopper-fed system for quick loading and reduced reload downtime
  • Lightweight and compact for easy handling
  • Digital Shot counter, on the rear of the gun.
  • Firing modes: Safe, Semi and Full Auto (Controlled by the orange switch on the base of the handle)
  • Simple operation, ideal for beginners and casual players
  • No traditional magazine required
  • Durable polymer construction
  • Striking Green Camo finish with modern styling

XYL ZP2 Green Camo Hopper Fed Sci-Fi Gel Blaster Pistol Specifications:

What’s in the box:

products.description:
Clear SCA Worm Drive M4 Gel Blaster Magazine

The translucent ClearSCA Worm Drive M4 Gel Blaster Magazine is a next-generation magazine designed to solve the most common feeding issues found in traditional motor-driven gel blaster magazines. Instead of relying on a bottom-mounted motor pushing gels through a long feed tube, this advanced design uses a high-tension spring-compressed gel stack, combined with a worm-drive assisted feed system at the outlet for precise, controlled delivery.

The result is a shorter feed path, constant pressure on the gel column, and a dramatic reduction in misfeeds, dry firing, and inconsistent shot delivery. The internal motor no longer struggles to push gels the full length of the magazine, instead driving a screw-style worm gear that advances gels only in the final stage, ensuring smooth, reliable feeding even during high-rate semi-auto or full-auto fire.

Built for M4 / AR15-style AEG Gel Blasters, this magazine is ideal for players who demand consistent performance, improved reliability, and reduced internal wear. Finished in an eye-catching translucent clear shell, it integrates seamlessly with both tactical and competition builds.

  • Spring-compressed gel stack maintains constant upward pressure
  • Short feed path dramatically reduces jams and misfeeds
  • Motor assists only the final feed stage, improving efficiency and reliability
  • Improved consistency during rapid firing and sustained use
  • Durable polymer construction with Translucent Clear finish
  • Designed for M4 / AR15-style AEG Gel Blasters

products.description:
Umarex Smoke Wagon Colt SAA Peacemaker V2 .45 Limited Edition Revolver – by Wingun

Step into the Wild West with the Wingun Colt SAA Peacemaker .45 Revolver Gel Blaster — a fully functioning, single-action revolver styled after the legendary Colt Single Action Army, but built for gel-ball blasting fun. With a full-metal body, smooth cylinder cycling and CO₂ power-system built into the grip, this model delivers authentic feel and performance. With a vintage “Smoke Wagon” nickel and gold finish and six-shot shell system, it’s as much a display piece as it is a thrill to shoot. Ideal for gel-ball skirmish, backyard fun or collector display, this revolver offers 300+ FPS performance and solid build quality that appeals to serious players and enthusiasts alike.

Whether you’re blasting gel balls in your CQB field or showing off the iconic Peacemaker silhouette on your wall, this Wingun model ticks both boxes. Just load in one of the six brass shells, attach a 12 g CO₂ cartridge (sold separately), load your 7-8 mm gel balls and you’re good to go.

Umarex Smoke Wagon Colt SAA Peacemaker V2 .45 Limited Edition Revolver Features:

  • Full-metal body for realism and durability.
  • Version 2 design with upgraded internals and gas efficiency (Compared with Version 1)
  • Realistic single-action revolver mechanism — manual cocking of hammer, cylinder rotation included.
  • CO₂ powered (12 g non-threaded cartridge required) — no battery needed.
  • Six-shell gel-ball cartridge system — each shell holds one 7-8 mm gel balls for true revolver feel.
  • High performance: rated at 300+ FPS (subject to gel quality, CO₂ strength & local conditions).
  • Iconic design: based on the Colt Single Action Army “Peacemaker” revolver — Western styling meets modern gel-ball fun.
  • Collector and skirmish ready — the finish and mechanics suit display and field use alike.
  • Other uses: Ideal for Cosplay or Western reenactment shows.
  • Maintenance friendly: shell re-loading, easy CO₂ replacement.

Umarex Smoke Wagon Colt SAA Peacemaker V2 .45 Limited Edition Revolver Specs:

  • Brand / Manufacturer: Wingun (under Umarex / licensing)
  • Model: Colt SAA Peacemaker .45 Revolver Gel Blaster
  • Finish / Colour: Nickel and Gold “Smoke Wagon” design.
  • Material: Full metal body (metal frame & cylinder)
  • Operation: CO₂ powered single-action revolver
  • Cartridge System: Six brass shells included
  • Ammunition: 7-8 mm gel balls (gel-ball ammo)
  • FPS (approx): 300+ FPS (verified by retailer)
  • Power Source: 12g non-threaded CO₂ cartridge (not included)
  • Recommended Use: Gel-ball skirmish, backyard practice, display collector piece
  • Included in Box: 1 x revolver unit, 6 x brass shells
  • Not Included: CO₂ cartridge, gel-ball ammo, maintenance oil/grease (maintenance recommended)

Please note: The gap between the hammer and the body of the revolver is completely normal, and is not a defect. The hammer is held slightly away from tyhe body of the revolver, by the gas release valve’s spring pressure. If you push the hammer, so that it is flush with the back of the revolver body, then gas will escape through the valve.

Items you need to make the blaster work (that are NOT included)…

  • 12g Co2 Non Threaded
  • AKA Gel Balls. (These GBB pistols do not work efficiently with anything else)
  • Abbey “Gun” Oil – This is for maintenance.
  • Abbey 100% Silicone Grease/Lubricant

A lot of customer find it a pain to take six shots, then have to reload each shell with a Gel and start again. Why not get  a six pack, or two, of spare shells so ya can keep shooting longer.

We tested, and recommend the Tenacity AKA Ultra Hard Gels, for use in the Peacemakers

Also, why not pick up a 15 pack of CO2 cartridges while you’re here. If you don’t already have some, this gun will need em.

CROSMAN Co2 12g Cartridges 15 Pack Deal

products.description:
Cybergun-EMG Colt M4A1 MK16 URGI M-LOK AEG Gel Blaster

The EMG / Cybergun Colt M4A1 MK16 URGI M-LOK AEG Gel Blaster is a fully licensed replica, produced under official authorisation to faithfully reproduce the external styling and markings of the Colt M4A1 platform. Manufactured through the collaboration between E&C (east Crane), EMG (Evike Manufacturing Group) and Cybergun, this gel blaster delivers a level of authenticity, branding accuracy, and visual realism that sets it apart from generic M4-style replicas on the market.

Every external detail has been designed to reflect the real-world counterpart, from the licensed Colt trademarks to the modern MK16 URGI-inspired configuration. The MK16-style M-LOK handguard gives the blaster its contemporary military appearance while maintaining a clean, professional aesthetic suited to both skirmish use and serious replica collections. This is not a loosely inspired design — it is an officially licensed Colt replica, purpose-built for the Gel Blaster market.

Operating on a proven AEG (Automatic Electric Gel Blaster) system, this model offers dependable electric operation combined with excellent compatibility across the M4 gel blaster ecosystem. The M-LOK interface allows users to mount compatible accessories such as foregrips, torches, and dummy PEQ units, enabling easy personalisation without compromising the rifle’s authentic profile. Whether you are a collector seeking licensed realism or a player wanting a solid base platform for upgrades, the EMG / Cybergun Colt M4A1 MK16 URGI delivers authenticity first, without airsoft terminology or unsupported performance claims.

Cybergun-EMG Colt M4A1 MK16 URGI M-LOK AEG Gel Blaster Key Features:

  • Fully licensed Colt M4A1 replica with official trademarks
  • Licensed and produced by E&C under license from EMG in partnership with Cybergun
  • AEG (Automatic Electric Gel Blaster) operation
  • MK16-style M-LOK handguard for authentic URGI appearance
  • M-LOK mounting system for compatible tactical accessories
  • M4-pattern platform with broad gel blaster compatibility
  • High-detail external finish focused on realism and branding accuracy
  • Designed specifically for Gel Blaster use – not an Airsoft reworked product.

Cybergun-EMG Colt M4A1 MK16 URGI M-LOK AEG Gel Blaster Specs:

  • Product Type: AEG Gel Blaster Rifle
  • Model: Colt MK16 URGI M4A1
  • Replica Type: Fully Licensed Colt M4A1
  • Licensing: Official Colt trademarks via EMG & Cybergun
  • Operation: Electric (AEG Gel Blaster)
  • Handguard: MK16-style M-LOK
  • Mosfet: pre-installed MOSFET
  • MagPrime: Yes. Engages on battery connection or on inserting a new mag.
  • Platform: M4-pattern Gel Blaster
  • Use Case: Gel Blaster skirmish & replica collection
  • Length:  725 mm (Stock Retracted) to 806 mm (Stock Extended)
  • Weight: 2487 g (actual product weight)
  • FPS:  320 (Average) Using AKA/Tenacity Ultra Hard Gel Balls

Designed for serious skirmish and competition use, this adaptor delivers improved consistency, extended shot count, and faster reloads compared to traditional green gas magazines.

Manufactured from CNC aluminium and left in a raw silver finish with a clear anodised coating, this adaptor maintains a clean, industrial appearance while benefiting from added corrosion resistance and surface protection. Depending on the pistol brand and internal tolerances, minor modification (shortening) of the magazine’s central bolt may be required to achieve correct fitment. products.description:
GW Notus Black HPA Adaptor for GBB Gel Balster Pistols

The GW Notus Black HPA Adaptor is a high-performance conversion solution for Gel Blaster players looking to run their GBB pistols on a High Pressure Air (HPA) system with large-capacity M4-style magazines. Designed for competitive skirmishing and high-volume gameplay, this adaptor significantly increases consistency, shot count, and reload efficiency compared to standard gas magazines.

This versatile adaptor system supports both G-Series GBB pistols and Hi-Capa-style pistols, using your existing pistol magazines rather than relying on proprietary mags. The kit includes two interchangeable magazine-to-hose adaptors, allowing one configuration for G-Series magazines and the other for Hi-Capa magazines, making it ideal for players who run multiple pistol platforms. A quick top-end rebuild of the Notus adaptor would be necessary to swap between Hi-Capa and G-Series, and vice versa.

Finished in a durable black coating, the GW Notus adaptor is built for reliability under sustained HPA pressure. Depending on the pistol brand and internal tolerances, minor modification (shortening) of the magazine’s central bolt may be required to achieve optimal fitment. Once installed, the system allows seamless feeding from standard M4 HPA magazines, delivering extended playtime and consistent performance throughout long skirmish sessions.

Designed with function in mind, the M4 Mag battery is easily accessible via the magnetic battery hatch on the sidew of the Nptus housing.

Bring the cutting edge of modern rifle design into your loadout with the WM Tan CERAKOTE SIG MCX Spear LT GBBR Kit. This premium gas blowback rifle kit is modelled after the renowned SIG MCX Spear LT platform, offering authentic styling, robust polymer and metal construction, and a highly realistic operation thanks to the gas powerered blowback system.

Delivered in two separate boxes, this is a self-assembly kit, giving experienced players the satisfaction of assembling their blaster, which gives invaluable understanding of the product, how it fits together and more important, how to strip it doen for essential lubrication etc. Once assembled, the SIG MCX Spear LT system provides crisp recoil, responsive trigger action, and consistent power — creating one of the most immersive gel blaster experiences available. Engineered for realism and durability, the MCX Spear LT pairs a lightweight profile with heavy-duty internals: a Stainless Steel Bolt Carrier Group, steel trigger box, adjustable hop-up inner barrel. products.description:
WM CNC GBBR Gel Blaster MWS Magazine – Lightweight CNC Aluminium Upgrade

The WM CNC GBBR MWS Magazine represents a major step forward in magazine design for MWS-platform gas blowback rifle gel blasters. Built around a fully CNC-machined aluminium internal core, this is the first WM MWS magazine to feature a precision-engineered internal structure, delivering improved gas efficiency, smoother gel feeding, and significantly reduced overall weight. Designed as a direct upgrade to earlier WM MWS magazine generations, it is ideal for players seeking higher performance and better handling on the skirmish field.

Thanks to its optimised internal gas and liquid distribution system, the CNC WM MWS Magazine delivers approximately 30% improved vaporisation efficiency, helping maintain more consistent cycling and shot performance. The one-piece CNC-machined gel loading track reduces friction, enhances durability, and ensures reliable feeding during high-rate, high-cycle gameplay. Combined with its dramatically lighter construction, this magazine improves balance, reduces fatigue, and supports longer, more comfortable play sessions.

Choose the WM GBBR Gel Blaster Magazine MK3.0 for an unparalleled combination of precision, reliability, and cutting-edge design, to get the most from your WM (MWS) Range of GBBR Gel Blasters

WM CNC GBBR Gel Blaster MWS Magazine Features:

  • Fully CNC-machined aluminium internal core
  • First CNC internal design for the WM MWS platform
  • Approximately 30% improvement in gas vaporisation efficiency
  • One-piece CNC gel loading track for smoother feeding
  • Reduced internal friction for enhanced reliability
  • Dramatic weight reduction compared to previous WM MWS magazines
  • Improved handling balance and reduced player fatigue
  • Optimised internal structure for easier disassembly and maintenance
  • Designed for fast servicing and straightforward cleaning
  • Direct upgrade replacement for previous WM MWS magazine generations

WM CNC GBBR Gel Blaster MWS Magazine Tech Specs:

  • Platform Compatibility: WM MWS-style GBBR Gel Blasters
  • Construction: CNC-machined aluminium inner core (T6061 Aluminium)
  • Magazine Type: Gas Blowback Rifle (GBBR)
  • Empty Weight (Previous Generation):  558 g
  • Empty Weight (CNC Version): 348 g
  • Weight Reduction compared to MK 3 Mag: 210 g
  • Function: The powerhouse behind your WM GBBR Assault Rifle
  • Upgrade Type:
    • Performance
    • Weight-reduction
    • Sturdier CNC Inner Core

We are proud to release the new WM CNC MWS Magazine because it delivers meaningful, real-world improvements over earlier designs — lighter weight, better gas efficiency, smoother feeding, and easier maintenance — all without compromising durability or reliability.

products.description:
MPX/MCX Tan Picatinny Stock Mounting Adaptor

The MPX / MCX Picatinny Stock Mounting Adaptor in Tan is designed for Gel Blaster platforms that use a rear-mounted Picatinny rail, including SIG MCX and SIG MPX style rifles. This adaptor converts the rear Picatinny interface into a stock-ready mounting point, allowing users to fit a broader range of compatible stocks while retaining proper alignment and a secure lock-up.

Finished in a high-quality anodised bronze coating, labelled as TAN, this adaptor adds both durability and visual appeal to MCX and MPX-style builds. It is ideal for players seeking a colour-matched setup, replacing factory components, or creating a premium custom loadout while maintaining a clean, low-profile rear profile.

MPX/MCX Tan Picatinny Stock Mounting Adaptor Features:

  • Designed for SIG MCX and SIG MPX style Gel Blasters
  • Fits rear-mounted Picatinny rail stock interfaces
  • Converts Picatinny rear section to accept compatible stocks
  • Anodised bronze finish, known as TAN
  • Durable construction for long-term reliability
  • Low-profile design for clean rear-end aesthetics
  • Ideal for repairs, replacements, or custom MCX / MPX builds

MPX/MCX Tan Picatinny Stock Mounting Adaptor Tech Specs:

  • Product Type: Stock Adapter
  • Compatibility: SIG MCX / SIG MPX style Gel Blasters
  • Mounting Interface: Rear Picatinny rail
  • Conversion Style: Allows for the mounting of a standard buffer tube, which opens up multiple options for the buttstock to fit your blaster.
  • Material: Metal (Aluminium)
  • Finish/Colour: Anodised bronze (TAN)
  • Use: Stock mounting and platform conversion
This Tan MPX / MCX stock mounting adaptor combines secure fitment with a premium anodised finish, making it an excellent choice for builders wanting both function and refined aesthetics. A functional and visually striking upgrade, this Tan MPX / MCX adaptor delivers secure stock fitment while elevating the look of your custom build.

COMPATIBILITY:

Picatinny rail

products.short_description:

products.description:
UDL Tan SIG M17 Semi-Auto Electric Gel Blaster Pistol

The UDL SIG P320 (M17) Semi-Auto Electric Gel Blaster Pistol, a truly exceptional electric blowback Gel Blaster Pistol! Great performance and look straight out of the box.

Unlock the power of precision and versatility with this Tan varaint of the UDL SIG M17 Semi-Auto Electric Gel Blaster Pistol. This gel blaster pistol is not your ordinary sidearm; it’s a game-changer that brings excitement and innovation to your tactical adventures, and improved accuracy courtesy of the integrated hop-up on the inner barrel.

UDL Tan SIG M17 Semi-Auto Electric Gel Blaster Pistol Key Features:

  1. Electric Firepower: The UDL SIG P320 (M17) Semi-Auto boasts great performance with its electric slide cycling mechanism and spring powered Gel Firing, ensuring rapid and consistent firing and improved accuracy, courtesy of the integrated inner barrel hop-up. Say goodbye to manual cocking and hello to lightning-fast shooting! (Can also be used in manual cocking mode, if no battery is installed in the magazine)
  2. Three-direction Integrated Hop-up: The Tan version of the UDL SIG P320 (M17) Semi-Auto Electric Gel Blaster Pistol, comes with an integrated inner barrel hop-up feature. Allowing for fine tuning of the Blaster’s accuracy. The system in the UDL P320 in quite impressive, giving 3 individual position of adjustment for the hop-up tongue, with grub screws at the 12, 2 and 10 o’clock position on the inner barrel.
  3. Gel Ball Compatibility: Equipped with a standard Gel Ball barrel, this blaster pistol fires safe, ec0-friendly, gel balls, providing a thrilling and safe gaming experience. Experience the excitement of realistic shooting without the risk.
  4. Realistic Design: The UDL SIG M17 Semi-Auto boasts a very realistic design, making it a true collector’s item. It replicates the iconic SigSauer P320, also known by it’s military designation as the M17. Providing an authentic feel and appearance for enthusiasts and collectors.
  5. Durable Construction: Crafted from high-quality nylon polymer materials, this blaster pistol is built to withstand the rigors of intense gameplay. It’s both sturdy and reliable, ensuring longevity and hours of fun.
  6. Adjustable Accessories: Customize your blaster to fit your unique playing style with the under-barrel picatinny tactical rail. Attach laser sights, torches, or any Picatinny style accessory to “Pimp” your blaster.
  7. Easy Operation: Thanks to its user-friendly design, this gel blaster pistol is suitable for all players. The ergonomic grip ensures a comfortable and secure hold during gameplay.

Discover the Tan UDL SIG P320 (M17) Semi-Auto Electric Gel Blaster Pistol’s impressive power and adaptability. Whether you’re battling opponents in close quarters or taking precise long-range shots, this pistol has got you covered.

Experience the thrill of gel blasting like never before and the added bonus of a laser conversion for unbeatable versatility. The UDL SIG P320 (M17) Semi-Auto Electric Gel Blaster Pistol is your gateway to hours of fun and excitement.

UDL Tan SIG M17 Semi-Auto Electric Gel Blaster Pistol Key Specs:

  • FPS: Averaging around 200 fps out of the box.
  • Ammo Capacity: Approximately 20 Gels
  • Range: Approx. 20 meters
  • Inclusions: Integral inner barrel hop-up, with 3 angles of adjustment.
  • Weight: 603g (including Mag and Battery)

UDL Tan SIG M17 Semi-Auto Electric Gel Blaster Pistol Pack contains:

  • 1 x UDL Tan SIG M17 Semi-Auto Electric Gel Blaster Pistoll with integral Hop-up System
  • UDL Tan SIG M17 Semi-Auto Electric Gel Blaster Pistol Magazine/battery pack
  • 1 x 7.4v battery
  • 1 x USB Charger

We recommend the the Dragon Orbz Extreme Ultra Hard Gels, as the best performing Gel, to use with this blaster. Please note, Gels are not supplied with this Blaster.

Click the image to add some Dragon Orbz to your order.

Also Available in Tan

UDL SIG M17 Tan

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable lockable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

products.description:
X-Force Bulk-Pack Milky White Gel Balls

Stock up and skirmish longer with X-Force Bulk-Pack Milky White Gel Balls — consistent, high-absorbency gel ammo designed for all-round performance and reliable feeding in AEG, spring and gas gel blaster platforms. Manufactured from superabsorbent polymer (primarily sodium polyacrylate), each bead hydrates to a uniform spherical shape with a predictable flight profile and excellent feed reliability. The Milky White colour improves visibility for gauging their flight when fired while still offering good impact performance for CQB and outdoor play.

Perfect for field operators, events and retail bundles, these bulk packs are offered in 500g pack, giving you plenty of gels in one batch. The beads hydrate quickly (approximately 4hrs) and maintain roundness and tensile strenght during use — ideal for players who want dependable, fuss-free ammo that’s simple to store and prepare. Supplied in an air-tight, resealable pouch, you can choose between growing small batches, or throw the lot in, if you’ve got a long event or filed hire to consider.

X-Force Bulk-Pack Milky White Gel Balls Features:

  • Premium bulk-pack gel ammo — great value for teams, clubs, indoor and outdoor field operators and retailers.
  • Milky White beads for easy visibility durting play.
  • Made from superabsorbent polymer (primarily sodium polyacrylate) — high water retention.
  • Consistent sphericity and size for reliable magazine feeding and accuracy.
  • Quick hydration: absorb water to recommended size with simple soak procedure, for roughly 4 hours, or until you have achieved the desired size, for size specific controlled grow.
  • Suitable for AEG, spring and gas gel blasters.
  • Resealable 500g Pouch, for bulk buy cost benefits.
  • Store dry in cool conditions — long shelf life when unhydrated.
  • X-Force Bulk-Pack Milky White Gel Balls are a harden gel used with most gel blasters that run the 7-8 mm gels.

X-Force Bulk-Pack Milky White Gel Balls specs:

  • Brand / Manufacturer: X-Force (X-Force Tactical)
  • Product: Bulk-Pack Milky White Gel Balls (GelSoft Ammo)
  • Material: Superabsorbent polymer (SAP) — primarily sodium polyacrylate (cross-linked polymer)
  • Hydrated bead diameter (typical): ~7–8 mm (can vary slightly by soak time and water temp)
  • Dry form: compressed bead / crystal (hydrates into soft sphere)
  • Pack sizes: 500g
  • Recommended soak: Approx. 4 hours (shorter times can be used for controlled grows)
  • Recommended use: CQB, outdoor skirmish, target practice, events, field operatots and retail resale
  • Storage (unhydrated): cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture, in the resealable zip lock pouch
  • Storage (hydrated): Store in large, airtight containers, such as soda bottle or large milk containers.
  • Safety: non-toxic when used as directed; keep out of reach of children & pets; avoid ingestion and eye contact. Always wear eye protection when firing Gels

 

 

Do Not Freeze and/or add washing liquid or any other lubricant to the water as this can damage your gel blaster.

products.description:
TG HK G36C AEG CQB Assault Rifle Gel Blaster – Best Value Entry-Level Rifle

The HK G36C AEG CQB Assault Rifle Gel Blaster from TG (TianGong) is a compact, high-fun CQB-ready replica build of the classic Heckler & Koch G36C (“C” for Compact), suitable for skirmish play and collectors who value authentic ergonomics. Internationally, in the real-world, the HK G36C is used by tier one operators, such as Genmany’s GSG-9 and Frances’ G.I.G.N. and R.A.I.D.

Compact and manoeuvrable, the G36C silhouette reproduces the HK aesthetic while offering practical gel-blaster features: an AEG nylon gearbox with metal gears for reliable semi/auto operation, a folding butt stock for tight environments, and a magazine-priming system activated using the charging handle for rapid, intuitive reload prep on the field.

Designed for close-quarters battles and backyard target practice alike, the TG G36C balances realistic handling with user-friendly maintenance. Picatinny accessory compatibility offer great accessory mounting options, the unit has a robust polymer receiver, and an easy-to-service gearbox, making it a great choice for players who want a durable, easily upgradeable platform. Whether you’re starting out or rounding out your roster of CQB kit, the TG HK G36C AEG CQB Assault Rifle Gel Blaster delivers reliable performance and that signature HK look.

TG HK G36C AEG CQB Assault Rifle Gel Blaster Features:

  • TG (TianGong) G36C replica profile for authentic handling and appearance.
  • Nylon AEG gearbox: with Metal gears, give reliable semi- and full-auto firing modes.
  • Magazine priming via the charging handle — fast, intuitive mag-prep without fiddly tools.
  • Folding butt stock for compact storage and superior CQB manoeuvrability.
  • Durable polymer receiver with metal-reinforced mounting points for upgrades.
  • Mag Coupling: Out of the box, these magazines are desigend to couple together. So if you get extra mags, the click together, to give you lighterning fast reloads.
  • Tool-free quick-access forward battery compartment tray for fast battery swaps.
  • Picatinny compatible top rail and handguard mounting options for optics and accessories.
  • Ergonomic HK-style pistol grip .
  • Compatible with the OEM TG G36-style spare magazines.
  • Inner Barrel: Metal inner barrels, with a basic rubber tounge hop-up.
  • Ideal platform for hop-ups, inner-barrel upgrades, and AEG performance tuning.

TG HK G36C AEG CQB Assault Rifle Gel Blaster Specs:

  • Manufacturer: TG (TianGong)
  • Model: HK G36C AEG CQB Assault Rifle (TG)
  • Power Type: Electric AEG (battery powered)
  • Performance: 280 to 290 FPS
  • ROF: Approx 9 rps with the standard 7.4 battery. Metal gear will support the use of 11.1v battery, which ups the ROF to approx 16 rps.
  • Magazine Type: TG G36-style AEG magazine
  • Magazine Priming: Charging handle activated mag prime (magazine primed by cocking/charging handle)
  • Stock: Folding butt stock (folds to the side for compact carry/storage)
  • Material: Polymer receiver with metal internal components, metal gears, inner barrel and flash hider
  • Rails: Top Picatinny rail; handguard mounting (M-LOK/Picatinny dependent on variant)
  • Dimensions: 76 cm full length (53 cms with buttstock folded down)
  • Weight: Medium-weight (depends on fitted battery & accessories)
  • Firing Modes: Semi-Auto / Full-Auto (AEG gearbox)
  • Battery: Supplied with common 7.4V Li-Po rechargeable battery
  • Blowback: Yes: The blaster has simulated electic (gear driven) blowback, with the bolt and charging handle cylcing as the blaster fires.
  • Chargin Handle: Ambidextrous operation, plus it cycles with the blaster, so watch your fingers lol!
  • Recommended Use: CQB, skirmish play, target practice, collection display

Please note: The fire select switch only opeartes on the left side of the receiver (as viewed from above) the right side switch is just decorative.

TG HK G36C AEG CQB Assault Rifle Included in the box:

  • 1 x TG HK G36C AEG CQB Assault Rifle
  • 1 xTG HK G36C AEG Magazinne
  • 1 x 7.4v rechargeable battery with XT30 style plug

products.description:
SPECTRE M4 PDW SMG Gel Blaster — Compact PDW-Style Gel-Ball SMG (Sub Machine Gun)

The SPECTRE M4 PDW SMG Gel Blaster brings compact, PDW-style firepower to your kit with an aggressive modern profile and user-focused ergonomics. Built for CQB and close-quarters gameplay, this gel-blaster replica typically features a short barrel, integrated foregrip area (battery Compartment) and a smooth feeding double stack style magazine system. Lightweight yet robust, the SPECTRE M4 is ideal as a primary SMG for tight CQB play or as a fast, manoeuvrable secondary for urban scenarios.

Designed for players who prioritise handling and speed, the SPECTRE M4 offers responsive trigger feel, reliable feeding and easy battery/magazine access — making it a popular choice for club nights and backyard skirmishes alike. With upgrade potential for hop-up, inner barrel and gearbox components, it’s a versatile base for performance tuning or cosmetic customisation to match your style on the field.

Brief Real-World History

The real Spectre M4 is an Italian submachine gun designed in the 1980s by Roberto Teppa and Claudio Gritti and produced by SITES (later by Greco Sport). It is a compact, high-rate-of-fire SMG known for its distinctive casket (four-column) magazines and top-folding stock. Production in Italy ran through the 1980s and 1990s, with small runs continuing into the early 2000s; the weapon was used in several regional conflicts and sold in both military and civilian (semi-automatic) variants.
