Please note: This product contains timber (wood) as part of it’s design. Timber, being a natural product, does not always provide a 100% smooth and consistent finish and may have irregularities dues to grain direction, knot imperfections and general “softness” of timber. products.description:

Step back into the Wild West with modern performance — the GE 1887 Winchester Shell-Ejecting Green Gas Shotgun Gel Blaster (Black) combines vintage lever-action styling with contemporary green gas power and reliable shell-ejecting mechanics. Gassing the blaster is achieved via the fill valve, which is tucked away on the underside of the loading lever, see images above. Yep, it took us a while to find it too LOL.

Key Features:

products.description:
Wosport Bison BK Lightweight Tactical Belt – Black

This system includes an inner belt lined with the loop (soft) side of hook-and-loop fastener, which threads through your trouser belt loops and remains in place. The outer tactical belt, featuring the hook (rough) side, attaches directly to the inner belt and fastens with a one hand quick release buckle system, that and holds all your gear—holsters, pouches, mag carriers, and more. When it’s time to remove your loadout, simply peel off the outer belt—your trousers stay secure with the inner belt still in place.

Perfect for Gel blasting. tactical games, airsoft, law enforcement training, or tactical field use, this belt delivers high-performance utility in a sleek, low-profile Operator Black finish.

Wosport Bison BK Lightweight Tactical Belt – Black Features:

  • Dual-Belt System: Inner belt stays on; outer belt detaches with gear for quick setup or removal
  • Hook & Loop Interface: Strong, reliable connection for zero belt shift during activity
  • Operator Black: Door Breacher Black, for seamless integration with modern SWAT or GIGN loadouts
  • Lightweight & Low-Profile: Designed for comfort and mobility during extended missions or skirmishes
  • Adjustable Fit: Fits most waist sizes with reinforced stitching for durability

Perfect for gel blaster skirmishes, airsoft, and real-world tactical use, the Wosport Bison BK Lightweight Tactical Belt – Black delivers unbeatable convenience without compromising tactical capability, and rapid-access convenience, making it a must-have TacToy and a truly dependable choice for serious operators. products.description:
Wosport U94 Tactical PTT unit for Gen 5 Headset – Black

Enhance your tactical communication setup with the Wosport U94 Tactical PTT Unit, specifically designed for use with our Wosport Gen 5 headsets. This rugged Push-To-Talk unit replicates the real-world U94/A/U military-style interface, offering reliable in-field communication with ergonomic functionality and authentic design.

Built with a NATO-standard U-174/U (TP-120) input connector, the U94 PTT securely interfaces with the Wosport Gen 5 headset, plus the following headsets Z-Tactical, Earmor, and Sordin-style models. On the radio side, it features a Kenwood 2-pin plug, compatible with popular transceivers such as the Baofeng UV-5R, Kenwood TK series, and many other two-way radios using the Kenwood standard plug.

The unit is finished in matte black with a reinforced clip backing, allowing easy mounting to MOLLE gear, chest rigs, or plate carriers for easy coms and fast access in high-pressure scenarios.

Wosport U94 Tactical PTT unit for Gen 5 Headset Features:

  • Compatible with Gen 5 Tactical Headsets using U-174/U (TP-120) connectors
  • Kenwood 2-Pin Plug: Works with Baofeng UV-5R, Kenwood TK-series, and similar radios
  • Military-Style U94 PTT Design: Realistic look and feel with rugged build quality
  • Tactile PTT Push-to-Talk Button: Responsive activation, even when wearing gloves
  • MOLLE-Compatible Clip: Secure mounting for vests, rigs, or belts

Whether you’re on the skirmish field or simulating real-world operations, the Wosport U94 Tactical PTT unit for Gen 5 Headset delivers dependable performance and seamless communication.

The WE Tech MEU M1911-A1 SOC GBB Gel Blaster Pistol in Brushed Silver is a high-performance sidearm inspired by the real-world US Marine Corps MEU(SOC) M1911-A1. Built for tactical reliability and enhanced handling in wet conditions, this gas blowback gel blaster combines classic military styling with modern upgrades, delivering field-ready performance and refined aesthetics.

Unlike standard 1911 replicas, the MEU (Marine Expeditionary Unit) variant includes combat-proven enhancements such as an extended beavertail grip safety  and a reinforced metal guide rod. These features improve control, responsiveness, and reliability under pressure — exactly what you’d expect from a sidearm modelled after a Special Operations Capable weapon.

Finished in an elegant brushed silver, this full-metal pistol features a textured grip, tactical sights, and is left plain, with no markings. Whether you’re running a Milsim loadout or need a dependable gel blaster sidearm, the WE MEU M1911-A1 SOC delivers authentic function with a premium finish.

We Tech MEU M1911-A1 SOC GBB Gel Blaster Pistol – Brushed Silver Features:

  • MEU (SOC) inspired 1911 GBB gel blaster pistol
  • Brushed silver full-metal slide and frame for realism and durability
  • Green gas-powered with realistic blowback recoil

The Colt M1911 from WE is full metal, a semi-auto replica of one of the most iconic pistol in the world.
Outside construction was made almost entirely from metal – only polymer parts are grip panels. Moving slide and strong gas blowback system gives the user a very realistic experience.
On the inside, WE provided quality parts that ensure long time usage and precision of each shot.

The M1911, also known as the Colt 1911, or the Colt Government, is a single-action, semi-automatic, magazine-fed, recoil-operated pistol chambered for the .45 ACP cartridge. It served as the standard-issue sidearm for the United States Armed Forces from 1911 to 1985. It was widely used in World War I, World War II, the Korean War, and the Vietnam War.

Designed by John Browning, the M1911 is the best-known of his designs to use the short recoil principle in its basic design. The pistol was widely copied, and this operating system rose to become the preeminent type of the 20th century and of nearly all modern centrefire pistols.

Gear up for unmatched realism and close-quarters firepower with the Golden Eagle GEL8878 Gas Powered Tactical Shotgun Gel Blaster. Built for gel ballers who demand performance and authenticity, this pump-action tri-shot shotgun is powered by green gas and delivers incredible stopping power with every pull of the trigger.

Each shot blasts a pre-selected quantity of gels, simultaneously, simulating the spread of a real shotgun. You can go from Triple Shot load (usually fires between 1 to 3 gels per pump) to Six-shot gel spread (usually fires between 4 to 6 gels per pump). The full-metal receiver, tactical handguard, and shell-fed magazine system create an ultra-immersive experience on the field. Whether you’re breaching corners or dominating tight arenas, the GEL8878 is your go-to CQB companion.

This shotgun replica is powered by Green Gas and made almost entirely of metal. Metal parts include: the barrel, the receiver, the buffer tube or the top RIS rail. Polymer parts include the pistol grip, the stock, the fore-end, flip-up iron sights and other small elements.
On the side of the replica, there is a special mount for six shells (Please note this is decorative only, the shotty does not use shells).

The top RIS rail features flip-up iron sights and enables the attachment of a wide variety of optical sights, such as red dot sights or similar.
Both sides of the replica feature QD tactical sling swivels. The replica uses an adjustable AR15-standard stock.

GEL8878 Gas Powered Tactical Shotgun Gel Blaster by Golden Eagle Key Features:

  • Full Metal Body – Tough alloy receiver and barrel for realistic weight and feel
  • Design: Gas-powered pump-action shotgun based on the TM (Tokyo Marui) System
  • Tactical Buttstock – Fully adjustable buttstock, mounted on a very tactical-looking buffer tube.

XYL ZP-5 357 Golden Edition Snub-Nosed Gel Blaster Revolver

Type: Manual Revolver Gel Blaster  (Also shoots small foam “Nerf” style darts)

Material: Metal and plastic

Uses: 7 – 8 mm gel ammo
products.description:
XYL ZP-5 357 Golden Edition Snub-Nosed Gel Blaster Revolver – Collector’s Presentation Set

Step into the world of Gel Blaster collecting with the XYL ZP-5 357 Golden Edition Gel Blaster Revolver—a refined, fully featured revolver set designed for collectors, enthusiasts, and skirmishers alike. Presented in a deluxe collector’s case, this limited-edition blaster combines functional versatility with eye-catching design.

The ZP-5 model keeps things compact and tactical with dual interchangeable snub-nose barrels—one crafted from chrome-coloured nylon and the other from chrome-finished metal. These barrels deliver a sleek, aggressive look while maintaining the revolver’s signature compact profile. Also included are two timber-look nylon pistol grips, giving you the option of a warm teak finish or a rich walnut tone, adding a premium aesthetic to this already impressive sidearm.

Function meets flexibility, as the ZP-5 357 is capable of firing both water Gel Balls and micro Nerf-style foam darts, making it ideal for casual plinking, close-quarters skirmishes, or display in any collection.

XYL Python 357 Golden Edition Gel Blaster Revolver Includes:

  • XYL ZP-5 357 Revolver – Short Barrel
  • 1 Chrome Finished interchangeable metal snub nosed barrel.
  • 6 nylon shells (dull colour)
  • 6 metal shells (Shiny metallic colour)
  • 12 Micro Nerf Style Foam darts
  • Speed loader with 2 shell holders for rapid reloads
  • Tactical holster for secure sidearm carry
  • Cleaning cloth
  • Allen key screwdriver to easily swap barrels or grips
  • XYL Brand Sticker

XYL ZP-5 357 Operation and performance:

The XYL ZP-5 357 is a single action style revolver. This mean that the hammer needs to be cocked, for each shot. Pulling the trigger without cocking the hammer first, will only rotate the barrel, and will not cock the hammer. So the revolver will only fire when the hammer has been cocked, before pulling the trigger. The black cylinder release catch, does not function as a safety, even though the “S” is engraved on the side of the body. This is only for looks, to replicate what a real revolver would look like, but there is no functioning safety for this toy.

  • Range: Approximately 10m (with the foam darts)
  • FPS: Approximately 80 to 90 FPS. (This item is very much about the look and feel of the product, but is definitely not a high performance piece. Ideal for Cosplay and other such activities)

Want to have extra time, between reloads? Then, why not add either extra OEM Nylon Shells or the Upgrade Metal Shells to you order.

Click the image above, to add some of the “Upgrade” Metal XYL Shells to your order.

A great choice for assisting with loading the Gels into the Shells, is one of our Pistol speed loaders

Click the image above to add a Pistol Gel Ball speed loader to your order.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

Step back in time and become a battlefield legend with the HT WW2 Thompson M1A1 Gel Blaster — a faithful, 1:1 scale replica of the iconic “Tommy Gun” used in WWII and immortalised in mobster lore and the movies. Ideal for the Gel Soft player that want the authentic look, without the hefty price tag that a full metal with real wood item would carry.

Built from lightweight and durable ABS plastic, the Thompson M1A1 features classic design elements including the wood-style handguard, pistol grip and buttstock.  With it’s oversized drum magazine — Gel Capacity is at a premium, ensuring you stay on  the field longer, between reloads.. The modern twists, include an LED display adds a  showing real-time battery voltage so you’re never caught off guard during battle, plus a modern MOE style tactical Foregrip and an imitation Plastic Eotech Sight..

Powered by a rechargeable 7.4v battery driving the electric gearbox gives a firing rate of 7–8 rounds per second and an effective range of up to 10 to 15 metres, it’s as capable as it is cool.

Breaking with historical precision, this Tommy Gun is outfitted with both top and bottom 20mm Picatinny rail sections, you can easily customise your loadout with optics, lights, or other tactical accessories. Ideal for backyard battles, WWII cosplay, or display purposes, the HT M1A1 Thompson blends old-school aesthetics with fast-paced gel blaster action.

The Thompson submachine gun is an American submachine gun first invented by John T. Thompson in 1918 during World War I and became infamous during the Prohibition era, being a signature weapon of various organized crime syndicates in the United States. It was a common sight in the media of the time, being used by both law enforcement officers and criminals.  The Thompson submachine gun was also known informally as the “Tommy Gun”, “Street Sweeper”, “Annihilator”, “Chicago Typewriter”, “Trench Broom”, “Chicago Submachine”, “Chicago Piano”, “Chicago Style”, “Chicago Organ Grinder”, “Drum Gun”, “the Chopper”, “the Tommy Boy” or simply “the Thompson”. This iconic submachine gun, was heavily utilised in WWII and saw action both in Europe and the U.S. conflict with the Japanese Imperial army.

HT WW2 Thompson M1A1 Gel blaster Key Features:

  • Authentic 1:1 scale replica of the WWII-era Thompson M1A1
  • Fully automatic electric-powered firing system
  • Iconic design with finned handguard, drum mag, and fixed stock
  • Real-time LED battery voltage display
  • Top & bottom 20mm Picatinny rail sections for attachments
  • Lightweight and Durable ABS polymer construction
  • Fires 7–8mm gel balls
  • High-capacity 200-round drum magazine
  • Compact, balanced design perfect for close-quarters skirmishes
  • Length: 82cm
  • Weight: 1.05kg

HT WW2 Thompson M1A1 Gel blaster specs:

  • Brand: HT
  • Material: ABS plastic
  • Fire Modes: Full-auto
  • Magazine Capacity: 200 gel balls
  • Ammo Type: 7–8mm gel balls
  • Colour: Black and imitation timber

What’s in the box:

  • 1x M1A1 Thompson Gel Blaster.
  • 1x drum magazine.
  • 1x imitation holographic sight. (Does have an LED basic reticle)
  • 1x 7.4v rechargeable lipo battery.
  • 1x usb charger.
  • 1x safety glasses.
  • 1x foregrip.
  • 1x pack of gel balls. NOTE: Please note, gels included with blasters are generally of low quality and can often cause feeding issues, we highly recommend you purchase our high quality harden gels for the best performance.

Relive history — one gel ball at a time. Whether you’re storming a backyard trench or just after a really inexpensive cosplay prop, then the HT WW2 Thompson M1A1 Gel Blaster delivers heritage-inspired pew-pews with modern reliability.

 

Special note: The fire select switches are for show only, that Gel Blaster has 2 modes, off and full auto. This is controlled by the “Fire/Safe” switch above the rear of the pistol grip. Similarly, the controls on the Eotech Sight are imitation, it only has a push button On/Off operation.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Whether you’re a collector, enthusiast, or just love mechanical realism, this is a must-have piece.

KELe Luger P08 Shell Ejecting Laser Pistol Specs:

  • Action: Manual Shell Ejecting

WADSN Tan TGD QD Long Shrapnel Foregrip

The WADSN Tan TGD QD Long Shrapnel Foregrip – MP01007-DE is a TangoDown BGV-QD-style vertical grip for compatible 20mm Picatinny rails. It features a quick-detach lever mount, full-length polymer grip and useful internal storage compartment.

Type: Long Quick release Shrapnel grip for Gel blaster
Colour: Tan
Material: Nylon Polymer
Product Weight: 104g
products.description:
WADSN Tan TGD QD Long Shrapnel Foregrip

The WADSN Tan TGD QD Long Shrapnel Foregrip gives Gel Blaster users a full-length vertical grip for rifles equipped with a standard 20mm Picatinny or Weaver-style accessory rail. WADSN lists this model as the TGD QD Long Vertical Grip, while the Tan version carries manufacturer part number MP01007-DE.

WADSN closely follows the well-known TangoDown BGV-QD series of vertical foregrips with this distinctive design. In this product family, TGD commonly refers to the TangoDown-style design, while QD stands for Quick Detach. WADSN produces this grip as an aftermarket reproduction rather than a genuine TangoDown product.

The side-mounted quick-detach lever provides one of the grip’s most useful features. Its layout follows the locking throw-lever concept used on genuine TangoDown BGV-QD grips. As a result, users can quickly attach or remove the foregrip from a compatible rail without repeatedly reaching for screws or Allen keys.

The long vertical body offers plenty of gripping area for a traditional full-hand hold. Alternatively, users can position their hand higher on the grip and use it as a hand index or control point. The textured polymer body also improves purchase while keeping the overall construction practical and lightweight.

A removable lower cap opens the internal storage compartment inside the grip. Users can store small accessories or suitably sized spare batteries in this compartment where dimensions allow. This storage feature also reflects one of the recognisable design elements found across the original TangoDown BGV-series foregrips.

The Tan / Dark Earth finish suits Gel Blaster builds that use tan, FDE, desert or mixed black-and-tan furniture. Consequently, the grip pairs particularly well with M4, AR-style, HK416-style and many other Gel Blaster platforms that feature a compatible lower Picatinny rail.

WADSN TGD QD Long Shrapnel Foregrip Key Features:

  • WADSN TGD QD Long Vertical Grip
  • Manufacturer part number MP01007-DE
  • Tan / Dark Earth colour
  • Full-length vertical foregrip design
  • Based on the TangoDown BGV-QD-style foregrip
  • Quick-detach locking lever mounting system
  • Designed for 20mm Picatinny / Weaver-style rails
  • Polymer grip body with metal QD mounting components
  • Removable side panel for PEQ box/Torch remote triggers
  • Approximate overall length of 125mm
  • Textured surface for improved grip
  • Large gripping area for traditional vertical hand placement
  • Can also be used as a hand indexing or control point
  • Removable bottom cap
  • Internal storage compartment for suitable small items or batteries
  • Tool-free attachment and removal once correctly adjusted
  • Suitable for a wide variety of compatible Gel Blaster rifles
  • Aftermarket reproduction; not manufactured by TangoDown

Tech specs of the WADSN TGD QD Long Shrapnel Foregrip

  • Brand: WADSN
  • Product: TGD QD Long Vertical Grip / Long Shrapnel Foregrip
  • Part Number: MP01007-DE
  • Colour: Tan / Dark Earth
  • Product Type: Vertical foregrip
  • Design Reference: TangoDown BGV-QD series
  • Mount: Quick-detach Picatinny / Weaver-style rail mount
  • Rail Compatibility: Standard 20mm Picatinny / Weaver-style rails
  • Construction: Polymer grip body with metal mounting components
  • Approximate Length: 125mm
  • Grip Configuration: Full-length / long vertical
  • Storage: Internal compartment accessed through removable lower cap
  • Application: Gel Blaster rifles and compatible recreational replicas with appropriate rail systems

Boost your control, speed, and accuracy with the WADSN Tan TGD QD Long Shrapnel Foregrip — built for operators who demand performance and reliability.

What Does TGD QD Mean?

For search and identification purposes:

TGD: Common abbreviation used on reproduction products to indicate a TangoDown-style design. (also sometimes known as the “TD QD”

QD: Quick Detach, referring to the lever-operated mounting system.

Therefore, searches for terms such as TGD grip, TD QD grip, TangoDown style grip, TangoDown BGV-QD grip, QD vertical foregrip, long vertical grip and shrapnel foregrip may all refer to this general style of accessory.

Compatibility

The WADSN TGD QD Long Foregrip is intended for Gel Blasters fitted with a compatible 20mm Picatinny or Weaver-style lower rail.

Typical applications can include:

  • M4-style Gel Blasters
  • AR-style Gel Blasters
  • HK416-style Gel Blasters
  • M16-style platforms
  • SCAR-style Gel Blasters
  • Kriss Vector-style Gel Blasters with suitable rail space
  • Other rifles fitted with a compatible 20mm Picatinny rail

It does not mount directly to bare M-LOK or KeyMod slots. An appropriate Picatinny rail section will normally be required first.

The WADSN MP01007-DE TGD QD Long Vertical Grip is a Tan quick-detach vertical foregrip for Gel Blaster rifles using 20mm Picatinny or Weaver-style rails. Its design is based on the TangoDown BGV-QD family of vertical foregrips and includes a long polymer grip body, quick-release lever mounting system and internal storage compartment.

It is particularly suitable for users wanting a TangoDown-style long vertical foregrip without purchasing a genuine TangoDown component. The Tan finish also complements FDE, desert and two-tone Gel Blaster builds.

Please note: This is a fully functional replica toy item and is intended for us on Gel Blasters and other such toys. It is not designed for, nor rated for, use with real firearms.

WADSN N-Style Laser Aiming Device – Red & Green Lasers (WD06059-DE)

Enhance your tactical setup with the WADSN N-Style Laser Aiming Device (WD06059-DE) – a compact and reliable PEQ-style laser module engineered for precision. Designed for airsoft and training applications, this unit delivers dual-laser capability with both red and green laser emitters, offering quick visual alignment across varying lighting conditions.

Control is streamlined through a single push-button interface that cycles through three phases: Red Laser, Green Laser, and Off – allowing fast transitions in the field.

At the rear of the device, a rotary dial offers adjustable brightness, letting users fine-tune the laser intensity for optimal visibility and battery conservation. Whether you’re zeroing in during low light or marking targets in daylight, this device offers simple, effective laser functionality with no unnecessary extras.

WADSN N-Style Laser Aiming Device Key Features:

  • Dual-laser system: Red and Green laser emitters
  • No torch/flashlight capability – laser-only output
  • Single-button operation: Red → Green → Off
  • Rear dial to adjust laser brightness
  • Durable PEQ-style design ideal for airsoft or training use
  • 4 rotary adjustment controls to adjust elevation and windage independently for each of the laser colour variants.
  • 1 Dummy knob, that simulates the look of the control knob, that would select between visible laser light, Infra Red laser and white light on a Real PEQ box. Note: This switch has no function and is only decorative.

Upgrade your gear with focused functionality – the WADSN N-Style Laser Aiming Device delivers laser precision without the bulk.

Designed for serious enthusiasts and collectors, this premium gas blowback rifle features an authentic Daniel Defense Mk18-style handguard, providing enhanced modularity and a battle-ready aesthetic. Powered by 12kg green gas, this blaster delivers a consistent velocity of 320 FPS, even during extended rapid-fire sessions. The advanced MWS System enhances safety, durability, and compatibility with TM parts, having been tested to withstand over 10,000 stress cycles.

A precision-crafted POM nozzle optimises gas flow, while a functional forward assist adds an extra layer of realism, making this one of the most immersive gel blaster experiences available.

    • Constructed entirely of durable steel for exceptional wear resistance.
    • Allows customization of hammer power and trigger travel for enhanced precision and gameplay adaptability.
  2. High Performance Steel Bolt
    Our latest bolt design is compatible with the previous version’s box lock-back structure. When used with the adjustable trigger box, the bolt achieves full travel. The bolt’s rear has been weighted for enhanced recoil feedback, delivering a more immersive experience.

    • Innovative weighted design enhances recoil feedback for a lifelike shooting experience.
    • Fully compatible with the adjustable trigger box for optimized performance.
    • Full-travel bolt for authentic operation — locks securely at the rear for realistic bolt-hold behavior.
  3. MWS System Technology
    • Ensures superior safety, durability, and compatibility with TM parts.
    • Tested rigorously to withstand over 10,000 stress cycles, guaranteeing long-lasting reliability.
  4. CNC Precision Crafting
    • CNC-machined steel internal components, including the steel bolt and trigger box, ensure unmatched material quality.
    • Stainless steel inner barrel with adjustable hop-up delivers customizable gel ball trajectory and precision.
  5. Realistic Design & Performance
    • Anodized aluminium receiver and solid build replicate the authentic look and feel of its real-steel counterpart.
    • Functional forward assist adds a touch of realism to your tactical setup.
    • Powered by 12kg green gas, it achieves a consistent velocity of 320 FPS with minimal cooldown, even during rapid fire.

Why Choose the WM Colt M4 with DD Mk18 Handguard MWS GBBR Gel Blaster?

Whether you’re a serious skirmisher or a collector, this premium GBBR Gel Blaster offers industry-leading build quality, advanced functionality, and an ultra-realistic experience. Featuring a battle-proven design, high-performance internals, and a durable DD Mk18-style handguard, this rifle is a must-have for any enthusiast.

Experience the Next Level of Gel Blasting – Order Yours Today!

Please note, this beautiful blaster is supplied without sights, so you have the freedom to choose from, Iron Sights, Red Dot Sights or Sniper Scopes.

WM Colt M4 with DD MK18 Handguard MWS GBBR Gel Blaster Key Features:

  • CNC Machined Aluminium Receiver
  • CNC Machined Steel Receiver Parts
  • Steel Bolt Carrier Group
  • CNC Machined Steel Trigger Box Parts
    • Heavy-duty construction: steel components
    • Adjustable trigger system: an adjustable trigger pull for more custom feel and adjustable hammer power
    • Full-travel bolt for authentic operation — locks securely at the rear for realistic bolt-hold behavior.
  • CNC Machined Aluminium Charging Handle
  • CNC Machined Aluminium Daniel Defense 9.5 inch MK18 Style Handguard
  • CNC Machined Aluminium Outer Barrel
  • Built-in Adjustable Hopup Inner Barrel
  • CNC Machined Aluminium Gas Block
  • CNC Machined Aluminium Buffer Tube
  • Lightweight Aluminium Buffer + Steel Weight
  • POM Enhanced Nozzle
  • 1.2 Recoil Spring
  • QPQ Treatment for All Steel Parts

Authentic G17 Gen4 Design

products.description:
Large M18 Smoke Spring Loaded Gel Grenade – Green

Take your gel ball skirmishes to the next level with the M18 Smoke Grenade Spring Loaded Gel Grenade – Green. Designed for dynamic gameplay, this spring-loaded grenade is perfect for clearing rooms, ambushing opponents, or adding a tactical edge to your strategy. Nicknamed the Lemon, by US troops in the Korean war, this is the successor to the MK2 Pineapple grenade, which is often wrongly called the M26A2.

Large M18 Smoke Spring Loaded Gel Grenade – Green Features:

  • Spring-Loaded Action: The M18 is equipped with a powerful spring mechanism that activates upon impact with a hard surface. (For best results, throw the grenade so that it lands on it’s side. They don’t always activate, if it hits the ground base first)
  • 360° Gel Ball Dispersal: Once triggered, the grenade’s three internal paddles fling gel balls in all directions, creating a wide blast radius to catch opponents off guard.
  • Durable Construction: Built to withstand repeated use, this grenade is tough enough for the most intense gel ball battles.
  • Realistic Design: Modelled after the classic large M18 sprung grenade, its authentic Green and white finish adds authenticity to your tactical loadout.
  • Easy to Use: Simple to arm and deploy, making it an essential tool for both experienced players and beginners.

Level up your gel ball game with the Large 13cm M18 Smoke Grenade Spring Loaded Gel Grenade – Green. Perfect for tactical diversions or making a statement on the battlefield, it’s a game-changer you don’t want to miss. Order now and dominate every skirmish!

This grenade requires Gel Ball ammo for the full affect. Click here to see our range of Gel Ammo.

To reset the grenade, takes a little practice. Fold down the 3 sprung paddles, that fling the gels out. Then hold closed the side opening doors, whilst wiggling the trigger balls then lifting it slightly, to lock the doors in place, re-arming the grenade. Fill the grenade with gels, from the screw fit bottom plug, on the base of the grenade.

 

Obvious first disclaimer. This is a Gel Ball device, and doesn’t have a “Smoke” function. It is just designed to look like the real world M18 Smoke Grenade.

Please be cautious when using this toy. If thrown overarm, like you see in the films, there is the possibility of hitting a member of your opposing team on the head. THIS WILL HURT. We suggest an underarm throw, to ensure a low trajectory, and impact with the ground.

products.description:
“KL. DUCK” Version of the M18 Smoke Grenade Spring Loaded Gel Grenade – Yellow

Take your gel ball skirmishes to the next level with the “KL. DUCK” Version of the M18 Smoke Grenade Spring Loaded Gel Grenade – Yellow. Designed for dynamic gameplay, this spring-loaded grenade is perfect for clearing rooms, ambushing opponents, or adding a tactical edge to your strategy. Nicknamed the Lemon, by US troops in the Korean war, this is the successor to the MK2 Pineapple grenade, which is often wrongly called the M26A2.

“KL. DUCK” Version M18 Smoke Grenade Spring Loaded Gel Grenade – Yellow Features:

  • Spring-Loaded Action: The M18 is equipped with a powerful spring mechanism that activates upon impact with a hard surface. (For best results, throw the grenade so that it lands on it’s side. They don’t always activate, if it hits the ground base first)
  • 360° Gel Ball Dispersal: Once triggered, the grenade’s three internal paddles fling gel balls in all directions, creating a wide blast radius to catch opponents off guard.
  • Durable Construction: Built to withstand repeated use, this grenade is tough enough for the most intense gel ball battles.
  • Realistic Design: Modelled after the classic M18 sprung grenade, its sleek green and white finish adds authenticity to your tactical loadout.
  • Easy to Use: Simple to arm and deploy, making it an essential tool for both experienced players and beginners.

Level up your gel ball game with the “KL. DUCK” Version M18 Smoke Grenade Spring Loaded Gel Grenade – Yellow. Perfect for tactical diversions or making a statement on the battlefield, it’s a game-changer you don’t want to miss. Order now and dominate every skirmish!

This grenade requires Gel Ball ammo for the full affect. Click here to see our range of Gel Ammo.

To reset the grenade, takes a little practice. Fold down the 3 sprung paddles, that fling the gels out. Then hold closed the side opening doors, whilst wiggling the trigger balls then lifting it slightly, to lock the doors in place, re-arming the grenade. Fill the grenade with gels, from the screw fit bottom plug, on the base of the grenade.

Please note, the use of the Green Version images, is simply to illustrate the trigger ball device, and how to se-set it. The items supplied, will be Yellow with the Duck motif, as pictured.

Obvious first disclaimer. This is a Gel Ball device, and doesn’t have a “Smoke” function. It is just designed to look like the real world M18 Smoke Grenade.

Please be cautious when using this toy. If thrown overarm, like you see in the films, there is the possibility of hitting a member of your opposing team on the head. THIS WILL HURT. We suggest an underarm throw, to ensure a low trajectory, and impact with the ground.

products.description:
M18 Smoke Grenade Spring Loaded Gel Grenade – Green

Take your gel ball skirmishes to the next level with the M18 Smoke Grenade Spring Loaded Gel Grenade – Green. Designed for dynamic gameplay, this spring-loaded grenade is perfect for clearing rooms, ambushing opponents, or adding a tactical edge to your strategy. Nicknamed the Lemon, by US troops in the Korean war, this is the successor to the MK2 Pineapple grenade, which is often wrongly called the M26A2.

M18 Smoke Grenade Spring Loaded Gel Grenade – Green Features:

  • Spring-Loaded Action: The M18 is equipped with a powerful spring mechanism that activates upon impact with a hard surface. (For best results, throw the grenade so that it lands on it’s side. They don’t always activate, if it hits the ground base first)
  • 360° Gel Ball Dispersal: Once triggered, the grenade’s three internal paddles fling gel balls in all directions, creating a wide blast radius to catch opponents off guard.
  • Durable Construction: Built to withstand repeated use, this grenade is tough enough for the most intense gel ball battles.
  • Realistic Design: Modelled after the classic M18 sprung grenade, its sleek green and white finish adds authenticity to your tactical loadout.
  • Easy to Use: Simple to arm and deploy, making it an essential tool for both experienced players and beginners.

Level up your gel ball game with the M18 Smoke Grenade Spring Loaded Gel Grenade – Green. Perfect for tactical diversions or making a statement on the battlefield, it’s a game-changer you don’t want to miss. Order now and dominate every skirmish!

This grenade requires Gel Ball ammo for the full affect. Click here to see our range of Gel Ammo.

To reset the grenade, takes a little practice. Fold down the 3 sprung paddles, that fling the gels out. Then hold closed the side opening doors, whilst wiggling the trigger balls then lifting it slightly, to lock the doors in place, re-arming the grenade. Fill the grenade with gels, from the screw fit bottom plug, on the base of the grenade.

 

Obvious first disclaimer. This is a Gel Ball device, and doesn’t have a “Smoke” function. It is just designed to look like the real world M18 Smoke Grenade.

Please be cautious when using this toy. If thrown overarm, like you see in the films, there is the possibility of hitting a member of your opposing team on the head. THIS WILL HURT. We suggest an underarm throw, to ensure a low trajectory, and impact with the ground.

products.description:
M26A1 Gel Ball Fragmentation Grenade – Green

Take your gel ball skirmishes to the next level with the M26A1 Gel Ball Fragmentation Grenade – Green. Designed for dynamic gameplay, this spring-loaded grenade is perfect for clearing rooms, ambushing opponents, or adding a tactical edge to your strategy. Nicknamed the Lemon, by US troops in the Korean war, this is the successor to the MK2 Pineapple grenade, which is often wrongly called the M26A2.

M26A1 Gel Ball Fragmentation Grenade – Green Key Features:

  • Spring-Loaded Action: The M26A1 is equipped with a powerful spring mechanism that activates upon impact with a hard surface.
  • 360° Gel Ball Dispersal: Once triggered, the grenade’s three internal paddles fling gel balls in all directions, creating a wide blast radius to catch opponents off guard.
  • Durable Construction: Built to withstand repeated use, this grenade is tough enough for the most intense gel ball battles.
  • Realistic Design: Modelled after the classic M26A1 fragmentation grenade, its sleek black finish adds authenticity to your tactical loadout.
  • Easy to Use: Simple to arm and deploy, making it an essential tool for both experienced players and beginners.

Level up your gel ball game with the M26A1 Gel Ball Fragmentation Grenade. Perfect for tactical diversions or making a statement on the battlefield, it’s a game-changer you don’t want to miss. Order now and dominate every skirmish!

This grenade requires Gel Ball ammo for the full affect. Click here to see our range of Gel Ammo.

Please be cautious when using this toy. If thrown overarm, like you see in the films, there is the possibility of hitting a member of your opposing team on the head. THIS WILL HURT. We suggest an underarm throw, to ensure a low trajectory, and impact with the ground.

Please note: This product contains timber (wood) as part of it’s design. Timber, being a natural product, does not always provide a 100% smooth and consistent finish and may have irregularities dues to grain direction, knot imperfections and general “softness” of timber, which makes it prone to marking easily. Also, in our harsh Australian climate, products containing timber should be stored out of direct sunlight, away from extremes in temperature fluctuations and protected from excessive exposure to humidity.

Care should be taken to keep timber in it’s best condition, timber needs to be maintained and “fed” using suitable timber oils, without any colourant of pigment, we suggest using Abbey Gun Solutions – Stock Finish. Click image below to add to your order.

products.name: Universal Drop Leg Gel Blaster Pistol Holster – LH Black
products.short_description:
Type: Left Handed Universal Drop leg holster for gel blaster pistols

Specifications:

Colour: Black
Material: 1000D Oxford Cordura Cloth
Product Size: 42*9*20cm
Product Weight: 324g
products.description:
The Universal Drop Leg Gel Blaster Pistol Holster – LH Black is designed for left-handed users, providing a customizable and secure fit for medium to full-sized gel blaster pistols, with or without rail-mounted accessories such as lights. This holster uses a wraparound thigh adjustable design, ensuring your pistol remains secure while allowing for a tailored fit to your specific firearm configuration.

Universal Drop Leg Gel Blaster Pistol Holster Key Features:

  • Premium Material: Crafted from 1000D Cordura Nylon, offering superior durability and long-lasting performance, perfect for tactical environments.
  • Adjustable Leg Straps: Equipped with two Cordura leg straps that minimize holster rotation while ensuring a firm hold on the thigh. The straps feature a heavy-duty Squeeze Release Camping style buckle for adjustability to provide the perfect fit.
  • Quick-Release Vertical Hanger Strap: The vertical hanger is made from 2” heavy-duty Cordura webbing with a Squeeze-release buckle, allowing rapid attachment or removal without needing to adjust your duty belt. It includes adjustable hook-and-loop for perfect length adjustments.
  • Adjustable Thumb Break Snap: This feature provides enhanced pistol retention while allowing for quick access during fast-paced gameplay.
  • Integrated Magazine Pouch: Conveniently placed on the holster spine, this single magazine pouch allows for easy access and secure storage with an adjustable strap.
  • Complete size adjustability: The overlapping hook and loop secured panels allow for the holster to be adjusted to fit most sizes of Gel Blaster Pistols, from Revolvers up to large Hi-Capa models, like Desert Eagles.

For versatile tactical use, the holster can be modified and configured for MOLLE attachments, allowing for alternative vest mounting without the need for leg straps. The Universal Drop Leg Gel Blaster Pistol Holster – LH Black is an excellent choice for left-handed gel blaster enthusiasts looking for a high-performance, adjustable holster that combines durability, comfort, and functionality.

products.description:
Introducing the Scylla by Jefftron – V2 optical Mosfet Electronic Trigger Unit

A cutting-edge performance upgrade for your Gel Blaster or AEG, designed to enhance trigger responsiveness, firing modes, and overall reliability. This state-of-the-art unit is packed with advanced features and provides seamless control through the Leviathan & Scylla app.

The Scylla – V2 optical is one of the most advanced ETU (electronic trigger unit) on the market

It combines optical and magnetic sensors for better handling and durability

Built-in wireless communication for quick setup using iOS or Android smartphones!

An adapter with magnet, is attached on the trigger, so you can adjust its sensitivity conveniently from the app

The Scylla offers everything you would expect from a processor unit:

  • Binary trigger
  • Burst fire
  • Trigger sensitivity
  • Rate of fire reduction
  • Piston pre-cocking
  • Li-Po alarm
  • statistics and much more

Real time response for any change in the settings – immediately feel the results

Easy to instal into the gearbox (fully integrated inside the gearbox instead of the original trigger contacts)

New functions are for free for every user via online update

The Scylla – V2 provides everything that’s important for your blaster!

Scylla by Jefftron – V2 optical Mosfet Electronic Trigger Unit Key Features:

  • Adjustable Trigger Sensitivity: Fine-tune trigger response using the magnet adapter, which can be easily used on standard V2 triggers or Jefftron-specific triggers.
  • Customizable Fire Modes: Configure and assign fire modes to your firing switch, including:
    • SAFE: No response to trigger pulls.
    • Semi: Single shot per trigger pull.
    • Binary Trigger: One shot on pull, another on release.
    • Burst: Fires a burst with each pull.
    • Burst/Full-Auto: Short press for burst, long press for full-auto.
    • Full-Auto: Continuous fire until trigger release.
  • Rate of Fire Reduction: Adjust your RoF between 40%-100% via the app, ideal for optimizing performance or diagnosing issues.
  • Active Brake System: Solve double-burst issues with weak springs by braking the motor after each shot, fully adjustable in the app from 0-100%.
  • Piston Pre-cocking: Enhance trigger response by pre-cocking the piston in semi mode, adjustable up to 80% for ultra-quick shots.
  • Electronic Fuse Protection: Built-in protection against short circuits ensures the safety of your device.
  • Li-Po Battery Alarm: Automatically detects and alerts you when battery voltage is low, preserving the longevity of your gear.
  • Advanced Stats: Access real-time data such as RoF, shot count, cycle time, motor temperature, and battery voltage to optimize performance.
  • Compatible with Brushless Motors: Easily integrate with brushless motors such as Warhead, with full app support.

Built to Last:

The Scylla V2 is protected against water damage with a durable lacquer coating. Installation is a breeze, with support for a mechanical trigger stop (optional).

Included in the Package:

  • Scylla V2 electronic module with wiring to stock and T-plug connector
  • Magnet adapter for standard trigger
  • Securing screw, wire holders, and stickers
  • Dog Tag keychain
  • Online manual for easy setup

The Scylla by Jefftron takes your gameplay to the next level, offering precise control and unmatched reliability in the heat of battle. Perfect for Gel Blaster enthusiasts and Airsoft players looking to elevate their tactical experience.

products.description:
SHS Gearbox Shim Kit

SHS Gearbox Skim Kit, which comes in the following sizes and quantities.

  • 5 qty of 0.1mm shims
  • 5 qty of 0.2mm shims
  • 5 qty of 0.3mm shims
  • 5 qty of 0.5mm shims

Unlock Peak Performance with Precision Gearbox Shimming

Are you tired of that annoying whining noise coming from your gearbox when you fire your airsoft gun? Or perhaps you’ve noticed premature wear on your gearbox components, increased stress on the motor, a sluggish rate of fire, and poor battery life? The solution to these common issues lies in the art of gearbox shimming.

What is Gearbox Shimming?

Gearbox shimming is a crucial practice in the world of Gelsoft, where small spacers, known as shims, are used to meticulously align the gears within your gearbox. The primary objective is to ensure that these gears function seamlessly, providing you with optimal performance and a quiet, efficient operation.

Why is Proper Shimming Vital?

Proper shimming achieves two main goals:

  1. Maximizing Tooth Contact: By spacing the gears correctly, we aim to maximize the contact between the teeth on each gear. This reduces wear and tear on your components while ensuring a smooth gear rotation.
  2. Minimizing Unwanted Movement: We also strive to minimize lateral movement within the gearbox. Excessive movement can lead to gears binding with each other or the gearbox casing, causing performance issues.

The Impact on Performance

Even if you have the finest quality gearbox components, your Gelsoft gun can feel lacklustre, excessively noisy and sluggish if not properly shimmed. Proper shimming is the secret sauce that transforms a mediocre setup into a high-performing, smooth running powerhouse.

In essence, gearbox shimming is not just a ‘nice to have’ – it’s an essential step towards achieving a well-running gearbox.

Ready to elevate your airsoft game? Don’t underestimate the power of precision shimming. Contact us today to experience the difference it can make in your airsoft adventures!

 

Note: Shimming your gearbox is a practice that requires a decent working knowledge of how your Gel Blaster’s gearbox runs. If you are unsure, please ask our friendly techs, who will happily carry out the shimming for you (labour charges will apply).

products.short_description:

Colour: Black
products.description:
Introducing the AZTECH Hellfire 3D Polymer Hop Up

The AZTECH Hellfire 3D Polymer Hop Up is designed to elevate both the performance and appearance of your gel blaster. With its aggressive muzzle brake styling and cutting-edge features, this hop-up enhances accuracy, range, and control during gameplay.

Building on the proven Muzzletek technology, the Hellfire hop-up offers unparalleled inner barrel stabilisation and precise 180° hop-up adjustment. This tool-less adjustment feature allows you to fine-tune hop settings effortlessly by rotating the front housing, giving you control over shot trajectory with ease.

The Hellfire side ports effectively disperse gases and vapour, replicating the look and function of a real muzzle brake. Designed for universal fitment, it supports 14mm counter-clockwise threaded gel blaster rifle barrels and accommodates inner barrels up to 12mm longer than the outer barrel.

AZTECH Hellfire 3D Polymer Hop Up Key Features:

  • Aggressive muzzle brake design for enhanced aesthetics and performance
  • Advanced 180° tool-less hop-up adjustment for precision shooting
  • Inner barrel stabilisation for improved accuracy and consistency
  • Compatible with 14mm CCW threaded gel blaster barrels
  • Polymer tough construction for durability in the heat of battle
  • Ideal for M4 and AK variants, extending range and accuracy
  • Transform your gel blaster’s performance with the AZTECH Hellfire 3D Polymer Hop Up, the perfect blend of style and functionality.

(Please note the 12mm, any more than 12mm and the inner barrel will make contact with the inner tongue of the hop unit and will either break the inner or push it out of its seat, we would recommend 10mm or 11mm maximum OR don’t turn the hellfire all the way onto your outer barrel to ensure it doesn’t make contact.)

AZTECH Hellfire 3D Polymer Hop Up Fitment Instructions:

  • Thread the Hellfire in a reverse direct until threaded all the way on(maximum of 12mm) making sure to be careful that the inner barrel doesn’t make contact with the rear of the internal tongue. If it does make contact, unwind the hop until it has clearance.
  • It more than likely will not have perfect rotation alignment to set the hop ramp at 12 o’clock
  • Rotate to set the alignment correctly then use the side grub screws to hold the Hellfire firmly in the correct position
  • To adjust the hop up, Turn the slotted end cap to lower the hop ramp, the cap rotates just 90 degrees offering 8 settings
  • If a permanent fixture we would recommend using a low strength Loctite to hold the side grub screws in place and if you wish a small amount on the main thread from hop to out barrel.

Designed, made and hand assembled in Australia!

Thread of main hop up: M14 CCW

Adjustment: Tool-less, rotate the front face for adjustment

Fitment: 1.5mm Allen key for the 2x side locating grub screws.

To replace the inner assembly of the adjustable tongue, remove the front adjuster cap, ensure to use substantial amount of heat to release the Loctite holding the stainless grub screw for the adjuster cap. If you don’t you may strip the 1.5mm Allen head grub screw. If you strip the stainless steel grub screw then there is a high chance of ruining the outer to get it out.

products.short_description:

Material: plastic/electrics
Voltage: 11.1 v battery
Discharge Connection: Mini Tamiya Connector Plug
products.description:
Bosli-po Arena Version 11.1 v Mini Taniya Battery Features:

  • High discharge lithium polymer battery
  • International universal 4P charging port
  • Surface: PVC; wear-resistant, anti-oxidation, high temperature
  • Standard voltage: 11.1v

Package Includes:

  • 1 x Battery

Please Note: 

11.1v Batteries cannot be charged with the 7.4v USB charger supplied with Gel Blasters.

A separate charger is required to charge 11v batteries. We advise the B3 Battery Charger as it charges each cell independently.

When charging batteries, we recommend charging them between 1-3 hours.

To preserve battery and maintain a long battery life please ensure your battery is charged regularly. Running the battery completely flat shortens it’s life span. The more complete discharge cycles the shorter the life span.

Bosli-po Arena Version 11.1 v Mini Taniya Battery Specifications:

  • Brand: BosLi-Po
  • Item type: Li-po battery
  • Capacity: 1300mAh
  • Continuous Discharge Rate: 25C
  • Voltage: 11.1V
  • Charge: 4 pin balance connector
  • Discharge Connector: Mini Tamiya female
  • Working temperature: 0-40 ℃
  • Battery Size: 13.6 * 2 * 1.6cm
  • Battery Weight: 91g

 

Things you might also consider, that you will need with your battery:

The ideal charger for this battery is, the Bosli-po Super Balance Charger (Click image to add to your order).

Bosli-Po Charger

We also Strongly recommend charging your batteries in our fire retardant safety bag (Click image to add to your order).

Li-PO Safety Bag

Its budget-friendly price point means families can enjoy hours of entertainment without breaking the bank. products.description:
Here at X-Force we love bringing you gel blasters that are a little out of the ordinary and the MP40 is definitely in that category. For WWII imitation item collectors, this is a must have Gel Blaster.

With that said the MP40 submachine gun was one of the most iconic World War 2 guns of all time.

The MP 40 (Maschinenpistole 40) is a submachine gun chambered for the 9×19mm Parabellum cartridge. It was developed in Nazi Germany and used extensively by the Axis powers during World War II.

Designed in 1938 by Heinrich Vollmer with inspiration from its predecessor the MP 38, it was heavily used by infantrymen (particularly platoon and squad leaders), and by paratroopers, on the Eastern and Western Fronts as well as armoured fighting vehicle crews. Its advanced and modern features made it a favourite among soldiers and popular in countries from various parts of the world after the war. It was often called “Schmeisser” by the Allies, after Hugo Schmeisser, who designed the MP 18, although he was not involved in the design or production of the MP40. The weapon’s other variants included the MP 40/I and the MP 41. From 1940 to 1945, an estimated 1.1 million were produced by Erma Werke.

This Gel Blaster replica pays very exacting homage to the iconic WWII real steel item. The AEG powered gearbox, and spring fed magazine (just like the ones in GBB Pistols) provide a finished product that runs as good as it looks.

  • Model: MP007B
  • Released: July 2022
  • Operation: Electric Automatic
  • Battery Type: 8.4V (Mini Tamiya Plug)
  • Battery type: NiMH
  • Metal Barrel Assembly

  • Metal Under-Fold Folding Stock

  • Metal Sights
  • 1:1 Scale, one of the best choices for MP40 / WWII collectors
  • Firing Modes: Semi-Automatic, w/ Safety
  • Gearbox: Full Metal / Upgradable
  • Motor: High Torque.
  • Battery: 8.4v Small Butterfly Type(Battery & Charger Included),  Compatible with 7.4v and 11.1V LiPo batteries(recommended)
  • Hop-Up: Not included. Instructions in the manual on hop-up are not for this product.
  • Sample gel balls
  • Stick Magazine Capacity: Approx. 50 Gel Balls
  • Colour: Black
  • Attention. Muzzle thread is a  CLOCKWISE thread, this means that it will not fit the aftermarket gel ball suppressors and flash hiders that are available, as they are all Counter Clockwise Threads.

Performance:

  • Variable FPS for different gels used, we recommend using Black label or aka gels

products.description:
SW Aliens M41A Pulse Rifle AEG Gel Blaster – Battle Worn SW-11B

“I wanna introduce you to a personal friend of mine. This is an M41A Pulse Rifle. Ten millimetre, with over-and-under thirty millimetre pump action grenade launcher.” ―Cpl. Hicks, to Ripley (from predominantly Aliens 1986 and in cameo on Alien3 1992, used by the Weyland-Yutani commandos)

Meet the Snow Wolf M41A Pulse Rifle Gel Soft AEG. This weapon is a beautiful replica of the service rifle carried by the 22nd Century Colonial Marines in James Cameron’s iconic and Oscar winning big screen movies ‘Aliens and Aline3’. True to the screen model, this fabulous replica is based on a Metal Thompson AEG Gel Blaster, with Nylon Polymer Furniture and replica under-barrel launcher. The Digital countdown LED is fully functional, counting your shots down from 95 to zero, obviously this is a nice touch and purely a cosmetic feature. As the Gel Magazine will hold approximately 180-200 gels, depending on Gel Size.

Manufactured by Snow Wolf, a leading name in the airsoft world, this model is a high-quality conversion of their iconic airsoft blasters into exceptional gel blasters, exclusive to X-Force Tactical.

The ammo counter on the gun is an operational unit that works with 9V batteries. The ammo counter starts off at 95 rounds, and will reset when you change magazines. If you wish to not use this function, you could remove the battery or switch it off. The gun also features a mock under barrel pump shotgun, but it is just for aesthetics, this is the battery compartment where you can insert your battery to power the rifle.

SW Aliens M41A1 Pulse Rifle AEG Gel Blaster SW-11B Features:

  • Nylon Polymer / Metal Construction
  • Semi & Fully Automatic Shooting Mode
  • Full metal Magazine
  • Digital countdown LED display function for counting your shoots (LED counter starts from 95 to zero) [Requires a standard 9v Battery, not supplied, click here to add one to your order]
  • Metal Gears & Gearbox
  • Velocity: Approx. 300+ FPS, depending on Gels
  • Propulsion / Powered by: AEG
  • Gearbox version: V6 Gearbox
  • Type of fire: Single, Auto
  • Retractable Stock

  • Weight: 3735g

Built on a Snow Wolf Thompson AEG Rifle with working digital round counter display. A digital counter starts at 95 rounds and as the gun is supplied with a magazine that holds more than 95 rounds, the counter needs to be reset by removing the magazine and then re-inserting.

7 – 8 mm

products.short_description:
Type: Aug Steyer AEG Gel Blaster magazine
Brand: Snow Wolf
Material: Nylon Polymer Plastics and Metal
Uses: 7-8 mm gels
products.description:
Introducing the Snow Wolf Aug Steyr magazine. This item is a direct OEM product, which can be used as either a spare for more time on the field, or replacement, should you damage the magazine that came with you Snow Wolf Aug Steyer.

The magazine is designed to be predominantly fed by the sprung loaded feeding plates, which push the gels to the top of the mag, where the feeder wheel is the only item that runs off the battery power of the blaster. This innovative design, ensures that all the parts that are susceptible to water damage, namely the motor and electronic components are at the top of the magazine. Away from where water would collect and reduce the life of standard style AEG Mags, where the motor and electronics would be at the bottom of the mag.

This should increase the life of the magazine considerably, as compare to a standard type AEG Magazine, as the motor and electronic are kept high and dry.

Compatibility: The Snow Wolf Range of Aug Steyrs.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

products.description:
KELe HK VP9 SK Manual Springer Gel Blaster – Tan and Black

This is another of the highly anticipated HK offerings, the VP9 SK. The VP designation in the name refers to Volkspistole, which translates to “People’s Pistol”.

This beautifully weighted replica feels great in the hand. It’s weight gives it the sense of being something more than just a simple toy, but more of an authentic replica of the real People’s Pistol. The HK VP9 SK is constructed as a metal slide on a polymer lower, with a manual, spring providing the power source. This means the slide needs to be re-racked after each shot, and makes the firing configuration, technically single-shot. And, as a couple of our competitive staff often say, the look of amazement on the face of a player at a Gel Soft skirmish, who has spent thousands on an HPA super gun set up, that shoot 25+ gels per second, at over 300 fps, then you creep up on them and take them out with a single shot from a springer, is priceless. Well, there’s no feeling quiet like that!!!

The HK VP9 SK Blaster is designed to run on either Gel Soft Gel Balls (not included) or red-tipped foam micro nerf darts, and we found it performs best on Gels and feeds well on a wide variety of Gels.

KELe HK VP9 SK Manual Springer Gel Blaster – Tan and Black Features:

  • Model: KELe HK VP9 SK Manual Springer Gel Blaster
  • Type: Manual, Mechanical, Spring-Powered (Single shot, rack the slide for each reload)
  • Single-Shot Pull-Back Type.
  • 1:1 Ratio
  • Metal Slide and Polymer body
  • Spring-fed, single-stack, Magazine (when using Gels)
  • Micro darts should be loaded from the barrel end and each slide rack. Darts do not fit in the magazine.
  • Magazine Capacity: Approx. 9 to 10 Gel Balls (dependent on Gel brand and variance in grown size)
  • Uses 7-8mm Gel Balls (sold Separately) or Micro Nerf Darts (10 qty included)

KELe HK VP9 SK Manual Springer Gel Blaster – Tan and Black Performance:

  • Up to 130 Feet per Second (When using Gels)
  • Up to 15m Firing Distance
  • 1 Shot per Pull Back of the Slide, then to load the next gel the slide needs to be racked again.

Remember, one mag is never enough. Why not add a spare mag, or two, to your order. A spare mag, pretty much pays for itself, in saving on the freight.

Click image to add the correct spare mag, for your KELe HK VP9 SK Manual Springer.

 

What’s the thing everyone loses? Yep, the little foam darts. Why not add an extra 10-pack, or two, of foam darts while you’re here.

Get some Spare Darts, ya know you’ll lose some 🙂

Please note: We highly recommend purchasing our high quality Hardened Gel Balls for the best performance, like our Tenacity AKA’s

Grab some Gels, while you’re here. You don’t have to pick these up, like you do the darts.

A really  cool add-on, would be a pistol speed loader, takes all the fiddly-ness out of getting the gels into the Magazine.

Pistol Speed Loader, a definite timer saver. Click image to add to order.

Only load Gel Balls into the magazine, DO NOT try to load mini darts into the Magazine, this will damage the gun and magazine. Mini darts should be pushed into the barrel only, in from the front of the pistol muzzle.

Always read the instruction on the gel packaging, and soak the gels in clean cold water for the specified time. Do not attempt to use Gels, that have not been soaked and have grown to their operational diameter.

Type: Precision CNC Piston Head for AEG Gel Blasters

Colour: Gold
products.description:
Elevate Your Gelsoft Performance with the Accu-Port Piston Head by Aztech Innovations

Discover the revolutionary Accu-Port Piston Head from Aztech Innovations, meticulously engineered to transform your Gelsoft experience. This adjustable piston head is crafted to boost your Gelsoft blaster’s accuracy and reduce grouping spread, thanks to its advanced port adjustment technology.

Innovative Design for Precision and Customization

The Accu-Port Piston Head operates like a tuneable cylinder port, enabling pressure release for limitless adjustment levels. Achieve exceptional accuracy by fine-tuning the piston head to complement your barrel perfectly, ideal for correcting over volumed or improperly ported cylinders. Constructed from high-quality CNC 7075 Aluminium, this piston head ensures durability and top-tier performance.

Premium Features for Enhanced Performance

  • Thrust Bearing & Pre-fitted Silicone Rubber O-ring: Comes with a thrust bearing and a pre-fitted silicone rubber O-ring, along with an additional upgrade Viton O-ring for superior resilience and sealing.
  • Anodized Finish: The anodized finish not only adds aesthetic appeal but also provides enhanced corrosion resistance.
  • Customizable Design: Includes the option to add Angle of Engagement (AOE) spacers between the piston body and head, allowing for further customization. The slotted internal base facilitates easy piston assembly and installation.

Maximum FPS and Compatibility

Designed to maximize FPS and overall performance, the Accu-Port Piston Head stands out in the Aztech piston head line-up. It is compatible with Gelsoft V2 and V3 gearboxes. For optimal tuning and correct length in Aztech or APS gearboxes, we recommend pairing it with the Aztech Spring Retainer, ensuring it does not intrude more than 40mm.

Easy Adjustment and Maintenance

  • Adjustment Tool: Use a long 3mm Allen key to adjust the Accu-Port.
  • Initial Setup: The port is adjusted to the closed/off position, blocking any air passage.
  • Fine-Tuning: Releasing the Allen key allows air tuning, with optimal performance typically within 3-5 full turns from the off position.
  • Secure Setting: Once tuned, apply low-strength Loctite to the adjuster thread to prevent self-adjustment during firing.

Weight: 16g packed.

Elevate your Gelsoft game with the Accu-Port Piston Head from Aztech Innovations, where precision engineering meets unmatched performance.

 

Please note, the piston body is not included, and the colour may vary from the pictured item.

products.short_description:

Type: Spring Powered Manual Revolver Gel Blaster
Material: All Nylon

products.description:
The Colt Single Action Army (also known as the SAA, Model P, Peacemaker, or M1873) is a single-action revolver handgun. It was designed for the U.S. government service revolver trials of 1872 by Colt’s Patent Firearms Manufacturing Company (today known as Colt’s Manufacturing Company) and was adopted as the standard-issued pistol of the U.S. Army from 1873 until 1892.

Its overall appearance has remained consistent since 1873. Colt has cancelled its production twice, but brought it back due to popular demand. The revolver was dubbed the “Peacemaker”, and is a famous piece of Americana and the American Wild West era, due to its popularity with ranchers, lawmen, and outlaws alike. Today, they are mainly bought as memorabilia by collectors and re-enactors. Its design has influenced the production of numerous other models from other companies.

The KELe range of spring manual pistols are next level in quality and these are no exception.  A full nylon and nylon built will definitely please both the bargain hunters and collectors alike.  These shoot gels or small foam darts from the imitation bullets, so you can really get into the spirit of gun slinging and target shooting. The The KELe Nylon Colt 1873 Peacemaker Manual Revolver pistols are a single action trigger, meaning the hammer has to be cocked back, for each shot.

KELe Colt Peacemaker Manual Revolver Features:

  • Full Nylon body
  • Realistic Single Action Revolver
  • Spring Powered
  • Smooth Cylinder Cycling
  • Antique Black Finish
IN THE BOX
  • 1 x KELe Nylon Colt SAA Peacemaker Manual Blaster –  Black
  • 6 x Shells
  • 10 x soft darts

Items you need to make the blaster work (that are NOT included).

Also, the foam darts are the first thing you’ll lose, trust us. Why not add some spare to your order and save in the freight.

Get some Spare Darts, ya know you’ll lose some :)

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

The Universal G-Series plate will fit most G-Series Gel blasters. The key feature to look for on the original sight is that it is held in a trapezoidal channel across the rear of the slide. Which is secured in place with a single bolt that screws up from the underside of the slide, into the bottom of the rear sight.

Sight mounting bolt, on the underside of the slide.

The Universal Plate Fitted to one of our E&G SAI G34’s

The G-Series Universal Red Dot Sight Mounting Plate itself, gives you multiple mounting options, and is compatible with many of the most common sight “footprints”, that you will find on your Red Dot sight, these include:-

  • Trijicon “RMR” Footprint
  • Docter/Noblex Footprint
  • C-More Footprint
  • Aimpoint Acro Footprint

So, if you want to put a red dot on your G-Series Gel Blaster, then this accessory is a must have.

products.name: GW Brushless 33K 480 Long Shaft 11.1v AEG Gel Blaster Motor
products.short_description:
Colour: Slate Blue and Black
Material: 7075 Aluminium high quality casing and rare earth Magnetics
RPM: 33,000 @ 11.1v
products.description:
GreyWolf Brushless 39,000 480 Long Shaft 11.1v AEG Gel Blaster Motor

Upgrade your gel blaster with the GreyWolf Brushless 33,000 480 Long Shaft 11.1v AEG Gel Blaster Motor for unmatched performance and reliability. Featuring a state-of-the-art brushless motor, this upgrade delivers increased efficiency, higher torque-to-weight ratios, and exceptional power input. The integrated MOSFET unit offers unparalleled control and extremely fast reaction times, ensuring your gel blaster operates at peak performance. With a direct plug-in installation, you can easily enhance your gear without the need for modifications or additional wiring.

Please Note: Installation of an upgraded motor is a technical process and should be conducted by an experienced Gel Blaster Technician. Also, with this upgrade, the gear box should ideally have a full re-build and potentially requires upgraded components to ensure that the gears, bearings, shims and all components are capable of handling the increase in power and overall RPMs. Every gearbox adjustment, must include a re-shim to ensure smooth operation and reduce the risk of damage.

The GreyWolf Brushless Motor is equipped with advanced protective features, including voltage protection below 5.5V and above 13.5V, battery low voltage protection for 2CELL (below 6V) and 3CELL (below 9V), and temperature protection up to 100 degrees Celsius. Stall protection ensures the motor’s longevity, even if gear damage or other issues arise. Enjoy a quieter, more efficient operation with reduced mechanical noise and near-elimination of electromagnetic interference (EMI). The brushless design also eliminates ionizing sparks from the commutator, providing a longer lifespan and reducing maintenance requirements. Upgrade today for a more reliable and powerful gel blaster experience!

GW Brushless 33K 480 Long Shaft 11.1v AEG Gel Blaster Motor Features:

  • Wide speed regulation: adjustable range 21000~33000RPM11.1VDC
  • Small no-load loss:33000RPM, no-load current ≤2.8A (2.4A); 26000RPM, no load current ≤1.8A (1.4A)
  • 21000RPM≤1.8A (1.4A)
  • 7075 Aluminium high quality casing
  • Total custom in-runner design with maximum power and torque
  • High temperature resistant quality copper windings
  • High quality Nd-Fe-B magnets
  • Moderate Speed.
  • High Torque.
  • Internal ESC with over amp draw and low voltage cut off to protect the motor and battery.
  • High Precision CNC design
  • High quality D-cut removable pinion gear for easy switch outs

RPM:

  • 21,000 with 8.4v
  • 33,000 with 11.1v (with no load)

GW Brushless 33K 480 Long Shaft 11.1v AEG Gel Blaster Motor Specifications:

  • Package Weight: 193 g
  • Package Dimensions: 9.6 x 6.1 x 3 cm
  • Motor Weight: 134 g
  • Type: AEG 480 Long Shaft Motor

Note: Do not exceed an M130 size spring.

Special Note: Installation at home of upgraded components, will void any warranty that is still valid on your blaster. If in doubt, seek advice from our Technicians, and request an estimate on having us conduct the work and upgrades for you. Damage caused to your pride and joy, cannot be “un-done”, so it is best to check things out before making any changes to the stock Gel Blaster.

GreyWolf Brushless 48,000 480 Long Shaft 11.1v AEG Gel Blaster Motor

Upgrade your gel blaster with the GreyWolf Brushless 48,000 480 Long Shaft 11.1v AEG Gel Blaster Motor for unmatched performance and reliability. Featuring a state-of-the-art brushless motor, this upgrade delivers increased efficiency, higher torque-to-weight ratios, and exceptional power input. With a direct plug-in installation, you can easily enhance your gear without the need for modifications or additional wiring.

Please Note: Installation of an upgraded motor is a technical process and should be conducted by an experienced Gel Blaster Technician. Also, with this upgrade, the gear box should ideally have a full re-build and potentially requires upgraded components to ensure that the gears, bearings, shims and all components are capable of handling the increase in power and overall RPMs. Every gearbox adjustment, must include a re-shim to ensure smooth operation and reduce the risk of damage.

The GreyWolf Brushless Motor is equipped with advanced protective features, including voltage protection below 5.5V and above 13.5V, battery low voltage protection for 2CELL (below 6V) and 3CELL (below 9V), and temperature protection up to 100 degrees Celsius. Stall protection ensures the motor’s longevity, even if gear damage or other issues arise. Enjoy a quieter, more efficient operation with reduced mechanical noise and near-elimination of electromagnetic interference (EMI). The brushless design also eliminates ionizing sparks from the commutator, providing a longer lifespan and reducing maintenance requirements. products.description:
Welcome to Catan: Trade Build Settle

Captivating Players Worldwide Since 1995

Experience the timeless appeal of Catan: Trade Build Settle, a board game that has enchanted players globally since 1995. Whether you’re a newcomer or a seasoned gamer, Catan offers endless excitement and strategic depth for everyone.

Minutes to Learn, a Lifetime to Explore

Learn the basics of Catan in just minutes and dive into a game rich with strategic possibilities. With endless tactics to explore, Catan remains compelling for years to come, ensuring you’ll always find new strategies and challenges.

Tremendous Replay Value

Enjoy nearly limitless replayability with Catan’s completely variable board. Every game presents a new set of challenges and opportunities, ensuring no two games are ever the same. The dynamic gameplay guarantees endless fun and value.

Build a Community

Catan is more than just a game; it’s a social experience. Whether you play with family, friends, or via video conference, Catan fosters interaction and community building. Dive into the world of Catan tournaments and connect with fellow enthusiasts.

The Original Strategy Board Game

Embark on a quest to settle the island of Catan! Discover its harbours and diverse regions, including pastures, fields, mountains, hills, forests, and deserts. Guide your settlers to victory through clever trading and smart development. Gather resources like grain, wool, ore, brick, and lumber to build roads, settlements, and cities. Acquire development cards that provide strategic advantages. Roll the dice, trade with others, and beware of the wily robber who may steal your resources!

Start your adventure with Catan: Trade Build Settle and experience the ultimate in strategic board gaming. Order now and embark on a journey filled with discovery, trade, and conquest!

Elevate Your Gel Blasting Experience

Step up your game with the CYMA M4A1 Full Metal Carbine AEG Gel Blaster. Its combination of durability, performance, and realistic design makes it a must-have for any serious gel blaster enthusiast. Order now and experience the ultimate in gel blaster technology!

CYMA M4A1 Full Metal Carbine AEG Gel Blaster Features:

products.description:
Introducing the E&C KAC KS-1 Gel Blaster Replica with Surefire Suppressor (EC-312) – The KS (Knight’s Stoner) Carbine, is a series of Armalite AR-15 style rifles produced by Knight’s Armament Company (KAC). It is designed as an improved version of their SR-16 family of rifles.

The 13.7″ KS-1 version, with the British Military designation “L403A1-AIW”, is quite literally a quantum leap forward for British Special Operations-Capable forces, being the first standard issue assault rifle to be entered into service since the adoption of the SA80 (L85A2) in the mid 80’s. Finally, the Commandos of the Royal Marines (his Majesties’ Corps of Royal Marines), and other Special Operations capable units of the British Army, have a weapon that matches their training and expertise. The E&C EC-312 is a very faithful replica, of the real world KS-1, and offers a great AEG Gel Blaster experience, with both great look and great performance.

Royal Marine from 45 Commando taking aim with the KS-1

Upgrade your gel blaster arsenal with the E&C KAC KS-1 Gel Blaster Replica with Surefire Suppressor (EC-312). This high-performance replica combines authentic design with exceptional functionality, perfect for both serious Gelsoft players and collectors.

E&C KAC KS-1 Gel Blaster Replica with Surefire Suppressor (EC-312) Key Features:

  1. Authentic Design: Modelled after the renowned KAC KS-1, this gel blaster offers a realistic and immersive experience.
  2. Surefire Suppressor: Includes a detachable Surefire Suppressor for enhanced stealth and tactical versatility.
  3. Durable Build: Constructed from high-quality materials for long-lasting durability and reliable performance.

  5. Customisation: The design of the E&C KAC KS-1 Gel Blaster (EC-312) allows for easy installation of accessories. With full length Picatinny that runs along the top of the receiver and handguard. Plus M-Lok compatible slots on the remaining seven side of the octagonal handguard, for additional (optional) picatinny rails to be mounted.

The E&C KAC KS-1 Gel Blaster Replica with Surefire Suppressor (EC-312) stands out with its superior craftsmanship and tactical enhancements. Whether you’re engaging in intense Gelsoft battles or adding to your collection, this replica is designed to impress.

This gel blaster pistol has been highly anticipated by many players for it’s light yet fast blowback action and loads of upgrade accessories.  It also has the ability to shoot in semi auto or full auto with the click of a switch and since it uses standard G-series magazines you should be able to easily find higher capacity extended mags or at least extra mags when needed.

products.short_description:
Type: Nylon Polymer Piston with CNC Head and Rack
Colour: Black and Copper (Mainly)
Materials: Nylon Polymer Body, CNC Streel Rack and CNC Aluminium Head.
products.description:
This piston is designed to be the ultimate choice for AEG enthusiasts, ticking every box for performance and reliability.

Crafted from custom-made, fibre-reinforced PA66 Polyamide (Nylon), this lightweight piston features a CNC Aluminium head and a CNC Steel cut rack. It is engineered with large windows in low-stress areas to reduce weight, keeping the total weight under 27.5 grams, making it DSG and high rate of fire friendly, right out of the box.

Aztech have maximized the engineering potential of this piston. The material at the highest stress point—the back of the piston bridge—has been nearly doubled, providing 80% more support for the pick-up tooth compared to other pistons we’ve tested. For the rack, we chose Cr12MoV hardened steel, the strongest metal available, to ensure maximum durability and breaking strength. Additionally, we incorporated every possible piston head feature to create the ultimate piston.

Aztech’s enhanced and reinforced piston boasts the following features:

  • Lightweight, ported, and reinforced ultra-strong PA66 Polyamide Piston
  • CNC 440C Stainless Steel rack
  • 9-port head for maximum airflow
  • Back cut chamfer for O-ring contraction
  • 360-degree axial thrust bearing spring seat
  • CNC Aluminium head mounting plate
  • Viton long-life max seal O-ring

The main properties of PA66 Reinforced Nylon include:

  • High strength and stiffness at high temperatures
  • Extreme lightweight design
  • Good impact strength, even at low temperatures
  • Excellent flow properties for flawless injection moulding with minimal risk of air bubbles
  • Good abrasion and wear resistance
  • Excellent resistance to oil and solvents
  • Good fatigue resistance

For high-performance builds, it is highly recommended to bond the steel rack to the piston body. We suggest using JB Weld Original Steel Reinforced Epoxy for the strongest bond possible, or at the very least, Gorilla Grip 2-part araldite epoxy

products.description:
GladiatAir HPA Polyurethane O-Ring for High Pressure Regulator Internal Valve

Replacement Polyurethane O-ring for the high pressure regulator’s, internal valve.

Polyurethane O-rings are made of general purpose polyurethane rubber, which is known for its combination of hardness and elasticity. Polyurethane O-rings have excellent abrasion resistance and high breaking strength. O-rings of polyurethane are resistant to oils, aging, ozone, heat, electricity, as well as to many chemicals.

Polyurethane O-rings perform well at low temperatures, but are not recommended for high temperature or superheated steam.

When installing your O-ring, and any time you remove then replace the regulator, we recommend us a good quality silicone grease to help the O-ring seat properly and seal properly.

Such as the Abbey Silicone Grease.

Abbey Silicone Grease

 

Sold individually.

 

Special Note: Only fill HPA cylinders from filtered “breathing Air” Scuba compressors. Contamination to the cylinder from oil, dust or any dirt, by filling using compressors that are not specifically designed to pump out clean “Breathable” quality, high pressure air, will void the warranty on your cylinder. This will also potentially void the warranty, and damage, the HPA gun that your cylinder is powering.
