products.description:
Double Bell – Lee Enfield MKIII Real Timber Body Gel Blaster Rifle

The Lee Enfield NO.1 MK3, in the real steel world, is a bolt action, magazine fed long rifle. British and Commonwealth armed force adopted the Lee Enfield rifles form the earliest manufacturing date of 1895, with the MK3 being launched in 1907 and is still in production today. The original item was chamber in .303 British Cartridge, and was the standard issue weapon, until 1957, when it was replaced by the L1A1 SLR.

This exquisite replica, reproduces the look and feel of the Lee Enfield MK3, down to the finest detail. The weight of this gel blaster, gives a reassuringly heavy feel, reminiscent of the real steel version. The real timber stock has the texture and grain that distinguished this blaster, as a real collectable. Ideal for enthusiasts and military memorabilia collectors, the Double Bell Lee Enfield MK3 get you as close to the real item as you can get, without actually having the real weapon.

Experience unparalleled authenticity with the Double Bell – Lee Enfield MKIII Gel Blaster Rifle. Crafted with a real timber body, this gel blaster rifle replicates the iconic WWII British firearm. Engineered to redefine your gaming experience, this cutting-edge blaster sets a new standard for performance and reliability. The primary upgrade from the original Apache Prime, is the additional holes in the face of the cylinder head, to ensure optimum airflow and ensure that the holes don’t clog. Also the O-Ring bumpers for the nozzle have been redesigned and are more recessed so they don’t have any possibility of slowing the nozzle down, only acting as bumpers.

Experience seamless gameplay with the Apache Prime V2—no more timing issues or tappet plate hassles. Its ground-breaking design ensures consistent airflow, delivering unmatched precision and power shot after shot. Whether you’re in semi-auto or full-auto mode, expect consistent feet per second (fps) for precise, controlled engagement.

But that’s not all—get ready for a whole new level of immersion with the Apache Prime V2’s commanding sound. Unlike traditional gel blasters, its distinctive, loud sound adds authenticity to your battles, elevating the intensity and realism of every skirmish.

Installation is a breeze with the Apache Prime V2, offering unmatched simplicity and user-friendliness. Pair it with our adjustable Aztech t-piece for peak accuracy and performance. Crafted from high-grade 7075 aluminium, this precision-engineered blaster guarantees durability and reliability that stand the test of time.

Dominate the field with confidence using the Apache Prime—whether you’re a seasoned pro or new to gel blasters, its exceptional reliability and consistency ensure unrivalled precision and power. Elevate your gameplay to new heights and conquer the competition with ease.

3v lithium non rechargeable button battery. Used in red dot optics and scopes on Gel Blasters Assault Rifles and Long Rifles.

Our PKCELL CR2032 battery delivers a robust 3V of power, with 210 mAh of capacity, ensuring that your red dot optics and scopes on Gel Blasters Assault Rifles and Long Rifles perform at their best. Colour: Black or Silver

products.description:
From the pages of the Ian Fleming spy novels, to the action of the “Bond” films on the silver screen. The Walther PPK has arguably become, the worlds most recognisable conceal carry sidearm. Made famous as James Bond (007’s) weapon of choice, this fantastic little replica of the Walther PPK pays exacting homage to the real steel version, of the renowned real steel PPK.

This fantastic little replica, gives a true 1:1 copy of the Walther PPK. The concealed carry piece, made famous in films beginning with the original “Dr. No” (1962) right through to “No Time to Die” (2021), carried by all the great actors, from Sean Connery to Daniel Craig, and even Australia’s only James Bond, George Lazenby. The Walther PPK has become synonymous with the 007 Franchise, across nearly 60 years.

Own your very own piece of movie memorabilia, and snap up 007’s Walther PPK. Ideal for both undercover spy missions or as a cosplay prop.

This extremely authentic replica, is based on a manual spring powered blaster design. Eliminating the need for batteries or compressed gases, simply drawback the slide to prime the piston’s spring and fire, then repeat for the next shot.

Walther PPK Manual Springer Gel Blaster Features:

  • Manufacturer: Walther (in the real steel world, that is)
  • Model: PPK
  • Type: Manual, Mechanical, Spring-Powered (Single shot, rack the slide for each re-load)
  • Single-Shot Pull-Back Type
  • 1:1 Ratio
  • Metal Slide and body
  • Mag Fed
  • Magazine Capacity: Approx. 14 gel balls
  • Approx. 200 Feet Per Second
  • Compact feel and size with easy handling
  • Engraved with high precision detail, mirroring the famous look of the PPK.
  • Slide lock on empty
  • Uses 7-8mm Gel Balls (sold Separately).

Performance:

  • Up to 200 Feet per Second (Dependant on Gels)
  • Up to 15m Firing Distance
  • 1 Shot per Pull Back of the Slide, then to load the next gel the slide needs to be racked again.

Specs

  • Weight: 616g
  • Length 155mm

Please note: We highly recommend purchasing our high quality Hardened Gel Balls for the best performance, like our Tenacity AKA’s

Grab some Gels, while you’re here. You don’t have to pick these up, like you do the darts.

A really  cool add-on, would be a pistol speed loader, takes all the fiddly-ness out of getting the gels into the Magazine.

Pistol Speed Loader, a definite time saver. Click image to add to order.

Always read the instruction on the gel packaging, and soak the gels in clean cold water for the specified time. Do not attempt to use Gels, that have not been soaked and have grown to their operational diameter.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

products.description:
WM DD MK18 Black RSIII MWS GBBR Gel Blaster Assault Rifle

Introducing the WM DD MK18 Black RSIII MWS GBBR Gel Blaster Assault Rifle, a ground-breaking creation by Western Manufacturing that redefines the standards of excellence in the realm of GBBR Gel Blasters. Prepare to be captivated by an unparalleled experience that sets the WM Daniel Defense MK18 RSIII apart from the rest.

Elevate your gel blaster experience with the WM DD MK18 Black RSIII MWS GBBR Gel Blaster, a cutting-edge gas blowback rifle by Western Manufacturing. This expertly crafted blaster delivers unparalleled realism, performance, and customisation options, setting a new benchmark for GBBR gel blasters.

Unmatched Realism & Performance

Designed for serious enthusiasts and collectors, this premium gas blowback rifle features an authentic Daniel Defense Mk18 RIS III-style handguard, providing enhanced modularity and a battle-ready aesthetic. The Steel Bolt, CNC-machined trigger box, and precision engineered buffer system ensure an ultra-smooth recoil, making every shot feel as real as it gets.

With an adjustable hop-up inner barrel, the WM DD MK18 Black RSIII MWS GBBR Gel Blaster offers exceptional accuracy and consistency. The added compatibility with tracer units allows for optimal performance in both daytime and low-light skirmishes.

Engineered for Durability & Tactical Advantage

The anodized aluminium receiver ensures longevity while maintaining an authentic look and feel. Powered by 12kg green gas, this blaster delivers a consistent velocity of 320 FPS, even during extended rapid-fire sessions. The advanced MWS System enhances safety, durability, and compatibility with TM parts, having been tested to withstand over 10,000 stress cycles.

A precision-crafted POM nozzle optimises gas flow, while a functional forward assist adds an extra layer of realism, making this one of the most immersive gel blaster experiences available.

WM DD MK18 Black RSIII MWS GBBR Gel Blaster Key Features:

  1. Adjustable Steel Trigger Box

Our newly launched adjustable trigger box parts are made entirely of steel, offering exceptional hardness and wear resistance. Functionally, it allows adjustment of the hammer power and trigger travel, providing players with enhanced customization and playability.

    • Constructed entirely of durable steel for exceptional wear resistance.
    • Allows customization of hammer power and trigger travel for enhanced precision and gameplay adaptability.
  1. High Performance Steel Bolt

Our latest bolt design is compatible with the previous version’s box lock-back structure. When used with the adjustable trigger box, the bolt achieves full travel. The bolt’s rear has been weighted for enhanced recoil feedback, delivering a more immersive experience.

    • Innovative weighted design enhances recoil feedback for a lifelike shooting experience.
    • Fully compatible with the adjustable trigger box for optimized performance.
    • Full-travel bolt for authentic operation — locks securely at the rear for realistic bolt-hold behavior.
  1. MWS System Technology
    • Ensures superior safety, durability, and compatibility with TM parts.
    • Tested rigorously to withstand over 10,000 stress cycles, guaranteeing long-lasting reliability.
  1. CNC Precision Crafting
    • CNC-machined steel internal components, including the steel bolt and trigger box, ensure unmatched material quality.
    • Stainless steel inner barrel with adjustable hop-up delivers customizable gel ball trajectory and precision.
  1. Realistic Design & Performance
    • Anodized aluminium receiver and solid build replicate the authentic look and feel of its real-steel counterpart.
    • Functional forward assist adds a touch of realism to your tactical setup.
    • Powered by 12kg green gas, it achieves a consistent velocity of 320 FPS with minimal cooldown, even during rapid fire.

Why Choose the WM DD MK18 Black RSIII MWS GBBR Gel Blaster?

Whether you’re a serious skirmisher or a collector, this premium GBBR gel blaster offers industry-leading build quality, advanced functionality, and an ultra-realistic experience. Featuring a battle-proven design, high-performance internals, and a durable DD Mk18 RSIII-style handguard, this Gel Blaster rifle is a must-have for any enthusiast.

Please note, this beautiful blaster is supplied without sites, so you have the freedom to choose from, Iron Sights, Red Dot Sights or Sniper Scopes.

  • CNC Machined Steel Receiver Parts

products.short_description:
Type: CO2 Powered 4 Inch Foam Dart Blaster Revolver
Material: Metal and imitation wood (Nylon Handle)
Uses: KELe Foam Darts (Can be converted to 7-8mm Gel ammo with the included replacement barrel and shells)
Gas Type: CO2 (12g Cartridge) – Sold Separately.
Colour: Dark Smokey Chrome
products.description:
Introducing the unparalleled power and precision of the HWASAN FSC1002BRW4 – 4-inch Revolver – CO2 Foam Dart Blaster.

Engineered for maximum performance, this CO2-powered revolver boasts a six-shot double action design, allowing for rapid-fire action with every pull of the trigger. Its swing-out cylinder design ensures quick and effortless reloading, while the push and pull cylinder release mechanism adds a layer of safety and convenience.

Constructed with a blend of durable metal and high-quality plastic, the HWASAN FSC1002BRW4 revolver features an alloy frame with an adjustable rear sight, an alloy outer barrel with a front sight, and an alloy cylinder and ejector rod capable of holding six shells. Complete with wood effect plastic grip covers for enhanced comfort and control, as well as alloy trigger, hammer, and cylinder release for added durability, this revolver offers a premium shooting experience like no other.

Included in the package are six metal shells, each takes a single KELe Foam Dart (once trimmed in length) for an authentic shooting action. Plus, with the addition of a plastic speed loader and both a 4-slot and 8-slot 20mm Picatinny rail (Revolver need to be fully disassembled, to fit the Picatinny rails to the top of the Barrel), you’ll have everything you need to dominate the battlefield with style and precision. Elevate your Foam Dart blaster game with the HWASAN FSC1002BRW4 – 4-inch Revolver – the ultimate combination of power, performance, and precision.

Please note: To use the foam dart, in the “Dart” shells that come with this pack, it is necessary to trim approx. 4.6mm off the bottom of each dart, to allow the chamber to close. Otherwise, the darts can be used individually, without modification, by inserting one dart per shot down the barrel, from the muzzle of the blaster.

HWASAN FSC1002BRW4 – 4 inch Revolver – CO2 Foam Dart Blaster Features:

  • Metal and Nylon body
  • Realistic Double Action Revolver
  • CO2 Gas Power
  • Smooth Cylinder Cycling
  • Dark Smokey Chrome with wood effect nylon grip
IN THE BOX
  • 1 x HWASAN FSC1002BRW4 – 4 inch Revolver – CO2 Foam Dart Blaster
  • 6 x Foam Dart Metal Shells (Once darts are trimmed to length)
  • 2 x Picatinny Rails ( 1 x 4-slot and 1 x 8-slot)
  • 1 x Allen Key (Hex Head Wrench, for our U.S. friends)
  • 1 x Quick Loader to load 6 shells at once
  • 1 x Instruction Leaflet

Plus FREE DIY upgrade Items also included, to allow you to customise your Foam Dart Blaster, into a Gel Ammo Blaster

  • 1 x 4 inch Gel Ball Inner Barrel, that can be made to fit with slight modification to the revolver outter barrel and some drillling.
  • 6 x Gel Ball compatible Shells

HWASAN FSC1002BRW4 – 4 inch Revolver – CO2 Foam Dart Blaster Performance

  • Power: Up to approx. 500 fps using the foam darts – Ouch!!
  • Range: Approx. 35 mtrs
Items you need to make the blaster work (that are NOT included).

Crosman CO2 Cartridges

 

Please note, this is a Foam Dart Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Blaster.

products.name: AZTECH Anti-Rotation 8mm Low Profile Bushes 440 Stainless for V2 and V3 Gearboxs
products.short_description:
Type: Low profile bushes for gel blasters
Material: 440 grade stainless steel
Colour: Silver
products.description:
Introducing Aztech Innovations’ Custom CNC Anti-Rotation Bushes, meticulously crafted for precision performance in your gearbox systems.

Crafted from top-tier 440-grade stainless steel boasting a formidable Rockwell hardness of 60HRC, these bushings are engineered to endure and excel under pressure.

Each bushing is machined to an exacting 8.02mm diameter, held to a remarkable tolerance of 0.001mm. Purposefully engineered with a slight oversize of 0.02mm, ensuring a snug fit without risking gearbox distortion due to over-tension.

For seamless installation, we recommend employing a light press or specialized bearing tool, steering clear of hammers or blunt force tools to safeguard your gearbox from inadvertent damage.

To fortify the longevity of your gearbox assembly, we advocate for the utilization of JB Weld Original epoxy, effectively anchoring the bushings in place to thwart any potential loosening or shifting.

Designed to complement next-generation gearboxes compatible with “The Aztech Bushing” V2 and V3 variants, tailored for both gel ball and airsoft applications. However, it’s important to note that some nylon gearboxes may not provide the depth required for secure retention.

Please be advised that these bushings are not compatible with Singularity 13 Gen 8 Gearboxes.

Each set includes six meticulously crafted bushings.

To ensure optimal performance and longevity, it’s imperative to lubricate stainless steel bushings with a high-quality bearing and gear grease. Our top recommendation is Nulon Xtreme Performance Grease with PTFE (L80), a specially formulated blend of Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) fluorocarbon particles in lithium-based grease.

PTFE L80 not only seals out moisture and dust but also applies a PTFE plating to mating surfaces during operation, enhancing seal performance, reducing operating temperatures, and minimizing grease “throw.” With a continuous temperature operating range of -9°C to 150°C, L80 stands as the ideal lubricant for our CNC bushings and gears, ensuring smooth operation under diverse conditions.

  • The Gel Ball sorter utilises USB-C charging designed to allow charging from any USB compatible charger, be it wall mount or plugged into a PC which allows for the unit to be used anywhere/Any time:
  • Incorporated in the design are dual metal sieve rails, meticulously crafted from the smoothest stainless steel, to ensure smoother operation and significantly reduce the mis-sieving rate of Gel Balls.

products.description:
Introducing Our Eclipse LR44 Gel Blaster Sight Battery

Elevate your Gel Blaster experience with our top-of-the-line LR44 battery, specially designed to power gel blaster sights.

1.55v Alkaline non rechargeable button battery. Used in red dot optics and scopes on Gel Blasters Assault Rifles and Long Rifles.

Long-Lasting Performance:
Boasting a high Amp. Hour Rating of 120mAh, this battery is designed to endure extended skirmishes and battles without faltering. You can count on it to keep your sights illuminated and ready for action when you need them most.

Convenient and Disposable:
Our LR44 battery is a single-use, disposable solution, making it hassle-free to replace when it eventually runs out of power. No need to worry about recharging or complex maintenance; simply swap it out for a fresh one, and you’re ready to go. Always remember to drop off  your used batteries, at battery recycling centres.

Versatile Compatibility:
Designed with a Nipple connection type, this battery is tailored for seamless compatibility with a wide range of red dot optics and scopes used in Gel Blasters Assault Rifles and Long Rifles. It’s the perfect fit for your equipment, ensuring consistent and dependable performance.

WARNING: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.
Button Cell Batteries are Hazardous (new or used). Keep batteries away from children. These Batteries can cause severe or fatal injuries within 2 hours or less if swallowed or placed inside any part of the body. Medical attention should be sought if it is suspected a battery has been consumed or inserted; Call the 24-hour Poisons Information Centre in Australia on 131126 or New Zealand on 0800 764 766 or contact your country’s emergency department.

products.description:

Ideal for players wanting to extend their inner barrel, to max their FPS, and to perhaps hide a hop-up. The two end caps are interchangeable so you can choose to have either the 14mm end, or the 19mm end nearest the end of the barrel, relative to how the logo appears. Elevate your gel blaster experience with the WM Geissele MK8 10.5 inch MWS GBBR Gel Blaster, a cutting-edge gas blowback rifle by Western Manufacturing. This expertly crafted blaster delivers unparalleled realism, performance, and customisation options, setting a new benchmark for GBBR gel blasters.

Unmatched Realism & Performance

Designed for serious enthusiasts and collectors, this premium gas blowback rifle features an authentic Geissele-style 10.5 inch handguard, providing enhanced modularity and a battle-ready aesthetic. The Steel Bolt, CNC-machined trigger box, and precision engineered buffer system ensure an ultra-smooth recoil, making every shot feel as real as it gets.

With an adjustable hop-up inner barrel, the WM Geissele MK8 10.5 inch MWS GBBR Gel Blaster offers exceptional accuracy and consistency. The added compatibility with tracer units allows for optimal performance in both daytime and low-light skirmishes.

Engineered for Durability & Tactical Advantage

The anodized aluminium receiver ensures longevity while maintaining an authentic look and feel. Powered by 12kg green gas, this blaster delivers a consistent velocity of 320 FPS, even during extended rapid-fire sessions. The advanced MWS System enhances safety, durability, and compatibility with TM parts, having been tested to withstand over 10,000 stress cycles.

A precision-crafted POM nozzle optimises gas flow, while a functional forward assist adds an extra layer of realism, making this one of the most immersive gel blaster experiences available.

WM Geissele MK8 10.5 inch MWS GBBR Gel Blaster Key Features:

  1. Adjustable Steel Trigger Box

Our newly launched adjustable trigger box parts are made entirely of steel, offering exceptional hardness and wear resistance. Functionally, it allows adjustment of the hammer power and trigger travel, providing players with enhanced customization and playability.

    • Constructed entirely of durable steel for exceptional wear resistance.
    • Allows customization of hammer power and trigger travel for enhanced precision and gameplay adaptability.
  1. High Performance Steel Bolt

Our latest bolt design is compatible with the previous version’s box lock-back structure. When used with the adjustable trigger box, the bolt achieves full travel. The bolt’s rear has been weighted for enhanced recoil feedback, delivering a more immersive experience.

    • Innovative weighted design enhances recoil feedback for a lifelike shooting experience.
    • Fully compatible with the adjustable trigger box for optimized performance.
    • Full-travel bolt for authentic operation — locks securely at the rear for realistic bolt-hold behavior.
  1. MWS System Technology
    • Ensures superior safety, durability, and compatibility with TM parts.
    • Tested rigorously to withstand over 10,000 stress cycles, guaranteeing long-lasting reliability.
  1. CNC Precision Crafting
    • CNC-machined steel internal components, including the steel bolt and trigger box, ensure unmatched material quality.
    • Stainless steel inner barrel with adjustable hop-up delivers customizable gel ball trajectory and precision.
  1. Realistic Design & Performance
    • Anodized aluminium receiver and solid build replicate the authentic look and feel of its real-steel counterpart.
    • Functional forward assist adds a touch of realism to your tactical setup.
    • Powered by 12kg green gas, it achieves a consistent velocity of 320 FPS with minimal cooldown, even during rapid fire.

Why Choose the WM Geissele MK8 10.5 inch MWS GBBR Gel Blaster Gel Blaster?

Whether you’re a serious skirmisher or a collector, this premium GBBR gel blaster offers industry-leading build quality, advanced functionality, and an ultra-realistic experience. Featuring a battle-proven design, high-performance internals, and a durable Geisele-style 10.5 inch handguard, this Gel Blaster rifle is a must-have for any enthusiast.

products.description:
GE 1887 Winchester Shell Ejecting Green Gas Shotgun Gel Blaster – Silver

The Winchester Model 1887 (Dellosso Shotgun) and Winchester Model 1901 are lever-action shotguns originally designed by famed American gun designer John Browning and produced by the Winchester Repeating Arms Company during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. The shotgun has become iconic for its use in the 1991 film Terminator 2: Judgment Day.

This Gelsoft variant is a pretty darn accurate replica of the real steel version. This build is very well constructed with a real wood furniture on a metal and nylon body. The GE 1887 Winchester Shell Ejecting shotty use Green Gas to power the blaster.  They shoot insanely well and are perfect for skirmishers, cosplayers and collectors alike. This iteration of the famous “Terminator” shotgun, not only talks the talk, but has the green gas power to walk the walk too.

We tested this fabulous wee beastie, using 14kg Warwolf Green Gas, and shooting single gels per cartridge to get the most accurate readings, and it averaged 450 fps!!! If you want a more “shotgun like” experience, the shells will comfortably hold 6 gels.

Gassing the blaster is achieved via the fill valve, which is tucked away on the underside of the loading lever, see images above. Yep, it took us a while to find it too LOL.

GE 1887 Winchester Shell Ejecting Manual Shotgun Gel Blaster Features:

  • Brand: Golden Eagle
  • Model: Gel8701 or Gel8701SV
  • Released: Dec. 2023
  • Type: Gas Powered
  • Gas Type: Green Gas 12kg or 14kg (Best use the Warwolf brand)
  • Colour: Black or Sliver
  • Material: Full Metal + Solid Wood
  • Metal Trigger
  • Metal Inner and Outer Barrels
  • Inner Barrel inner diameter size: 7.5mm
  • TYPE : Shell Injecting
  • INNER BARREL LENGTH : 280mm
  • TYPE OF FIRE : Single
  • MAGAZINE CAPACITY : 3 replica shotgun cartridges
  • Ammo: 7-8mm gel balls.
  • Frame: wooden (Real Wood)

GE 1887 Winchester Shell Ejecting Manual Shotgun Gel Blaster Specs:

  • Total length (approx.-): 480mm
  • Weight: 2kg
GE 1887 Winchester Shell Ejecting Manual Shotgun Gel Blaster, what’s in the box:
  • 1 x 1887 Gas-Powered Gel Blaster
  • Green gas powered
  • 3 x Bullet shell

Please note: This product contains timber (wood) as part of it’s design. Timber, being a natural product, does not always provide a 100% smooth and consistent finish and may have irregularities dues to grain direction, knot imperfections and general “softness” of timber, which makes it prone to marking easily. Also, in our harsh Australian climate, products containing timber should be stored out of direct sunlight, away from extremes in temperature fluctuations and protected from excessive exposure to humidity.

Care should be taken to keep timber in it’s best condition, timber needs to be maintained and “fed” using suitable timber oils, without any colourant of pigment, we suggest using Abbey Gun Solutions – Stock Finish. Click image below to add to your order.

Timber Stock Treatment

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

products.short_description:
KELe HK VP9 SK Manual Springer Gel Blaster – Black

Type: Manual (Spring Powered) Gel blaster pistol
Material: Metal body, with polymer lower grip
Colour: Black

products.description:
KELe HK VP9 SK Manual Springer Gel Blaster – Black

This is another of the highly anticipated HK offerings, the VP9 SK. The VP designation in the name refers to Volkspistole, which translates to “People’s Pistol”.

This beautifully weighted replica feels great in the hand. Its weight gives it the sense of being something more than just a simple toy, but more of an authentic replica of the real People’s Pistol. The HK VP9 SK is constructed as a metal slide on a polymer lower, with a manual spring, providing the power source. This means the slide needs to be re-racked after each shot, and makes the firing configuration, technically single-shot. And, as a couple of our competitive staff often say, the look of amazement on the face of a player at a Gel Soft skirmish, who has spent thousands on an HPA super gun set up, that shoot 25+ gels per second, at over 300 fps, then you creep up on them and take them out with a single shot from a springer, is priceless. Well, there’s no feeling quiet like that!!!

The HK VP9 SK Blaster is designed to run on either Gel Soft Gel Balls (not included) or red-tipped foam micro Nerf darts, and we found it performs best on Gels and fed well on a wide variety of Gels.

KELe HK VP9 SK Manual Springer Gel Blaster – Black Features:

  • Model: KELe HK VP9 SK Manual Springer Gel Blaster
  • Type: Manual, Mechanical, Spring-Powered (Single shot, rack the slide for each reload)
  • Single-Shot Pull-Back Type.
  • 1:1 Ratio
  • Metal Slide and Polymer body
  • Spring-fed, single-stack, Magazine (when using Gels)
  • Micro darts should be loaded from the barrel end and each slide rack. Darts do not fit in the magazine.
  • Magazine Capacity: Approx. 9 to 10 Gel Balls (dependent on Gel brand and variance in grown size)
  • Uses 7-8mm Gel Balls (sold Separately) or Micro Nerf Darts (10 qty included)

Performance:

  • Up to 130 Feet per Second (When using Gels)
  • Up to 15m Firing Distance
  • 1 Shot per Pull Back of the Slide, then to load the next gel the slide needs to be racked again.

Remember, one mag is never enough. Why not add a spare mag, or two, to your order and push you cart total, over the free freight threshold. A spare mag, pretty much pays for itself, in saving on the freight.

Click image to add the correct spare mag, for your KELe HK VP9 SK Manual Springer.

 

What’s the thing everyone loses? Yep, the little foam darts. Why not add an extra 10 pack, or two, of foam darts while you’re here.

Get some Spare Darts, ya know you’ll lose some 🙂

Please note: We highly recommend purchasing our high quality Hardened Gel Balls for the best performance, like our Tenacity AKA’s

Grab some Gels, while you’re here. You don’t have to pick these up, like you do the darts.

A really  cool add-on, would be a pistol speed loader, takes all the fiddly-ness out of getting the gels into the Magazine.

Pistol Speed Loader, a definite timer saver. Click image to add to order.

Only load Gel Balls into the magazine, DO NOT try to load mini darts into the Magazine, this will damage the gun and magazine. Mini darts should be pushed into the barrel only, in from the front of the pistol muzzle. The image of the TAN version of the VP9 is shown, to illustrate hot to insert the soft darts.

Always read the instruction on the gel packaging, and soak the gels in clean cold water for the specified time. Do not attempt to use Gels, that have not been soaked and have grown to their operational diameter.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

products.description:
Introducing the latest in the cost effect Cyma line, the 7.4v CYMA Nylon FN SCAR L AEG Gel Blaster. This blaster has to be one of the best entry level blaster we’ve seen for a long time. Combine that with the fact that Cyma internals are easily obtained and installed, then upgrading to metal internals at a later date in a doddle.

  • Firing Modes: Semi Auto, Full-Auto select ability and a Safe setting with an AMBI Selector for ultimate control.
  • Robust Construction: Experience a heavy and well-distributed weight for enhanced stability. The 2-piece split Nylon upper receiver and Nylon polymer lower receivers, coupled with a strong metal inner barrel, ensures durability and reliability.
  • Precision Engineering: Enjoy a Cyma Nylon Gearbox with Nylon gears, at 18:1 Gear ratio.
  • Sleek Aesthetics: Stand out on the battlefield, the FN Scar is an iconic assault rifle, and this little Cyma does the real steel version proud.
  • Adaptable Design: Customize your experience with an extendable stock, full picatinny top rail, partial picatinny side rails, full handguard length picatinny lower rail and the charging handle opening the dust cover for added realism.
  • Optimal Gel Compatibility: Designed for 7-8mm gel balls, this blaster boasts an approx.  200 round Hi-Capacity magazine. It’s compatible with other M4/M16 Series Cyma Gel Blaster AEG Mags for versatility.
  • Variable FPS: Achieve variable FPS between 250-270, accommodating different gel types. We recommend our own Brand Orange Gels or the Tenacity AKA Hard Gels for optimal performance.
  • Thread Compatibility: The Nylon outer barrel features a 14mm CCW thread for customization options.
  • Inner Barrel: Aluminium Alloy (7.5mm ID and 9.5mm OD)
  • Fire Select Modes: Choose from Semi Auto, Full-Auto, and Safe modes for adaptability in various scenarios.
  • Efficient Power: The blaster runs on a 7.4v Long Cylinder Type battery (included), with wiring lead into the stock and a JST Style connector for hassle-free operation.

Elevate your gel blaster experience with our feature-packed Cymae Scar Gel Blaster – the perfect blend of power, precision, budget price and style.

CYMA Nylon FN SCAR L AEG Gel Blaster Features:

  • Nylon Polymer upper receiver and barrel assembly
  • Nylon Polymer Outer Barrel (with 14mm CCW thread)
  • Folding stock with adjustable cheek rest
  • Adjustable plastic (replica iron sight) front and rear sights
  • Reinforced Cyma Nylon gearbox
  • Wired to the stock with a small Tamiya connector (7.4v Battery included)

What’s in the box?:

  • 1 x CYMA Nylon FN SCAR L AEG Gel Blaster
  • 1 x Cyma Nylon Gel Ball Mag
  • 1 x Plastic replica “Iron” Sights
  • 1 x Nylon Black Flash hider (14mm CCW Thread)
  • 1 x 7.4v rechargeable battery
  • 1 x USB charger
  • 1 x Safety glasses
  • 1 x Gel Ball Starter Pack (Please note these are generally considered to be pretty poor quality, and we recommend saving them for use in a grenade, a claymore or something similar. Our recommendation would be to use either our own Brand Orange Gels or the Tenacity AKA Hard Gels)

products.description:
JY Dragunov (SVD) Manual Gel Blaster Sniper Rifle

The SVD, known more commonly as the Dragunov after it’s designer, was, in the real world, designed to serve a squad support role to provide precise long-range engagement capabilities to ordinary troops following the Warsaw Pact adoption of the 7.62×39mm intermediate cartridge and assault rifles as standard infantry weapon systems. At the time, NATO used battle rifles chambered in 7.62×51mm NATO as standard infantry weapon systems and had not yet adopted an intermediate cartridge and assault rifle of their own, allowing them to outrange their Warsaw Pact counterparts.

This fun replica is a great talking point for any den or beer room, as a wall hanger or display piece. It’s definitely more about the looks, than the performance. It still manages a reasonable 170 (ish) FPS, but that is a long way off the performance of most AEGs or Gas Powered Blasters.

JY Dragunov (SVD) Manual Gel Blaster Sniper Rifle Features:

  • This item fires a single shot each time the bolt is cocked
  • Gel are fed up trough the magazine by the electric motor, each time the bolt is racked.
  • Firing Modes: Single-Shot
  • Approx. 1:1 Scale
  • Released: JAN. 2021
  • Type: Manual Operation
  • Highest quality materials and craftsmanship
  • Plastic imitation Sniper Scope (Push Fit – removable)
  • Adjustable Iron Sight
  • High Quality Imitation Wood
  • Designed and built with the utmost attention to detail
  • Weighted Buttstock
  • Metal Trigger Guard
  • Metal Sling Point
  • Removable Muzzle
  • Metal Fire/Safety Switch
  • Metal inside barrel
  • Metal select fire toggle
  • Metal Release for receiver upper.
  • Reinforcement – Solid metal rod for added strength
  • Large stock with cheek pad
  • Adjustable/ Removable Cheek Plate

To attach the buttstock, you first must remove the top receiver cover, see below.

JY Dragunov (SVD) Manual Gel Blaster Sniper Rifle Performance:

products.description:
The JinMing M4a1 is quite possibly the most popular blaster ever made, and this new version really improves on the original. To the already excellent Blaster, JM have added features like a metal inner barrel, metal gears and a mag prime feature, for when the charging handle is pulled back.

This new version of the JM M4A1 features the JinMing Gen 8 gearbox, but now with Metal Gears instead of the former nylon one.

The majority of he Blaster in a durable Nylon Polymer, except the buffer tube which is still ABS Plastic.

Optional upgrades and modifications available for this model, they include Drum mags, laser sights, hop ups, higher voltage and larger capacity batteries, and stronger springs.

DISCLAIMER
Do not try to upgrade any part of your toy gel blaster yourself, as this will void the warranty. Upgrades refer to pulling any of the blaster apart or opening it up, changing springs or upgrading the battery from 7.4v to an 11.v battery. 

M4A1 Gen8 AEG Gel Blaster Assault Rifle Ver2 Features:

  • JinMing Gen 8 Gearbox with Metal Gears
  • Adjustable / Removable Stock
  • Adjustable Plastic rear “Iron” sight.
  • Functional dust cover
  • Charging Handle Mag Prime

M4A1 Gen8 AEG Gel Blaster Assault Rifle Ver2 Specs:

  • Gel Type: 7-8mm
  • Suggested Gel Type: Either our own Brand Orange Gels or the Tenacity AKA Hard Gels
  • Metal Inner barrel size: 7.4mm
  • Inner barrel length: 27.5cm

products.description:
Introducing the TianGong Arp9 AEG Gel Blaster, a top-notch simulated firearm toy that falls within the submachine gun/CQB series of blasters, featuring a compact gun body for enhanced manoeuvrability and easy target acquisition.

Crafted in strong and light Nylon Polymer, this gel blaster boasts a stunning and intricate design, making it an ideal choice for collectors and skirmishers alike. Its gearing and spring setting ensures a decent firing speed, extended range, and reasonable precision, providing players with a remarkably realistic gaming experience.

The TianGong Arp9 offers the standard fire select shooting modes; safe, semi automatic and full auto, allowing players to adapt to different in-game scenarios. Enhanced anti-shake functionality ensures improved accuracy during dynamic battlefield situations.

Equipped with a detachable magazine and an adjustable  plastic “Iron” sights, the gel blaster provides added convenience for players to seamlessly change and fine-tune their equipment. Users can expect an outstanding shooting experience coupled with unparalleled entertainment enjoyment. The TG ARP9 also boasts a full length top picatinny rail, with small picatinny sections on the underside and sides of the handguard. The rear plastic site, when folded flat, also can act as a picatinny riser, if you want to mount red dot optics.

When comparing the XYL Arp9’s with the TG Arp9, the key distinction lies in economy levels. Both exhibit impressive performance, but the TG Arp9 stands out as a cost-effective option, offering remarkable value for money. Despite a minimal performance gap, the significant difference in price makes the TG Arp9 a highly recommended choice among Gel Blaster enthusiasts and players alike. Elevate your gaming experience with the TianGong Arp9 AEG Gel Blaster – where performance meets affordability.

Special Consideration, if toy are looking for an ARP9 that is suitable to be upgraded, then the XYL options are a much better choice, as the TG ARP9 is a clam-shell design receiver, which splits in half to access the internals, as opposed to the more common feature of the upper and lower receive sections, being able to be separated.

products.description:
In the Real Steel Version, the Knight’s Armament MK11 (SR-25 [Stoner Rifle-25]) was a precision designated marksman rifle and semi-automatic sniper rifle meticulously crafted by Eugene Stoner and expertly manufactured by Knight’s Armament Company.

Featuring a rotating bolt and a direct impingement gas system, the MK11 draws inspiration from Stoner’s iconic AR-10, meticulously rebuilt in its original 7.62×51mm NATO calibre. Remarkably, in the real steel version, up to 60% of the MK11’s components are interchangeable with the AR-15 and M16, encompassing everything except the upper and lower receivers, the hammer, the barrel assembly, and the bolt carrier group.

Originally, the MK11 barrels were precision-crafted by Remington Arms, showcasing 5R rifling (five grooves, right twist) with a twist ratio of 1:11.25. The MK11’s substantial 24-inch (610 mm) barrel is ingeniously free-floating, ensuring that handguards attach to the front of the receiver without making contact with the barrel. Immerse yourself in precision and performance with the MK11.

This beautifully crafter Gel Blaster Replica of the MK11, comes with many accessories already provided in the box, such as a Surefire Suppressor, Knight Armament Picatinny Rail coves and the Metal Buffer tube is top of the line X-Power branded one.

Thing you will need to buy, that this Gel Blaster does not come supplied with.

This blaster is supplied without any sights. The options would be to either use basic iron sights to keep the cost down, or add a Sniper Scope to give it the real look of a classic KA MK11 (SR-25) as it would have been used in the real world.

Add some Iron Sights to your KA MK11

US Marines using the Real Steel KA MK11 on the range

Also,  some good quality Gels and a speed loader bottle, get the best out of your KA MK11.

Elevate your Gel Soft game with the Premier Tactical Face Mask – the ultimate combination of protection and style. Engineered for Gel Soft skirmishes, this high-performance face mask ensures you stay in the game with confidence.

products.description:
Introducing the LeHui Beretta Shell Ejecting Foam Dart Shotgun – a thrilling and high-performance addition to your foam dart arsenal. This cutting-edge foam blaster brings the excitement of tactical play to a whole new level, promising an exhilarating gaming experience for enthusiasts of all ages.

Equipped with exceptional attention to detail, this foam dart shotgun boasts a striking resemblance to the real Beretta firearm, making it a standout choice for cosplay or simulation enthusiasts. Its ergonomic design ensures a comfortable grip, allowing you to handle intense battles with ease.

The LeHui Beretta Shell Ejecting Foam Dart Shotgun is supplied with 10 foam darts. Whether you’re engaging in close-quarters combat or backyard skirmishes, this shotgun empowers you to adapt to any battlefield scenario.

The LeHui Beretta Shell Ejecting Shotgun can operate in two modes

  1. Single shot manual when no battery is installed. Where the user draws the bolt to load the first shell and compress the spring. Once the trigger is pulled the user the draws the bolt again, to eject the spent shell and load the next.
  2. Semi Auto: when the battery is installed. The user draws the bolt to load the first shell and compress the spring. Once the trigger is pulled and the dart fired, then the electric motor cycles the bolt, ejecting the spent shell and loading the next, till all shells are fired.

The Beretta 1301 TACTICAL Shotgun was made famous, or perhaps infamous, in movies such as John Wick: Chapter 3 – Parabellum, Sicario: Day of the Soldado (2018) and Mile 22 (2018). This Soft Dart firing replica is very true to the look and feel of the real world item, making it a must for collectors of movie replica.

LeHui Beretta Shell Ejecting Shotgun Features:

  • Make: LeHui
  • Model: Beretta 1301 Tactical
  • Released: Oct. 2023
  • Type: Spring Powered firing, with electric cycling to reload the next shell.
  • Colour: Tan

  • TYPE : Shell Ejecting
  • TYPE OF FIRE : Single (if no battery is fitted, with manual reload) or Semi (with battery providing the recycle of the bolt and ejecting/reloading of the shells)
  • Ammo: Soft darts

products.description:
The Classic Derringer, or more formally know and the Remington Model 95 Derringer, set the standard for concealable firearms at it’s time. The real-steel pistol, that this lovely little toy is based on, was easily carried by the gentleman of the time in a coat pocket, or by the Victorian Ladies of the era in their purse.

Discover the Timeless Elegance of the Remington Model 95 Double-Barrel Pocket Pistol, a Classic Derringer. This iconic firearm boasts a design that remained virtually unchanged throughout its remarkable 70-year production history. Production of the original pistol lasted from 1866, through to 1935, with over 150,000 being made. Explore its enduring charm today.

The original, was a single shot weapon, that carried a “spare” bullet in the second barrel. This plastic dart firing replica, discharges both barrel simultaneously, firing the small orange darts up to 12 meters. Once the trigger has been pulled, the toy needs to be reloaded with 2 fresh shells, with the plastic darts pushed in, until the spring inside the shell is locked, ready for the hammer to release, once fired.

products.description:
KELe Colt 1873 Peacemaker Manual Revolver – Silver

The Colt Single Action Army (also known as the SAA, Model P, Peacemaker, or M1873) is a single-action revolver handgun. It was designed for the U.S. government service revolver trials of 1872 by Colt’s Patent Firearms Manufacturing Company (today known as Colt’s Manufacturing Company) and was adopted as the standard-issued pistol of the U.S. Army from 1873 until 1892.

Its overall appearance has remained consistent since 1873. Colt has cancelled its production twice, but brought it back due to popular demand. The revolver was dubbed the “Peacemaker”, and is a famous piece of Americana and the American Wild West era, due to its popularity with ranchers, lawmen, and outlaws alike. Today, they are mainly bought as memorabilia by collectors and re-enactors. Its design has influenced the production of numerous other models from other companies.

The KELe Colt Peacemaker Manual Revolver pistols are next level in quality, and these are no exception.  A solid metal and nylon build will definitely please any collector.  These shoot gels and small foam darts, so you can really get into the spirit of gun slinging and target shooting. The KELe Colt Peacemaker Manual Revolver pistols have a single-action trigger, meaning the hammer has to be cocked back for each shot.

KELe Colt Peacemaker Manual Revolver Features:

  • Full Metal body and Nylon Grips
  • Realistic Single Action Revolver
  • Spring Powered
  • Smooth Cylinder Cycling
  • Chrome Plated Finish

KELe Colt 1873 Peacemaker Manual Revolver – Black

The Colt Single Action Army (also known as the SAA, Model P, Peacemaker, or M1873) is a single-action revolver handgun. It was designed for the U.S. government service revolver trials of 1872 by Colt’s Patent Firearms Manufacturing Company (today known as Colt’s Manufacturing Company) and was adopted as the standard-issued pistol of the U.S. Army from 1873 until 1892.

Its overall appearance has remained consistent since 1873. Colt has cancelled its production twice, but brought it back due to popular demand. The revolver was dubbed the “Peacemaker”, and is a famous piece of Americana and the American Wild West era, due to its popularity with ranchers, lawmen, and outlaws alike. Today, they are mainly bought as memorabilia by collectors and re-enactors. Its design has influenced the production of numerous other models from other companies.

The KELe range of spring manual pistols are the next level in quality, and these are no exception.  A solid metal and nylon build will definitely please any collector.  These shoot gels and small foam darts, so you can really get into the spirit of gun slinging and target shooting. The KELe Colt Peacemaker Manual Revolver pistols have a single-action trigger, meaning the hammer has to be cocked back, for each shot.

KELe Colt Peacemaker Manual Revolver Features:

  • Metal and Nylon body
  • Realistic Single Action Revolver
  • Spring Powered
  • Smooth Cylinder Cycling
  • Antique Black Finish

CT Shell Ejecting G17 Gen5 HD17-SER Training Simulator Gel Blaster Key Features:

  1. Realistic Shell Ejection: The CT HD17-SER features authentic shell ejection, adding an extra layer of realism to your training sessions. Each shot ejects a spent shell casing, just like a real firearm.
  2. G17 Gen5 Replica: This gel blaster is a faithful replica of the G17 Gen5, one of the most popular and recognisable handguns in the world. It’s ideal for those who want to train with a firearm that mimics the look and feel of the real thing. This is identical to the sidearm carried by QLD Police, though in the real world, they use the G22, which is chambered in .40 cal, whereas the G17 in the real world would be a 9×19 Parabellum.
  3. High-Quality Construction: Crafted with precision and durability in mind, this gel blaster boasts a robust build that ensures longevity. It can withstand rigorous training and gaming scenarios.
  4. Training Simulator: Perfect your quick draw and firearm handling skills in a safe and controlled environment. The CT HD17-SER is an excellent tool for law enforcement, military, and recreational users to practice and improve their shooting techniques.
  5. Gel Blaster Fun: When you’re not training, enjoy the excitement of gel blaster battles with friends and fellow enthusiasts. The HD17-SER delivers reliable and accurate performance for gel blaster gaming.
  6. Easy to Use: This gel blaster is user-friendly, making it suitable for beginners and experienced users alike. It’s designed to be intuitive, so you can get started quickly.
  7. Accessory Compatibility: Customise your HD17-SER with various accessories, utilising the tactical under-barrel mounting rail, to enhance your training or gaming experience.

Start your training regimen and gaming adventures with the CT Shell Ejecting G17 Gen5 HD17-SER Training Simulator Gel Blaster. This versatile and realistic gel blaster is the ideal choice for those who demand authenticity, quality, and performance in one complete package. Whether you’re a professional sharpening your skills or a gel blaster enthusiast seeking an exceptional experience, the CT HD17-SER has you covered.

Please take special note, this product is the cutting edge of training simulators for non-lethal firearms training. That is it’s primary role. It is a Gel Blaster, but due to the fact that the barrel is shorter than other Gel Blasters of it’s size, and there are places that allow gas pressure to escape (namely between the Shells, the gas outlet and the barrel) this device will never achieve the FPS figures, associated with “standard” GBB Gel Blaster pistols. We sell these primarily to Law Enforcement, the Military, Cinema Prop houses and to customers that want the most realist training pistol, for safe, non-lethal, firearms training. If you want high FPS figures and don’t need to simulate the actions of a real G17, this is not the product for you.

If you, as a member of the general public, intend to use this product as a training aid to practice techniques for a real firearm, then it should be used under the guidance of a qualified firearms instructor.

 

Order yours today and discover the difference of a gel blaster that sets new standards for realism and training value. Elevate your shooting game with the CT Shell Ejecting G17 Gen5 HD17-SER Training Simulator Gel Blaster!

products.description:
Introducing the  AZTECH Scythe Gen9 V2 CNC Gearbox in 7075 Alloy  – A Marvel of Precision Engineering

  • Crafted with Passion: At Aztech, they take great pride in their CNC gearbox. Their dedicated technicians, after working with numerous branded gearboxes, decided to raise the bar. Their commitment to quality means no corners cut and no holds barred, resulting in the ultimate V2 gearbox with ambidextrous controls.
  • Premium Aerospace-Grade Material: The Aztech Scythe is meticulously constructed using world-class CNC 7075 aluminium, ensuring uncompromising durability and performance.
  • Stunning Silver and Black Options: Available off the shelf in its raw 7075 Silver and Black anodized finishes, the Aztech Scythe offers a sleek and distinctive appearance.
  • Universal Compatibility: The Aztech Scythe is designed to work seamlessly with 100% APS Silveredge parts, plus the majority of V2 Receivers, making upgrades and modifications a breeze.
  • Smooth Operation: Compatible with anti-rotation bushes, V2 receivers, and Aztech 8mm bushes (with compatibility for other 8mm sizes), this gearbox is engineered to perfection.
  • Ambidextrous Excellence: Offering full ambidextrous compatibility, the Aztech Scythe also works effortlessly with APS charging handles.
  • Precision at its Best: Aztech’s gearbox is machined to remarkable 0.0001mm tolerances, ensuring that every component fits together flawlessly for peak performance.
  • Versatile Gel ball Compatibility: The V2-style gearbox is gel ball compatible, providing versatility for various applications.
  • Complete Package: We include stainless 2mm Torx head screws for added convenience, plus a mini Torx screw driver. Additionally, the Aztech Scythe comes with a rear spring retainer adapter for HPA setups, enhancing its adaptability.
  • Direct APS Gearbox Upgrade: This gearbox housing is a straightforward replacement for APS gearboxes, and numerous other V2 gearboxes from other brands. You can easily transplant all the original parts into this gearbox housing, offering an optional upgrade path.
  • Performance-Driven Finish: While the CNC finish may vary from item to item, Aztech’s focus is on function over form. Constructed from raw 7075 aluminium, the unique surface finish includes CNC swirls, wire wheel marks, and buff marks, all aimed at providing a smooth, high-performance touch. We haven’t sacrificed quality for aesthetics; this gearbox is designed to deliver unrivalled performance.

Experience the Aztech Scythe – Where Precision Meets Passion! Your search for the ultimate CNC gearbox ends here.

AZTECH Scythe Gen9 V2 Gearbox 7075 Alloy – Silver Features:

  • 100% APS Silveredge parts compatible
  • Compatible with anti rotation bushes
  • V2 receiver compatible,
  • Made to suit Aztech 8mm bushes (other 8mm will work also)
  • 100% Ambidextrous Compatible,
  • APS charging handle compatible
  • Machined to 0.0001mm tolerances
  • V2 style gearbox gel ball compatible
  • Includes Stainless 2mm Hex head screws
  • Includes rear spring retainer adapter for HPA setups

 

Please note: Installation and assembly of the gearbox, and it’s internals require a reasonable level of familiarity with AEG Blaster re-builds. If you are at all uncertain of what to do, please contact our techs to inquire on quotes for the assembly and fitting of this fantastic gearbox to your blaster. X-Force Tactical can assume no responsibility for damage to your blaster, the gearbox internals, the receiver, or any other parts, due to incorrect method of assembly and fitting.

  • Metal barrel

products.description:
Introducing Our High-Performance CR2032 Gel Blaster Sight Battery

Elevate your Gel Blaster experience with our top-of-the-line CR2032 battery, specially designed to power gel blaster sights. Whether you’re an avid skirmisher or a gel blaster enthusiast, our CR2032 battery is your reliable choice for optimal performance.

3v lithium non rechargeable button battery. Used in red dot optics and scopes on Gel Blasters Assault Rifles and Long Rifles.

Unleash the Power:
Our CR2032 battery delivers a robust 3V of power, ensuring that your red dot optics and scopes on Gel Blasters Assault Rifles and Long Rifles perform at their best. With a diameter of 20mm and a height of 3.2mm, it’s perfectly sized to fit seamlessly into your gear, providing a compact and efficient energy source.

Long-Lasting Performance:
Boasting a high Amp. Hour Rating of 140mAh, this battery is designed to endure extended skirmishes and battles without faltering. You can count on it to keep your sights illuminated and ready for action when you need them most.

Lithium Ion Technology:
Our CR2032 battery utilizes advanced Lithium Ion technology, ensuring stable and reliable performance throughout its lifespan. This chemistry is known for its high energy density and low self-discharge rate, making it the ideal choice for Gel Blaster enthusiasts.

Convenient and Disposable:
Our CR2032 battery is a single-use, disposable solution, making it hassle-free to replace when it eventually runs out of power. No need to worry about recharging or complex maintenance; simply swap it out for a fresh one, and you’re ready to go.

Versatile Compatibility:
Designed with a Nipple connection type, this battery is tailored for seamless compatibility with a wide range of red dot optics and scopes used in Gel Blasters Assault Rifles and Long Rifles. It’s the perfect fit for your equipment, ensuring consistent and dependable performance.

WARNING: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.
Button Cell Batteries are Hazardous (new or used). Keep batteries away from children. These Batteries can cause severe or fatal injuries within 2 hours or less if swallowed or placed inside any part of the body. Medical attention should be sought if it is suspected a battery has been consumed or inserted; Call the 24-hour Poisons Information Centre in Australia on 131126 or New Zealand on 0800 764 766 or contact your country’s emergency department.

products.short_description:
Rizer Alloy Adjustable Hopup – Slim

Ultra-slim alloy hopup with precision grub screw adjustment. Designed for 9.5mm barrels and tight suppressor or flash hider builds.

Type: Hop Up for Gel Blasters
Length: 35mm

products.description:
Rizer Alloy Adjustable Hopup – Slim

If you’re chasing tighter groupings and extended effective range from your Gel Blaster, the Rizer Alloy Adjustable Hopup – Slim delivers precision tuning in an ultra-compact design. Built from durable alloy, this slimline hop unit offers superior strength over plastic alternatives while maintaining the flexibility required for consistent backspin application. The result is improved accuracy, better shot consistency, and enhanced range on the field.

Designed specifically to suit 9.5mm inner barrels, this hopup features an ultra-slim 11mm outer diameter, making it ideal for builds where space is limited. It fits neatly inside most flash hiders and suppressors without requiring bulky modifications. Adjustment is handled via a precise grub screw system, allowing you to fine-tune the amount of hop applied to your gels for optimal trajectory control.

To achieve peak performance, the hopup should be installed approximately 8mm onto the inner barrel. For correct operation and long-term stability, the Rizer Slimline Hopup must be secured to the inner barrel using a very small amount of superglue. This ensures the unit remains perfectly aligned during use and prevents movement under recoil or vibration.

Compact, durable and highly effective, the Rizer Slim is a smart upgrade for CQB builds, suppressed setups, or any Gel Blaster requiring a low-profile precision hop solution.

Rizer Alloy Adjustable Hopup – Slim features:

  • Alloy construction for enhanced durability and strength
  • Adjustable grub screw for fine-tuning hop application
  • Designed to increase accuracy and effective range
  • Compatible with 9.5mm inner barrels
  • Ultra-slim 11mm outer diameter for tight builds
  • Ideal for use inside flash hiders and suppressors
  • Requires installation approximately 8mm onto inner barrel
  • Must be secured with a small amount of superglue for correct alignment

Rizer Alloy Adjustable Hopup – Slim specs;

  • Brand: Rizer
  • Model: Slim Adjustable Hopup
  • Material: Alloy
  • Inner Barrel Compatibility: 9.5mm
  • Outer Diameter: Approx. 11mm
  • Adjustment Type: Grub screw
  • Installation Depth: Approx. 8mm onto inner barrel
  • Securing Method: Small amount of superglue required

For players who demand precision without added bulk, the Rizer Alloy Adjustable Hopup – Slim delivers serious performance in a compact package. Install it correctly, secure it properly, and enjoy tighter groupings with extended range on your next skirmish.

  • 5 qty of 0.5mm shims

Unlock Peak Performance with Precision Gearbox Shimming

Are you tired of that annoying whining noise coming from your gearbox when you fire your airsoft gun? Or perhaps you’ve noticed premature wear on your gearbox components, increased stress on the motor, a sluggish rate of fire, and poor battery life? The solution to these common issues lies in the art of gearbox shimming.

What is Gearbox Shimming?

Gearbox shimming is a crucial practice in the world of gelsoft, where small spacers, known as shims, are used to meticulously align the gears within your gearbox. The primary objective is to ensure that these gears function seamlessly, providing you with optimal performance and a quiet, efficient operation.

Why is Proper Shimming Vital?

Proper shimming achieves two main goals:

  1. Maximizing Tooth Contact: By spacing the gears correctly, we aim to maximize the contact between the teeth on each gear. This reduces wear and tear on your components while ensuring a smooth gear rotation.
  2. Minimizing Unwanted Movement: We also strive to minimize lateral movement within the gearbox. Excessive movement can lead to gears binding with each other or the gearbox casing, causing performance issues.

The Impact on Performance

Even if you have the finest quality gearbox components, your Gelsoft gun can feel lacklustre, excessively noisy and sluggish if not properly shimmed. Proper shimming is the secret sauce that transforms a mediocre setup into a high-performing, smooth running powerhouse.

In essence, gearbox shimming is not just a ‘nice to have’ – it’s an essential step towards achieving a well-running gearbox.

Ready to elevate your airsoft game? Don’t underestimate the power of precision shimming. Contact us today to experience the difference it can make in your airsoft adventures!

 

Note: Shimming your gearbox is a practice that requires a decent working knowledge of how your Gel Blaster’s gearbox runs. If you are unsure, please ask our friendly techs, who will happily carry out the shimming for you (labour charges will apply).

Unmatched Performance and Accuracy: Equipped with a high-quality 7.3 mm precision inner barrel, the King Arms TWS SBR (Short-Barrelled Rifle) GBBR Gel Blaster ensures unparalleled accuracy and precision in every shot. Dominate the battlefield with pin-point accuracy, and outmanoeuvre your opponents with ease.

Customization at Your Fingertips: Personalize your gel blaster to match your unique playstyle! With M-LOK and Picatinny rail systems, attaching your favourite grips, scopes, and other tactical add-ons is a breeze, giving you the edge you need to conquer any scenario.

Durability and Reliability: Crafted with top-notch materials and meticulous craftsmanship, the King Arms TWS SBR (Short-Barrelled Rifle) GBBR Gel Blaster guarantees long-lasting durability and reliability. It’s designed to withstand the rigors of intense battles, ensuring you can rely on it during the heat of action.

Perfect for Gel Blaster Enthusiasts: Whether you’re a seasoned gel blaster veteran or new to the sport, the King Arms TWS SBR (Short-Barrelled Rifle) GBBR Gel Blaster caters to all levels of players. Join the Gel Blaster Revolution: Don’t miss out on the excitement! Elevate your gel blaster experience with the King Arms TWS SBR (Short-Barrelled Rifle) GBBR Gel Blaster. 65L Heavy Duty Backpack – Camo Bag Key Features:

Ample Storage Capacity: With a generous 65L capacity, you’ll have plenty of room to pack all your gear and essentials for extended trips. Say goodbye to the limitations of smaller backpacks and embrace the freedom of carrying everything you need.

Comfortable and Ergonomic Design: The backpack features adjustable padded shoulder straps, a lumbar support and an adjustable sternum strap, providing optimal comfort even during extended hikes. Versatile Multi Terrain Pattern (MTP) Camo: The camo pattern not only adds a touch of style to your outdoor gear but also blends seamlessly with nature, making you less visible to wildlife during your wilderness journeys.

Invest in Your Adventure: Whether you’re a seasoned backpacker or a weekend warrior, our 65L Heavy Duty Camo bag Backpack is an investment in your outdoor experiences. With its ample storage, thoughtful organization, and durable construction, it ensures you’ll be prepared for any adventure that comes your way.

products.name: Retro Arms V2 Split CNC Gel blaster Gearbox (8mm) – QSC
products.short_description:
Type: CNC Split Aluminium Gearbox

Version: V2

Bearing Size: 8mm

Weight: 178g
products.description:
Are you in search of a high-performance CNC split gearbox designed exclusively for gel soft replicas like AR15 (M4), M16, and other models with a V2 gearbox? Your quest ends here! Introducing the Retro Arms CNC Split Gearbox V2 – a revolutionary upgrade for the world of gel soft enthusiasts.

Crafted from a solid block of aircraft Aluminum (Dural) EN AW 7075 T651, the Retro Arms Split gearbox boasts exceptional strength with a rating of 590MPa – significantly higher than common construction steel (390MPa). This choice of material ensures unparalleled durability and resilience, surpassing traditional zinc-Aluminum gearboxes in every aspect.

The Retro Arms factory employs cutting-edge CNC milling machines to manufacture these gearboxes with utmost precision. The result is a gearbox that sets new standards in the gel soft industry.

One of the key advantages of our split gearbox design is its two-part structure, consisting of the Upper and Lower sections. This ingenious design simplifies the installation of inner parts, allowing you to set up your cylinder set with ease. You no longer need to remove the entire gearbox from your receiver during setups. Simply dismount the upper part, conveniently held by one receiver pin. The versatility of our CNC Split Gearbox V2 allows seamless installation even in gel soft replicas with non-straight receivers like AR15 (M4), paired with any AR15 (M4) Hop-Up chamber of your choice.

For optimal performance, we recommend a nozzle length of 21.4mm. However, keep in mind that various factors such as the angle of the tapped plate or the length of the front part of the Hop-Up bucking can influence the required nozzle length. In such cases, you may need a different nozzle length to achieve the best results.

Each package includes the CNC Split Gearbox V2 (8mm) – QSC, available in your preferred colour, along with a set of screws and a QSC spring guide.

We’ve made significant improvements to our CNC Split Gearboxes V2 to enhance your gel soft experience. Spring holders now feature grooves, preventing springs from jumping off the tapped plate and trigger switch. Additionally, we’ve added grooves for the safety lever and trigger spring to ensure a better fit.

The gearbox now includes an AOE control hole, along with sockets for bushings/bearings with a reduced diameter of -0.02mm (7.98mm) to prevent overturning during installation. To ease wiring, we’ve enhanced the grooves to accommodate 1mm wirings with a 2.5mm diameter. Moreover, we’ve added a protective edge for wiring against the motor.

The gearbox threads are shaped instead of cut, significantly increasing their strength. The gearbox parts are accurately centred by milled grooves and edges, ensuring optimal performance. For added durability, Retro Arms has reinforced the cylinder head part of the gearbox with 100% more material and added a groove for the anti-reversal latch spring to keep it securely in place.

The outer edges have been precisely cut off, and the gearbox type (8mm or 9mm) is indicated on the outside.

One standout feature of the Retro Arms gearbox is the Quick Spring Change System (QSC). This ingenious system allows you to replace the spring without opening the gearbox. Please note that you must secure the spring guide with a screw, either using the stock screw or the QSC screw, depending on your stock configuration.

To ensure compatibility, the trigger switch space is designed to fit trigger switches and units from common manufacturers like Gate.

Our CNC gearbox V2 is protected with anodizing to safeguard against corrosion, even with the challenging Aluminum EN AW 7075 T651 material. Avoiding anodizing could lead to the formation of unsightly grey spots that resemble corrosion.

It’s important to note that our CNC gearbox can only be installed in gel soft replicas with a Tokyo Marui compatible standard, including the inner parts. During installation, use only 1Nm tightening moment on screws to prevent them from overturning in the heads. Excessive force is unnecessary, but if you want to ensure a perfect fit, consider using thread glue or thread colour.

Please refrain from using a MAXX cylinder head with Retro Arms gearboxes, as it may lead to compatibility issues.

Lastly, we must emphasize that installing inner parts and gearboxes requires professional knowledge, experience, and skills. With various gel soft manufacturers in the market, each with their own sizing standards, compatibility issues can arise with parts from different manufacturers. To ensure the best fit, we recommend having the gearbox professionally built and installed by our Tech Team.

Upgrade your gel soft replica with our top-of-the-line CNC Split Gearbox V2, and experience the ultimate performance and durability.

 

Retro Rams has made some useful improvements into their CNC split gearboxes V2:

  • Spring holders have grooves, so the springs for tapped plate and trigger switch will not jump off.
  • Added groove for safety lever, so it will hold during installation.
  • Added groove for trigger spring, for better fitting.
  • AOE control hole.
  • Sockets for bushings/bearings have smaller diameter about -0,02mm (7,98mm), for non-overturning the bushings during installation. The socket edges are cutted down for better installation.
  • We enhanced grooves for wiring for 1mm, you can now use wirings with 2,5mm diameter.
  • Added protecting edge for wiring against the motor.
  • All threads are now shaped instead of cut for better strength.
  • Both of the gearbox parts are cantered by milled grooves and edges.
  • Added hole for releasing anti-reverse latch.
  • For better durability, we added more material around cylinder head part of the gearbox, this was the most critical part and we added 100% more material where is huge radius.
  • Added groove for anti-reversal latch spring, so it will not jump off.
  • Outer edges are now cut off.
  • You can find what type of sockets gearbox have on the outside part of the gearbox (8mm or 9mm).

Whether you’re a competitive Speed QB’er, a tactical MilSim’er, or an avid skirmisher, the HSW24a Red Dot Sight is your ultimate companion for unmatched performance on the range or in the field.

Introducing our Quick Mount/Detach System Flashlight

Experience convenience and versatility with our Quick Mount/Detach System Flashlight. Designed for ease of use, this flashlight features a user-friendly micro-USB charging system and a battery indicator, making it a reliable companion for all your lighting needs.

The side indicator of the flashlight serves as your power guide. When the battery is low, it will turn a vibrant RED, ensuring you’re aware of the remaining power. On the other hand, a soothing Green light indicates that the battery is fully charged, guaranteeing you’re ready for any situation.

Equipped with a powerful CREE XP-L HI LED, our flashlight delivers an impressive beam of up to 800 lumens, with a remarkable throw distance of 90 meters. With a runtime of 65 minutes, you can rely on its consistent performance during your outdoor adventures or daily activities.

Enhancing its functionality, our flashlight includes mount adapters (1913) that easily attach to any Picatinny via the quick detach mount. This feature ensures seamless integration with your preferred setup, allowing for a hassle-free experience.

Featuring a wide beam angle of 170°, our flashlight’s SO-23 output provides extensive coverage, illuminating your surroundings with ease. Switching between the two available modes is a breeze. In Mode One, a static beam ensures a constant source of light. Simply click either switch for a steady illumination, and with another click, the light turns off.

For a different lighting experience, switch to Mode Two, offering an intermittent beam. Hold down either switch for a momentary on, and the light will stay on until the switch is released. If you wish to change the mode, a simple solution awaits. Just long-press any button for 5 seconds, and witness the flashlight flash five times, indicating the successful transition to the other mode.

Upgrade your lighting gear with our Quick Mount/Detach System Flashlight, delivering convenience, versatility, and powerful illumination in one exceptional package. Whether you’re an outdoor enthusiast or in need of a reliable everyday flashlight, our product is designed to meet your diverse lighting requirements.

Experience unmatched precision and enhanced Gel Blaster performance with the remarkable Grace Optics M1. When it comes to uncompromising accuracy and versatility, the Grace Optics M1 reigns supreme. Elevate your gel soft experience and take your skills to new heights with this exceptional reflex sight. Whether you’re a competitive Speed QB’er, a tactical MilSim’er , or an avid skirmisher, the Grace Optics M1 is your ultimate companion for unparalleled performance on the range or in the field.

Experience precision like never before – choose the Grace Optics M1 and embrace a new era of Gel Blaster excellence.

TOPLESS DESIGN

The M1 has a topless design designed to give you a wider field of view, resulting in quicker target acquisition and more accurate shooting.

STRENGTH

  • Robust Aluminium Construction
  • 5 Brightness Level
  • Lens Diameter: 24MM
  • Waterproof: IPX7
  • Topless Design

products.name: Muzzletek V2 GBB Pistol Hop System by AZTECH Innovations
products.short_description:
Type: Adjustable hop up for GBB Pistol blasters

Material: Metal

Colour: Black
products.description:
Do you want a metal hop up unit that works with a tracer but looks like a suppressor?

The next generation of the Aztech Muzzletek hop up is here
Designed and assembled in Australia!

-Suits blasters with up to 12mm of inner barrel protruding from outer barrel.
(Please note the 12mm, any more than 12mm and the inner barrel will make contact with the inner tongue of the hop unit and will either break the inner or push it out of its seat, we would recommend 10mm or 11mm maximum OR don’t turn the Muzzletek all the way onto your outer barrel to ensure it doesn’t make contact.)
-CNC machined outer casing from 6065 aluminium,
-Injection moulded ABS inner, tool less adjustment,
-14mm Counter clock wise outlet for additional accessory fitment i.e. tracer unit or amplifier
– CNC Cap to cover accessory thread if not used.

We have made the V2 to be the identical outer diameter as Acetech Lighter C tracer unit so once fitted it looks like a suppressor unit.

Is available in two options:
-14mm CCW long mount version for gel blaster Rifle platforms
-14mm CCW short mount version for gel blaster pistols

Pistol options:

-11mm counter clock wise adaptor Suits APS pistols
-12mm clockwise adaptor Suits WE Tech pistols

Hopup Material: CNC alloy outer case with ABS plastic inner

Adaptor Material: CNC 6065 aluminium

 

GBB Pistol version Fitment Instructions:

  • Thread the Muzzletek in a reverse direct until threaded all the way on(maximum of 12mm) making sure to be careful that the inner barrel doesn’t make contact with the rear of the internal tongue. If it does make contact, unwind the hop until it has clearance.
  • It more than likely will not have perfect rotation alignment to set the hop ramp at 12 o’clock
  • When set correctly, the reses in the bottom of the Muzzletek V2 will line up with the Pistol recoil rod.
  • Rotate to set the alignment correctly then use the side grub screws to hold the Muzzletek firmly in the correct position
  • To adjust the hop up, Turn the slotted end cap to lower the hop ramp, the cap rotates just 90 degrees offering 8 settings
  • If a permanent fixture we would recommend using a low strength Loctite to hold the side grub screws in place and if you wish a small amount on the main thread from hop to out barrel.

Note: Picture if for display purpose only, colour might be slightly different due to light variations.

products.short_description:

products.description:
GladiatAir HPA Over Pressure Burst Disc for Tank Valves

This is a safety device used to prevent damage to your GladiatAir HPA cylinder, from being filled to pressure beyond what the cylinder was designed for. The burst disc is designed so that the copper plate inside will rupture, before a pressure is reached that may damage your cylinder. HPA Cylinder must always be filled by experienced technicians, who are trained in the use of Scuba compressor, which supply clean, filtered breathing quality air.

High pressure burst disc for paintball regulator 1.8K psi

Burst Discs for GladiatAir paintball regulators, please note, these burst discs may not fit or seal correctly when used in other regulator bodies. These burst discs will fit standard un-branded regulators purchased from Air tanks.

Burst Disc thread is 1/8″NPT Male.

Burst pressure is 1,800 PSI with a tolerance of +0% and -10%.

Supplied individually

Sold individually.

 

Special Note: Only fill HPA cylinders from filtered “breathing Air” Scuba compressors. Contamination to the cylinder from oil, dust or any dirt, by filling using compressors that are not specifically designed to pump out clean “Breathable” quality, high pressure air, will void the warranty on your cylinder. This will also potentially void the warranty, and damage, the HPA gun that your cylinder is powering.

products.description:
The SKD M4 Drum Mag CQB Gel Blaster is quite possibly the most cost effective blaster on the market. What a great way to get into the hobby, if you’re a youngster wanting a budget first blaster, or just on e tight budget.

The Blaster has 2 fire modes, “Off” and “Full Auto”, that markings around the fire select are for aesthetic purposes only.

Want to be the coolest teens on the block. Why not have Gel Ball fights anywhere, with your besties, with the super cool new Thanos Infinity Glove Gel Blaster.
