products.short_description:
Type: Sniper Rifle Gel Blaster

DSR No.1 Police Issue Sniper Rifle Gel Blaster Toy Features:

  • Swivel mount Bipod
  • 2 x Magazines
  • Manual Fire only
  • Material: Nylon and Metal
  • Spring powered bolt release.
  • Ambidextrous Fire control.
  • Adjustable buttstock length
  • Adjustable Butt pad Height
  • Screw adjust Monopod in Buttstock

Uses: 7-8 mm gels, or mini foam Nerf Darts
products.description:
The JSR No 1 Sprung bolt action Sniper Rifle is a beautiful, solid blaster weighing in at 3.625 kilograms and just under a meter long.

The blaster features a sturdy nylon polymer chassis, which makes a solid base for the other included features such as the Metal Sprung Action Bolt mechanism, adjustable stock, adjustable butt pad, lower handguard & metal bipod assembly. This creates a large amount of modularity that will help fit the user’s preferences. The Bipod has a very simple sprung bar, used as a locking mechanism on the top Picatinny rail. When in place, the Bipod allows the rifle to be swivelled roughly 15 degrees left and right, and also up and down, without the need to move the placement of the legs. Both legs of the Bipod adjust to seven separate height settings, controlled by the circular indents on each bipod leg, allowing you to set the height of the sniper rifle to your exact needs, in your snipers nest.

The DSR No.1 comes with two barrels, one to suit the tapered shells which take Gel Balls, and one for the cylindrical shells used with the foam darts. Out of the box, once assembled with the Bolt in place and stock adjusted to its maximum length, the DSR No.1 Sniper Rifle measures in at an impressive 1.03 Meters.

The Jund/Cyma AMP Technical Services DSR No.1 features a working safety as well as a removable bolt, which gives you the ability to keep the bolt safe during transit.

The DSR No.1 is a bullpup-style sniper rifle, meaning that it feeds from the mag at the rear. However, the rifle does feature an included second magazine near the centre of the blaster. Because of this bullpup design, the DSR-1 uses a 60cm internal barrel with an ID of 7.5mm. In testing, with the standard spring, we average 220 fps.

The full length picatinny rail, on the top side of the DSR No.1, allows for the mounting of any manner of optics, scopes and accessories.

Ammo Size:
7 – 8mm or Mini Nerf Dart

What’s in the box?

  • 1 x AMP DSR no.1 Sniper Rifle body (Gel suitable barrel installed)
  • 2 x Magazines
  • 1 x Sprung Bolt Mechanism
  • 1 x Adjustable Bipod
  • 1 x Flash Hider
  • 5 x Brass Tapered shells for Gel Balls
  • 5 x Brass straight shells for mini Nerf Darts
  • 20 x Mini Nerf Darts
  • 1 x Bag for parts (3 Allen Keys, 1 Blanking disc for behind the bolt action, 1 punch pin, 1 grub screw for flash hider)
  • 1 x Chinese instruction manual

Click here to view out range of rifle bags and cases.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

The brand new KELe GTW Beretta Manual Gel Blaster Pistol, is a spring feed gel blaster with metal slide, lower and polymer grip, this is a great entry level pistol for anyone looking to get into gel blasters and shooting targets in the backyard. The clean look and attention to detail for the real steel Beretta are unparalleled in the manual pistol range .

Features:

  • Uses 7-8mm Gel Balls (sold Separately)
  • Comes with 10 Foam mini Nerf darts

Performance:

  • Up to 160 Feet per Second
  • Up to 20m Firing Distance
  • 1 Shot per Pull Back of Slide

What’s the thing everyone loses? Yep, the little foam darts. Why not add an extra 10 pack, or two, of foam darts while you’re here.

Get some Spare Darts, ya know you’ll lose some 🙂

Please note: We highly recommend purchasing our high quality Hardened Gel Balls for the best performance, like our Tenacity AKA’s

Grab some Gels, while you’re here. You don’t have to pick these up, like you do the darts.

A really  cool add-on, would be a pistol speed loader, takes all the fiddly-ness out of getting the gels into the Magazine.

Pistol Speed Loader, a definite timer saver. Click image to add to order.

Only load Gel Balls into the magazine, DO NOT try to load mini darts into the Magazine, this will damage the gun and magazine. Mini darts should be pushed into the barrel only, in from the front of the pistol muzzle.

Manual pistols may not always feed gels consistently from the magazine into the barrel. You might experience issues such as double feeds (two gels at once), empty feeds (no gels), and normal feeds (one gel). These problems are quite common with manual pistols and are not defects; they are simply part of owning, manual spring fed Gel Blasters.

Always read the instruction on the gel packaging, and soak the gels in clean cold water for the specified time. Do not attempt to use Gels, that have not been soaked and have grown to their operational diameter.

products.description:
GladiatAir HPA Regulator O-Ring – Polyurethane

Replacement Polyurethane O-ring for the neck of the HPA Cylinder, where the regulator sit on top of the HPA tank.

Polyurethane O-rings are made of general purpose polyurethane rubber, which is known for its combination of hardness and elasticity. Polyurethane O-rings have excellent abrasion resistance and high breaking strength. O-rings of polyurethane are resistant to oils, aging, ozone, heat, electricity, as well as to many chemicals.

Polyurethane O-rings perform well at low temperatures, but are not recommended for high temperature or superheated steam.

When installing your O-ring, and any time you remove then replace the regulator, we recommend us a good quality silicone grease to help the O-ring seat properly and seal properly.

Such as the Abbey Silicone Grease.

Abbey Silicone Grease

 

Sold individually.

 

Special Note: Only fill HPA cylinders from filtered “breathing Air” Scuba compressors. Contamination to the cylinder from oil, dust or any dirt, by filling using compressors that are not specifically designed to pump out clean “Breathable” quality, high pressure air, will void the warranty on your cylinder. This will also potentially void the warranty, and damage, the HPA gun that your cylinder is powering.

The M1911, also known as the Colt 1911, or the Colt Government, is a single-action, semi-automatic, magazine-fed, recoil-operated pistol chambered for the .45 ACP cartridge. It served as the standard-issue sidearm for the United States Armed Forces from 1911 to 1985. It was widely used in World War I, World War II, the Korean War, and the Vietnam War.

Designed by John Browning, the M1911 is the best-known of his designs to use the short recoil principle in its basic design. The pistol was widely copied, and this operating system rose to become the preeminent type of the 20th century and of nearly all modern centrefire pistols.

    •  Supports up to 11.1V batteries
    •  Binary trigger. Put the selector in semi-auto position, pull and hold the trigger for 3 seconds will change the semi-auto function into binary trigger shooting mode.
    • Block-up protection. When gearbox Block-up occurs, the system stops working and emits a ‘beep’ sound. Please check the  gearbox immediately by powering off.
    • Auto-loading priming function is designed for gel ball blaster magazines with motor inside, when changing the magazine, the magazine motor will run automatically for 0.5 second.
    • Increase rate of fire.This module allows to increase rate of fire, the stability of single-shot and make batteries have a higher durability.
    • Active braking. The energy that support the active brake function comes from the inertia of motor, stop the piston without delay. The effect of active brake is significant on high torque motor
    • Prevent gears from over-rotating. The active function prevents the over-spin of gears, this solves the issue that a single shot becomes full auto under high voltage. Meanwhile, the spring is fully released in semi-auto mode and parts in gearbox are not under strain, thus increase the life cycle of gearbox and parts.
    • DTU overheat protection. When the DTU is overheated, after the trigger is pulled, the motor will give a beep prompt until it is automatically restarted after cooling.

This is the ultimate high performance gearbox. Whether you’re an enthusiast looking at a full build or a newbie just wanting something strong and reliable with potential to upgrade in the future, the Xforce Black Label V2 gearbox is a great place to start.

Use protective eyewear at ALL times as the incorrect usage can lead to eye damage.

Gel blasters must be concealed during transport and used in designated areas.

Includes:

  1. Taranis Complete assembled and tested bolt gearbox
  2. N52 High Torque Motor
  3. Stainless steel barrel
  4. Labour to build and test
products.description:
True innovation at its finest! This is the TARANIS recoil gearbox. It is much more than just a gearbox that provides recoil, this has a fully functioning bolt that is not there for looks but for functionality. In simple terms, we have inverted the gearbox meaning the piston is stationary and the cylinder (bolt) moves which has an internal face. The air travels through the piston and into the APACHE activating the nozzle and pushing the gel out. The average FPS is 320FPS in semi and full auto modes.

The bolt assembly weighs in at a whopping 130 grams and is made of 440C hardened stainless steel. The Rack is easily replaced and also made of 440C stainless steel which has proven to be ultra hard! The gearbox shell as always is made of 7075 alloy as is all other alloy internal parts.

The recoil of this gearbox is unparalleled!

 

 

Please remember to check all local laws regarding the usage and ownership of gel blasters in your particular State or Territory.

Use protective eyewear at ALL times as the incorrect usage can lead to eye damage.

Gel blasters must be concealed during transport and used in designated areas.

products.description:
90% Ported Cylinder Stainless Steel

The 90% Ported Cylinder Stainless Steel is a high-quality internal upgrade designed for most full-size AEG gel blasters. Installed inside the gearbox, this cylinder works with the piston assembly to compress air and generate the pressure required to propel gel balls down the inner barrel with consistent and efficient output.

Featuring a 90% ported design, this cylinder retains a larger air volume compared to lower-ported options, making it ideally suited to standard-length inner barrels found in most full-size M4, AR-style and rifle-length gel blasters. It delivers balanced air compression for reliable performance across general-use builds. The only setups where this cylinder is not recommended are ultra-long, DMR-style builds that require maximum air volume from a full, non-ported cylinder.

Manufactured from durable stainless steel rather than aluminium alloy, this cylinder offers enhanced strength, improved wear resistance and long-term reliability. The smooth internal finish supports a strong air seal against the piston O-ring, helping to maintain consistent compression over time. Whether you are refreshing worn internals or building a dependable skirmish-ready platform, the 90% Ported Stainless Steel Cylinder provides a versatile and durable solution for most standard AEG configurations.

90% Ported Cylinder Stainless Steel Features:

  • 90% ported design suited to most full-size gel blasters
  • Optimised air volume for standard inner barrel lengths
  • General-purpose cylinder for everyday AEG builds
  • Precision stainless steel construction for durability
  • Smooth internal surface to promote a strong air seal
  • Compatible with standard AEG gearbox piston assemblies

90% Ported Cylinder Stainless Steel Specs:

  • Product Type: Gearbox Cylinder
  • Porting: 90%
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Compatibility: Standard AEG gel blaster gearboxes
  • Recommended Use: Full-size / standard barrel gel blasters
  • Not Recommended For: Ultra-long DMR-style builds

For most standard rifle-length gel blasters, correct air volume matching ensures consistent performance and efficient compression. A 90% ported cylinder provides a near full-volume air supply while maintaining balanced airflow for common barrel lengths. Combined with the added durability of stainless steel construction, this cylinder offers a practical upgrade over typical aluminium alloy versions found in many stock builds.

products.description:
60% Ported Cylinder Stainless Steel

The 60% Ported Cylinder Stainless Steel is a precision gearbox upgrade designed to optimise air volume and improve performance in shorter barrel AEG gel blasters. Engineered to sit inside the gearbox housing, this cylinder works in conjunction with the piston assembly to compress air and drive gel balls down the inner barrel with consistent pressure and efficiency.

Unlike full-volume cylinders, the 60% ported design reduces the total available air capacity during the compression cycle. This controlled air reduction makes it ideal for CQB-style gel blasters and other short-barrel builds, where excessive cylinder volume can cause inefficiency and inconsistent output. By better matching cylinder volume to barrel length, this stainless steel unit helps create a more balanced air system for improved shot consistency and smoother operation.

Manufactured from high-grade stainless steel, the cylinder offers excellent durability and resistance to internal wear. The polished internal surface reduces friction against the piston O-ring, promoting better air seal and longer service life. Whether you are fine-tuning a compact M4 build, upgrading a PDW platform, or refreshing worn internal components, the 60% Ported Cylinder Stainless Steel is a smart choice for performance-focused builders who understand the importance of correct air volume matching.

60% Ported Cylinder Stainless Steel features:

  • 60% ported design optimised for shorter inner barrel setups
  • Ideal for CQB and compact AEG gel blaster builds
  • Precision stainless steel construction for durability
  • Smooth internal finish to support a strong air seal
  • Designed to work with standard AEG gearbox piston assemblies
  • Helps balance air volume to barrel length for improved consistency

60% Ported Cylinder Stainless Steel specs:

  • Porting: 60%
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Compatibility: Standard AEG gel blaster gearboxes
  • Recommended Use: Shorter barrel / CQB-style gel blasters

Matching cylinder volume to barrel length is critical in achieving efficient airflow and consistent firing performance. A 60% ported cylinder reduces excess air in short-barrel builds, helping to prevent over-volume inefficiencies and maintain smoother operation across repeated shots. Manually pressing the valve stem, (round disk in the centre of the shell base) WILL misalign the o-rings, and cause the shell to leak propellant gas from the top of the valve, inside the shell itself)

 

We have a saying here, 2 shells are never enough LOL. Why not add a few extra shells to your order, while you’re here. Please Note: Shells sold individually

Please note: This product contains timber (wood) as part of it’s design. Timber, being a natural product, does not always provide a 100% smooth and consistent finish and may have irregularities dues to grain direction, knot imperfections and general “softness” of timber, which makes it prone to marking easily. Also, in our harsh Australian climate, products containing timber should be stored out of direct sunlight, away from extremes in temperature fluctuations and protected from excessive exposure to humidity.

Care should be taken to keep timber in it’s best condition, timber needs to be maintained and “fed” using suitable timber oils, without any colourant of pigment, we suggest using Abbey Gun Solutions – Stock Finish. Click image below to add to your order.

Beautiful set of Angel Wings replica grips for your beloved gas 1911.

Suitable for: Blasters modelled on the Genuine Colt 1911 Models

Material factor: The handle’s texture cannot be exactly the same as the picture as each might be unique, please note before placing an order.

Fitment, these grips have been tested on the following models, and will fit any 1911 style Gel Blaster that is product to the Genuine Colt 1911 Pattern:

  • Golden Eagle
  • Double Bell
  • Any blaster made to the Genuine Colt 1911 external design Spec.

The Grips should fit any “standard” spec 1911 Grips (based on the original Colt 1911), and under the grips should be a completely flat inner surface, with the screw holes 79.6 mm apart.

 

Models that we know the grips WON’T fit:

  • We Tech
  • Armorer Works
  • Army Armament
  • Wells

 

Please note: This product contains timber (wood) as part of it’s design. Timber, being a natural product, does not always provide a 100% smooth and consistent finish and may have irregularities dues to grain direction, knot imperfections and general “softness” of timber, which makes it prone to marking easily. Also, in our harsh Australian climate, products containing timber should be stored out of direct sunlight, away from extremes in temperature fluctuations and protected from excessive exposure to humidity.

Care should be taken to keep timber in it’s best condition, timber needs to be maintained and “fed” using suitable timber oils, without any colourant of pigment, we suggest using Abbey Gun Solutions – Stock Finish. Click image below to add to your order.

Timber Stock Treatment

products.description:
We’re proud to introduce this awesome replica, of the Kimber Ultra Carry II, in stunning Flat Dark Earth.

This full metal and beautifully weighted replica feels great in the hand. It’s weight gives it the sense of being something more that just a simple toy, but more of an authentic replica of the real Kimber Ultra Carry II. KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II is constructed with a full metal, aluminium alloy, body with imitation wood (Nylon) grips. Some of the really cool attention to detail touches on this blaster, are the etched “Kimber” logo on the handle, plus the Kimber Model Number, engraved just above the trigger. Looking at this Manual Springer replica, against the real steel counterpart and it is hard to spot any differences. This is a must for collectors, who are looking for authenticity in their replicas. Other feature that definitely make this such a great replica, is the functioning beaver tail (grip) safety, and a thumb safety that prevents the slide from being racked.

And, as a couple of our competitive staff members often say, the look of amazement on the face of a player at a Gel Soft skirmish, who has spent thousands on an HPA super gun set up, that shoot 25+ gels per second, at over 300 fps, then you creep up on them and take them out with a single shot from a springer, is priceless. Here at X-Force we love bringing you gel blasters that are our of the ordinary.

The PPSh-41(Russian:–,tr.Pistol t-pulemy t Shp gina, ‘Shpagin’s machine-pistol’) is a Soviet submachine gun designed by Georgy Shpagin as a cheaper and simplified alternative to the PPD-40. products.name: KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II Manual Springer Gel Blaster – Black Mamba (Shadow Chrome)
products.short_description:
KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II Manual Springer Gel Blaster – Black Mamba

Type: Manual (Spring Powered) Gel blaster pistol
Material: Full metal build, with imitation wood handles (Nylon Polymer)
Colour: Shadow Chrome
Weight: 734g
products.description:
We’re proud to introduce this awesome replica, of the Kimber Ultra Carry II, in stunning Shadow Chrome.

This full metal and beautifully weighted replica feels great in the hand. It’s weight gives it the sense of being something more that just a simple toy, but more of an authentic replica of the real Kimber Ultra Carry II. KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II is constructed with a full metal, aluminium alloy, body with imitation wood (Nylon) grips. Some of the really cool attention to detail touches on this blaster, are the etched “Kimber” logo on the handle, plus the Kimber Model Number, engraved just above the trigger. Looking at this Manual Springer replica, against the real steel counterpart and it is hard to spot any differences. This is a must for collectors, who are looking for authenticity in their replicas. The only slight deviation from the real deal, is the inclusion of the word “stainless” on the slide, whereas this only appears on the silver version in real life. Other feature that definitely make this such a great replica, is the functioning beaver tail (grip) safety, and a thumb safety that prevents the slide from being racked.

The KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II is a manual “springer” style blaster, which means the slide needs to be racked for each shot, and make the firing configuration technically a single shot manual device. And, as a couple of our competitive staff members often say, the look of amazement on the face of a player at a Gel Soft skirmish, who has spent thousands on an HPA super gun set up, that shoot 25+ gels per second, at over 300 fps, then you creep up on them and take them out with a single shot from a springer, is priceless. Well, there’s no feeling quiet like that!!!

KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II Manual Springer Gel Blaster – Black Mamba Features:

  • Model: KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II Manual Springer Gel Blaster
  • Type: Manual, Mechanical, Spring-Powered (Single shot, rack the slide for each re-load)
  • Single-Shot Pull-Back Type.
  • 1:1 Ratio
  • Full Metal (aluminium Alloy) with Imitation wood grips.
  • Colour: Shadow Chrome.
  • Built in Hop-up
  • Spring fed, single stack, Magazine.
  • Magazine Capacity: Approx. 9 to 10 Gel Balls (dependant on Gel brand and variance in grown size)
  • Uses 7-8mm Gel Balls (sold Separately).

KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II Manual Springer Gel Blaster – Black Mamba Performance:

  • Up to 140 Feet per Second (Dependant on Gels)
  • Up to 15m Firing Distance
  • 1 Shot per Pull Back of the Slide, then to load the next gel the slide needs to be racked again.

Remember, one mag is never enough. Why not add a spare mag, or two, to your order and get your cart total over the free freight threshold.

Click image, to add the correct mag for your KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II to your order.

Please note: We highly recommend purchasing our high quality Hardened Gel Balls for the best performance, like our Tenacity AKA’s

Grab some Gels, while you’re here. You don’t have to pick these up, like you do the darts.

A really  cool add-on, would be a pistol speed loader, takes all the fiddly-ness out of getting the gels into the Magazine.

Pistol Speed Loader, a definite timer saver. Click image to add to order.

Only load Gel Balls into the magazine, DO NOT try to load mini darts into the Magazine, this will damage the gun and magazine. Mini darts should be pushed into the barrel only, in from the front of the pistol muzzle.

Manual pistols may not always feed gels consistently from the magazine into the barrel. You might experience issues such as double feeds (two gels at once), empty feeds (no gels), and normal feeds (one gel). These problems are quite common with manual pistols and are not defects; they are simply part of owning, manual spring fed Gel Blasters.

Always read the instruction on the gel packaging, and soak the gels in clean cold water for the specified time. Do not attempt to use Gels, that have not been soaked and have grown to their operational diameter.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

products.description:
CowCow Silver SS Guide Rod Set for TM spec G-Series Gel Blaster Pistols

The CowCow Silver SS Guide Rod Set for TM Spec G-Series Gel Blaster Pistols is a premium stainless steel recoil system designed for performance-focused G-Series pistol builds. CNC machining provides a strong, accurately finished guide rod assembly suitable for replacing or upgrading compatible factory components.

CowCow includes an enhanced recoil spring designed to increase return force and help the slide cycle more positively. This can provide a sharper, faster cycling action when correctly matched with the rest of the pistol’s setup.

The kit also includes four coloured buffer spacers, allowing experienced builders to tune the recoil system and reduce slide travel. Shortening the cycling distance can improve cycle speed and responsiveness, particularly in lightweight or competition-style Gel Blaster pistol builds.

Because recoil spring strength, slide weight, gas pressure and internal components all influence cycling, the ideal buffer configuration can vary between builds. Removing or adjusting buffers may therefore be necessary to achieve reliable Gel Ball feeding and correct slide operation.

Professional installation or fitting is recommended where required. For upgraded or custom TM-spec G-Series Gel Blaster pistols, the CowCow CCT-TMG-014 SS Guide Rod Set provides a high-quality foundation for tuning recoil response and cycling characteristics.

  • Four removable buffer spacers
  • Allows adjustment of slide travel

products.short_description:
Type: Adjustable hop up for gel blaster Assault Rifles and SMGs

Material: Metal

Colour: Black
products.description:
Do you want a metal hop up unit that works with a tracer but looks like a suppressor?

The next generation of the Aztech Muzzletek hop up is here
Designed and assembled in Australia!

-Suits blasters with up to 12mm of inner barrel protruding from outer barrel.
(Please note the 12mm, any more than 12mm and the inner barrel will make contact with the inner tongue of the hop unit and will either break the inner or push it out of its seat, we would recommend 10mm or 11mm maximum OR don’t turn the Muzzletek all the way onto your outer barrel to ensure it doesn’t make contact.)
-CNC machined outer casing from 6065 aluminium,
-Injection moulded ABS inner, tool less adjustment,
-14mm Counter clock wise outlet for additional accessory fitment i.e. tracer unit or amplifier
– CNC Cap to cover accessory thread if not used.

We have made the V2 to be the identical outer diameter as Acetech Lighter C tracer unit so once fitted it looks like a suppressor unit.

Is available in two options:
-14mm CCW long mount version for gel blaster Rifle platforms
-14mm CCW short mount version for gel blaster pistols

Pistol options:

-11mm counter clock wise adaptor Suits APS pistols
-12mm clockwise adaptor Suits WE Tech pistols

Hopup Material: CNC alloy outer case with ABS plastic inner

Adaptor Material: CNC 6065 aluminium

 

Long Rifle version Fitment Instructions:

  • Thread the Muzzletek in a reverse direct until threaded all the way on(maximum of 12mm) making sure to be careful that the inner barrel doesn’t make contact with the rear of the internal tongue. If it does make contact, unwind the hop until it has clearance.
  • It more than likely will not have perfect rotation alignment to set the hop ramp at 12 o’clock
  • Rotate to set the alignment correctly then use the side grub screws to hold the Muzzletek firmly in the correct position
  • To adjust the hop up, Turn the slotted end cap to lower the hop ramp, the cap rotates just 90 degrees offering 8 settings
  • If a permanent fixture we would recommend using a low strength Loctite to hold the side grub screws in place and if you wish a small amount on the main thread from hop to out barrel.

Note: Picture if for display purpose only, colour might be slightly different due to light variations.

products.description:
Here at X-Force we love bringing you gel blasters that are a little out of the ordinary and the MP40 is definitely in that category. For WWII imitation item collectors, this is a must have Gel Blaster.

With that said the MP40 submachine gun was one of the most iconic World War 2 guns of all time.

The MP 40 (Maschinenpistole 40) is a submachine gun chambered for the 9×19mm Parabellum cartridge. It was developed in Nazi Germany and used extensively by the Axis powers during World War II.

Designed in 1938 by Heinrich Vollmer with inspiration from its predecessor the MP 38, it was heavily used by infantrymen (particularly platoon and squad leaders), and by paratroopers, on the Eastern and Western Fronts as well as armoured fighting vehicle crews. Its advanced and modern features made it a favourite among soldiers and popular in countries from various parts of the world after the war. It was often called “Schmeisser” by the Allies, after Hugo Schmeisser, who designed the MP 18, although he was not involved in the design or production of the MP40. The weapon’s other variants included the MP 40/I and the MP 41. From 1940 to 1945, an estimated 1.1 million were produced by Erma Werke.

products.description:
The Winchester Model 1894 rifle (also known as the Winchester 94 or Model 94) is a lever-action repeating rifle that became one of the most famous and popular hunting rifles of all time. It was designed by John Browning in 1894.

The 1894 was produced by the Winchester Repeating Arms Company through 1980 and then by U.S. Repeating Arms under the Winchester brand until they ceased manufacturing rifles in 2006. Reproductions are being made by the Miroku company of Japan and imported into the United States by the Browning Arms company of Morgan, Utah.

The Model 1894 has been referred to as the “ultimate lever-action design” by firearms historians such as R. L. Wilson and Hal Herring. The Model 1894 is the rifle credited with the name “Winchester” being used to refer to all rifles of this type and was the first commercial sporting rifle to sell over 7,000,000 units.

The gel ball variant is just a replica with an imitation wood (Plastic) and metal body, using a spring design to power the blaster.  They don’t shoot very well and are aimed at mostly cosplayers and collectors, but  if you ever wanted one and loved playing cowboys and Indians as a kid then these are every boys dream.

products.name: AZTECH Hellfire CNC Hop Up
products.short_description:
Type: Adjustable hop up for gel blasters

Material: cnc Metal

Color: Black
products.description:
Hellfire!!!!!!  CNC Muzzle brake styling to enhance your blaster both visually and performance wise.

Using the same internal design and technology as our long proven Muzzletek hop up that changed the face of gel ball accuracy and range capabilities.  Now with the outstanding appearance to match the performance.

The Hellfire side ports disperse gases and vapor just like the real thing.  The Hellfire has Tool-less adjustment by turning the front face of the housing to apply more or less hop through a 90 degree adjustment rotation.

Universal fit for 14mm Counter clock wise thread for gel blaster rifle outer barrels and inner barrel maximum 12mm longer than the outer.

(Please note the 12mm, any more than 12mm and the inner barrel will make contact with the inner tongue of the hop unit and will either break the inner or push it out of its seat, we would recommend 10mm or 11mm maximum OR don’t turn the hellfire all the way onto your outer barrel to ensure it doesn’t make contact.)

This gel blasters hop up is CNC aluminum tough and will add that much needed distance to your new M4 and AK variant rifle.

Fitment Instructions:

  • Thread the Hellfire in a reverse direct until threaded all the way on(maximum of 12mm) making sure to be careful that the inner barrel doesn’t make contact with the rear of the internal tongue. If it does make contact, unwind the hop until it has clearance.
  • It more than likely will not have perfect rotation alignment to set the hop ramp at 12 o’clock
  • Rotate to set the alignment correctly then use the side grub screws to hold the Hellfire firmly in the correct position
  • To adjust the hop up, Turn the slotted end cap to lower the hop ramp, the cap rotates just 90 degrees offering 8 settings
  • If a permanent fixture we would recommend using a low strength loctite to hold the side grub screws in place and if you wish a small amount on the main thread from hop to out barrel.

Designed and hand assembled in Australia!

Hop up Material: CNC alloy outer cage 5 Axis CNC milled in our machine shop in                                   Taiwan.
: Injection molded Polypropylene inner tongue made in house here                               at Aztech Innovations

Adapter Material: Slotted CNC milled alloy

Thread of main hop up: M14 CCW

Adjustment: Tool-less, rotate the front face for adjustment

Fitment: 1.5mm Allen key for the 2x side locating grub screws.

Replacement Inserts are available Separately.

To replace the inner assembly of the adjustable tongue, remove the front adjuster cap, ensure to use substantial amount of heat to release the loctite holding the stainless grub screw for the adjuster cap.  If you don’t you may strip the 1.5mm Allen head grub screw. If you strip the stainless steel grub screw then there is a high chance of ruining the CNC outer to get it out.

Note: Picture if for display purpose only, color might be slightly different due to light variations.

products.name: AZTECH Air Pressure Activated Cylinder Head (APACHE)
products.short_description:
BENEFITS

  • No timing issues… ever!
  • Improved accuracy!
  • Max efficiency, max range, less turbulent flight.
  • Unique sound – everyone will know you are running an APACHE
  • No more broken return springs
  • No FPS loss from semi to auto modes
  • Adjustable nozzle length (4mm of adjustment) using spacers
  • Tappet plate and return spring no longer required
  • Includes stronger 0.9mm internal spring, 2mm and 3mm sorbo pads
products.description:
Here it is, the APACHE!  The first of its kind in the world, all air controlled driven by the piston.
-No mechanical forks or prongs to retract the nozzles,
-No timing issues,
-No broken return springs ,
-No broken tappet plates and best of all no fps droop on high rate of fire.

The all in one sealed cylinder head ensures perfect seal for max air flow and zero air loss with out any mechanical gear driven parts to create issues.

The APACHE produces extremely consistent high pressure air flow seen as a huge improvement in consistency of feet per second plus a noticeable improvement in accuracy thanks to reduced turbulence of the airflow through the tri port and past the aerodynamic “boat tail” internal nozzle, combined these streamline the airflow into the barrel and behind the gel, pushing the gel in a single uniform flow for max power.

Please note, using an APACHE DOES NOT increase the volume of your cylinder.  The APACHE doesn’t open be able to increase volume, it opens when cylinder pressure increases through the piston moving forward, then the air moves from the Cylinder forward into the APACHE, the volume doesn’t increase as it opens it moves.

To prevent risking damaging the APACHE nozzle we suggest do not fire the apache with the upper receiver off. 

BENEFITS

  • No timing issues… ever!
  • Improved accuracy!
  • Max efficiency, max range, less turbulent flight.
  • Unique sound – everyone will know you are running an APACHE
  • No more broken return springs
  • No FPS loss from semi to auto modes
  • Adjustable nozzle length (4mm of adjustment) using spacers
  • Tappet plate and return spring no longer required
  • Includes stronger 0.9mm internal spring, 2mm and 3mm sorbo pads

Tested and proven to feed perfectly with zero fps drop comparing semi auto to full auto all the way up to 85 rps on DSG and well over 500 fps on SSG.

The APACHE is a hi tech little piece of kit, we highly recommend only experienced AEG builders tackle an install and setup. The theory is very similar to HPA for tuning and airflow.  The process is definitely made easier with the Aztech Adjustable T piece to assist in setting the seal of the nozzle to the t piece while allowing for perfect feeding from the magazine.

APACHE comes with 2 springs, the 0.8mm spring is installed from new, it is the spring we favor for 99.99% of builds.

We recommend only using Ausgel Elite or AKA Extra Hard gels, softer gels and older gels will not be able to handle the high nozzle speed of the APACHE.

We also recommend a low strength loctite on the cap thread when you finally install it to ensure the top cap does not unscrew under high vibration environment.

-The body is made completely of 7075 CNC aluminum
-Nozzle made from CNC 7075 Aluminum
-All seals are Nitrile 70 duro rubber.
-Custom made 70 duro rubber tip.
-Anodized finish or raw machined finish

 

Note: Picture if for display purpose only, color might be slightly different due to light variations.

Extra shell sets are one of the most practical accessories you can own for your SRC CO2 revolver.

IN THE BOX

products.name: SRC Titan 6 Inch Revolver Gel Blaster – Black Version
products.short_description:
SRC Titan 6 Inch Revolver Gel Blaster – Black Version

Type: C02 Revolver Gel Blaster
Material: Plastic/Metal
Uses: 7 -8 mm gel ammo

An excellent addition is our Crosman CO2 gas, which you’ll need for this awesome Blaster to fire.
products.description:
SRC Titan 6 Inch Revolver Gel Blaster – Black Version Description

TITAN 6’ Revolver

A solid revolver by SRC made almost entirely of metal. Elements of the mechanism such as the hammer, trigger or the drum are also made of metal. The only polymer part is the pistol grip. The gel blaster has a realistic mock shell-feeding system into the rotary drum – exactly as in the case of a live revolver. Each shell carries a single gel. The set includes 6 shells and a dedicated speed loader that enables with a single motion place 6 shells in the drum.

The set also includes two metal RIS / Picatinny rails for attachment under the barrel or on top of it. Rails enable equipping the revolver with additional accessories such as optics or tactical lighting.

Drum release fulfils at the same time the role of safety, blocking the trigger and hammer from firing an accidental shot. Inside the pistol grip is room for a standard, 12 g CO2 capsule. In order to open the grip and install the capsule, no tools are necessary. Aiming is made easier by luminescent points on the revolver’s rear sight.

SRC Titan 6 Inch Revolver Gel Blaster – Black Version Features:

  • Metal Construction:
  • Smooth Cylinder Cycling
  • Black Finish
  • Polymer Grips
  •  Clean Double Action
  •  Co2 Powered

SRC Titan 6 Inch Revolver Gel Blaster – Black Version Specs:

  • Model: COR-801B-Gel
  • Colour: Black
  • Magazine Type: Revolver Drum
  • Power Source: Gas propulsion – CO2 12g
  • Recommended Gels: Dragon Orbz
  • Velocity: 400+ FPS
  • Materials Used: Metal & Polymer
  • Inner Barrel Material: Metal
  • Inner Barrel Length:
  • Inner Barrel ID:
  •  Blaster Length: 600mm
  • Blaster Weight: 950g

SRC Titan 6 Inch Revolver Gel Blaster – Black Version in the box:

  • 1 x SRC TITAN 6’ Revolver Gel Blaster – Black
  • 1 x Shell Loader
  • 2 x  Rails
  • 6 x Shells x6

Items you need to make the blaster work (that are NOT included)…

An excellent addition is our Crosman CO2 gas, which you’ll need for this awesome Blaster to fire.

The Gels that work the Besh with this revovler, are our Dragon Orbz Extreme Ultra Hard Gel Balls

  • 12g Co2 Non Threaded
  • Dragon Orbz Extreme Ultra Hard Gels. (These GBB pistols do not work efficiently with anything else)
  • Abbey “Gun” Oil – This is for maintenance.
  • Abbey 100% Silicone Grease/Lubricant

DISCLAIMER
Do not alter any part of your toy gel blaster as this will void the warranty. Alterations refer to pulling any of the blaster apart or opening it up, changing springs, upgrading the barrel to alloy, upgrading the battery from 7.4v to an 11.v battery or painting the gel blaster.

 

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

products.name: SRC Titan 2.5 Inch Revolver Gel Blaster – Black Version
products.short_description:
SRC Titan 2.5 Inch Revolver Gel Blaster – Black Version

Type: C02 Revolver Gel Blaster
Material: Plastic/Metal
Uses: 7 -8 mm gel ammo
products.description:
SRC Titan 2.5 Inch Revolver Gel Blaster – Black Version

A solid revolver by SRC made almost entirely of metal. Elements of the mechanism such as the hammer, trigger or the drum are also made of metal. The only polymer part is the pistol grip. The gel blaster has a realistic mock shell-feeding system into the rotary drum – exactly as in the case of a live revolver. Each shell carries a single gel. The set includes 6 shells and a dedicated speed loader that enables with a single motion place 6 shells in the drum.

Drum release fulfils at the same time the role of safety, blocking the trigger and hammer from firing an accidental shot. Inside the pistol grip is room for a standard, 12 g CO2 capsule. In order to open the grip and install the capsule, no tools are necessary. Aiming is made easier by luminescent points on the revolver’s rear sight.

SRC Titan 2,5 Inch Revolver Gel Blaster – Black Version Features:

  • Metal Construction
  • Smooth Cylinder Cycling
  • Black Finish
  • Polymer Grips
  •  Clean Double Action
  •  Co2 Powered

SRC Titan 2,5 Inch Revolver Gel Blaster – Black Version Specs:

  • Model: COR-803B-GEL
  • Colour: Black
  • Magazine Type: Revolver Drum
  • Power Source: Gas propulsion – CO2 12g
  • Recommended Gels: Dragon Orbz
  • Velocity: 340 FPS (Using Dragon Orbz)
  • Materials Used: Metal & Polymer
  • Inner Barrel Material: Metal
  • Inner Barrel Length:
  • Inner Barrel ID:
  •  Blaster Length: 200mm
  • Blaster Weight: 725g

SRC Titan 2,5 Inch Revolver Gel Blaster – Black version in the box:

  • 1 x SRC TITAN 2.5’ Revolver Gel Blaster – Black
  • 1 x Shell Loader
  • 6 x Shells x6

Items you need to make the blaster work (that are NOT included)…

An excellent addition is our Crosman CO2 gas, which you’ll need for this awesome Blaster to fire.

The Gels that work the Besh with this revovler, are our Dragon Orbz Extreme Ultra Hard Gel Balls

  • 12g Co2 Non Threaded
  • Dragon Orbz Extreme Ultra Hard Gels. (These GBB pistols do not work efficiently with anything else)
  • Abbey “Gun” Oil – This is for maintenance.
  • Abbey 100% Silicone Grease/Lubricant

DISCLAIMER
Do not alter any part of your toy gel blaster as this will void the warranty. Alterations refer to pulling any of the blaster apart or opening it up, changing springs, upgrading the barrel to alloy, upgrading the battery from 7.4v to an 11.v battery or painting the gel blaster.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

products.description:
The AIMS-74 is a Romanian clone of the Soviet AK-74. In the mid 1970s Soviet Union switched from 7.62×39 mm ammunition to 5.45×39 mm round and encouraged other nations from Warsaw Pact, including Romania, to follow. Development of the new Romanian assault rifle commenced in the mid 1980s. Interestingly though the Romanian AIMS-74 is not a license-produced version of the Soviet AK-74. This weapon was designed independently and had some indigenous modifications. It was adopted by Romanian armed forces in 1986 as the Pusca Automata model 1986. (PA md.86 or simply md.86). It became a standard-issue infantry rifle and gradually replaced the older AIM assault rifle (license-produced version of the Soviet AKM). It is used in this role ever since. As of 2016 Romania has not yet switched to standard NATO ammunition. Only Romanian special forces are using weapons chambered for the standard NATO 5.56×45 and 7.62×51 mm ammunition.

   The AIMS-74 is based on the previous AIM assault rifle, but chambered for the new 5.45×39 mm ammunition. It is a gas-operated, selective fire weapon. Interestingly though due to indigenous modifications the AIMS-74 is 600 g heavier than equivalent Soviet AKS-74 assault rifle.

   This Romanian assault rifle has a more complex firing mechanism than the Soviet AK-74 with an added 3-round burst firing mode. So the AIMS-74 is one of the few AK clones to have such capability. Though this more complex firing mechanism reportedly reduced reliability of the weapon.

   The AIMS-74 is rugged, simple in design and operation. Also this weapon is simple to maintain. It can be field stripped in one minute without using any tools.

The AK series is one of the most popular blasters around, if you’re an enthusiast or purchasing your first gel blaster, this is a great blaster to have in your collection.

Metal body, mag, gearbox and stock

The AKM (Russian:, tr. Avtomát Kalášnikova modernizírovannyj, lit. ‘Kalashnikov’s Automatic Rifle Modernised’) is an assault rifle designed by Soviet small arms designer Mikhail Kalashnikov in 1959. It is the most ubiquitous rifle of the Kalashnikov rifles. It was developed as a replacement to AK-47 introduced a decade prior.

Introduced into service with the Soviet Army in 1959, the AKM is the most prevalent variant of the entire AK series of firearms, and it has found widespread use with most member states of the former Warsaw Pact and its African and Asian allies as well as being widely exported and produced in many other countries. The production of these rifles was carried out at both the Tula Arms Plant and Izhmash. It was officially replaced in Soviet frontline service by the AK-74 in the late 1970s, but remains in use worldwide.

The AKM maintains the AK-47’s wood stock, but has simpler individual parts that are favourable for mass production. Like the AK-47, many variants of the AKM exist, such as the AKMS, AKML, and AKMP.

products.description:
[vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text woodmart_inline=”no” text_larger=”no”]

Double Bell Kalashnikov AKS-74N – 006A

The Double Bell Kalashnikov AK-74N 006A Gel Blaster combines traditional AK styling with substantial metal construction, genuine wood furniture and Double Bell’s proven V3 AEG platform. Designed for enthusiasts who prefer the classic appearance of an early AK-74-pattern rifle, the 006A delivers a particularly convincing combination of weight, materials and external detailing.

Unlike many lightweight AK-style gel blasters, Double Bell builds the 006A around a predominantly metal external structure. Metal components give the platform a solid feel, while the real wood furniture provides the traditional appearance associated with early AK-74 variants. Double Bell’s manufacturer specification for the 006A lists a metal-and-wood construction, while other current listings specifically identify steel receiver components and genuine wood furniture.

Internally, the Australian gel-blaster version uses a V3 metal gearbox with metal gears. Furthermore, the platform uses an 18:1 gear ratio, a stainless-steel gel barrel and a Mini Tamiya electrical connector. This familiar V3 layout gives owners an established AK-style AEG platform rather than an unusual proprietary drivetrain. Australian specifications list a 7.5 mm inner-barrel diameter and is ideally suited to hydrated gel balls, grown to between 7.4 and 7.5 mm.

The 006A also supports semi-automatic and full-automatic operation, together with a dedicated safety position. Therefore, players can switch between controlled single shots and automatic fire according to field rules and the situation. Australian retailers advertise performance of up to approximately 300 FPS, although actual results can vary with gel preparation, spring specification, seals, battery condition and individual production batches.

Another defining feature is the left-side AK optics mounting interface. Historically, the “N” suffix identified AK-74 variants designed to accept side-mounted night optics. Consequently, the side rail also gives the Double Bell replica an important visual detail that distinguishes the AK-74N pattern from a basic AK-74. Compatible AK side-mount adaptors can provide a mounting platform for suitable optics and accessories.

The full-length format, traditional muzzle assembly, classic sights and wood furniture create a distinctly Cold War-era AK appearance. In addition, the roughly three-kilogram platform weight gives the 006A substantially more presence than many nylon-bodied alternatives. Double Bell lists the underlying 006A platform at approximately 946 mm long and 3013 g, although minor differences can occur between gel-blaster production batches and regional versions.

Overall, the Double Bell 006A AK-74N Gel Blaster suits players and collectors looking for a traditional AK platform rather than a heavily modernised tactical build. Its real wood, extensive metal construction and proven V3 gearbox combine classic styling with a practical electric gel-blaster drivetrain.

Queensland Compliance Note

In Queensland, gel blasters do not require a weapons licence to possess. However, Queensland Police states that purchasers must be 18 years or older, new customers will be required to provide proof of age. Gel blasters must be stored securely in a locked container when not in use, and they should remain concealed from public view when transported. Laws differ elsewhere in Australia, and some jurisdictions prohibit or restrict possession. Customers should confirm the laws applying at their destination before purchasing.

Australian listings predominantly identify Double Bell model 006A as the AK-74N. Historically, “AKS-74N” refers to the folding-stock version, while the AK-74N uses a fixed stock and side optics interface. For search compatibility, however, both names may appear in online listings.

Yes, it only has the power of the manual spring and isn’t going to shoot a gel at tremendous speed, for many many meters. But what it does have, is a truly beautiful finish, and puts a blaster into your hand that has the authentic look and feel of the real steel item. And, as a couple of our competitive staff often say, the look of amazement on the face of a player at a Gel Soft skirmish, who has spent thousands on an HPA super gun set up, that shoot 25+ gels per second, at over 300 fps, then you creep up on them and take them out with a single shot from a springer, is priceless. Well, there’s no feeling quiet like that!!!

  • Model: KELe Desert Eagle 50cal Manual Gel Blaster – Silver
  • Type: Manual, Mechanical, Spring-Powered
  • Single-Shot Pull-Back Type (Slide needs to be re-racked after every shot)
  • 1:1 Ratio
  • Exquisitely designed Metal Slide and Nylon Polymer lower
  • Mag Fed
  • Magazine Capacity: Approx. 17 Gel Balls
  • Uses 7-8mm Gel Balls (sold Separately)
  • Comes with 10 darts

Performance:

  • Up to 160 Feet per Second
  • Up to 20m Firing Distance
  • 1 Shot per Pull Back of Slide

What’s the thing everyone loses? Yep, the little foam darts. Why not add an extra 10 pack, or two, of foam darts while you’re here.

Get some Spare Darts, ya know you’ll lose some 🙂

Please note: We highly recommend purchasing our high quality Hardened Gel Balls for the best performance, like our Tenacity AKA’s

Grab some Gels, while you’re here. You don’t have to pick these up, like you do the darts.

A really  cool add-on, would be a pistol speed loader, takes all the fiddly-ness out of getting the gels into the Magazine.

Pistol Speed Loader, a definite timer saver. Click image to add to order.

Only load Gel Balls into the magazine, DO NOT try to load mini darts into the Magazine, this will damage the gun and magazine. Mini darts should be pushed into the barrel only, in from the front of the pistol muzzle.

Manual pistols may not always feed gels consistently from the magazine into the barrel. You might experience issues such as double feeds (two gels at once), empty feeds (no gels), and normal feeds (one gel). These problems are quite common with manual pistols and are not defects; they are simply part of owning, manual spring fed Gel Blasters.

Always read the instruction on the gel packaging, and soak the gels in clean cold water for the specified time. Do not attempt to use Gels, that have not been soaked and have grown to their operational diameter.

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

products.description:
X-Force CNC machined v2 gearbox shell designed and manufactured specifically for gel blasters.

CNC split gearbox V2 designed for Gel blasters M4, M16 and other ones with V2 gearbox. This gearbox is manufactured from one solid block of aircraft aluminium 7075, which has higher strength, than common construction steel. Because of used material, our gearboxes have the much more durability and resilience than common zinc-aluminium gearboxes.

Split gearbox means, that this gearbox is designed as a two part, Upper and Lower. Having a split gearbox has many advantages. For example much more easy installation of the inner parts into the gearbox. During setups of you cylinder set, there is no need of removing whole gearbox from your receiver, only upper part can be dismounted, because it‘s mounted on one receiver pin.

Package includes: X-Force CNC Split Gearbox V2 (9mm) with pre-installed bushes –  set of screws and spring guide.

V2 Receivers compatibility:

SLR
X-Power (BD556, Magpul)
TTM
Warinterest

 

NOTE:

Installation of the inner parts and gearbox requires professional knowledge, experience and skills. There are a lot of manufacturers on the market and every one of them create their own sizes, there are no standards like engineering ISO in gel blasters.

The M1911, also known as the Colt 1911, or the Colt Government, is a single-action, semi-automatic, magazine-fed, recoil-operated pistol chambered for the .45 ACP cartridge. It served as the standard-issue sidearm for the United States Armed Forces from 1911 to 1985. It was widely used in World War I, World War II, the Korean War, and the Vietnam War.

Designed by John Browning, the M1911 is the best-known of his designs to use the short recoil principle in its basic design. The pistol was widely copied, and this operating system rose to become the preeminent type of the 20th century and of nearly all modern centrefire pistols.

products.description:
Abbey Predator Mini Ultra Green Gas (270ml)

Abbey Ultra Gas is our mid-power airsoft gas designed to keep your rifle’s muzzle energy under control in those warmer climates. It’ll also help elevate the muzzle energy of lightweight plastic pistols in the colder weather where it may be too cold for a less powerful gas, such as 144a.

Medium Pressure 

Ultra Gas is the perfect pressure to reduce the muzzle energy of an airsoft rifle that’s firing too high on a hot day when using a stronger airsoft gas, like Abbey Vertex.

However, it’s strong enough to keep light plastic airsoft pistols cycling when it gets too cold for lighter airsoft gases, such as Abbey 144a.

Suspended Lubricant

Abbey airsoft/gel blaster gases feature a suspended lubricant. This lubricant is designed to remain suspended in the gas and doesn’t settle in the bottle or magazine. This means there’s no need to shake the bottle before refilling, and the lubricant constantly keeps O-rings fresh and sealed whilst the magazine is charged.

Other lubricants found in gases, such as silicone, will settle to the bottom of the can and magazine and cause potential operation problems between metal components.

A little info on the mosfet:

You can only program the 2 round burst setting it seems. Put it into the 2 round setting Pull the trigger and hold until it starts to vibrate then pull the trigger to change the setting. Each pull will cycle it to the next setting. It will vibrate a pattern to let you know what setting you are on. After you choose your setting switch it to full auto to save it. It seems to go into program mode on semi but it won’t save the setting.
So you can only reprogram the 2 round burst setting. It can be single through to 5 round burst. You can also set it to be a binary trigger (pull the trigger 1 shot, release the trigger 1 shot).
Also holding the trigger for 8 seconds will allow you turn off the automatic mag prime.

products.name: Abbey Silicone Gun Oil 35 Aerosol Can 150ml
products.short_description: Type: Gun Oil for your gas powered gel blasters
products.description:
Abbey Silicone Gun Oil is our high-quality, low-viscosity silicone-based lubricant perfect for gas, electric and spring gel blasters. Silicone Gun Oil has multiple uses, from forming a protective barrier against the elements, through to rejuvenating o-rings and lubricating plastic components.

The lubricant is silicone based, so unlike mineral oils it won’t dry out over time and it’s low-viscosity means it easily forms a protective barrier across any surface.

It comes in small 30ml dropper bottles or in this handy 150 ml aerosol can.

Keep O-Rings Sealed

O-rings need oil to keep up a perfect seal. Our dropper bottles are perfect to apply small amounts directly onto o-rings during disassembly, cleaning and maintenance. Alternatively, our spray bottles are great for getting into tight spaces, or dousing valves in oil.

Protective barrier

A small protective barrier of Silicone Gun Oil can be applied to exposed raw metal to inhibit corrosion. The protective oil barrier rejects moisture, grease, and dirt, and prevents rust and oxidation from penetrating the metal. Apply directly to the metal or liberally onto a cloth for wiping down.

Plastic Lubricant

Lubricants designed for use where two metals contact are ineffective when used on plastic. The low viscosity of our Silicone Gun Oil means it can eliminate friction on plastic components such as tappet plates, triggers, blowback-housings etc.

Non-harmful to Wood

Wood furniture on your gun can easily be damaged by mineral oils. The mineral oil soaks in and compromises the strength, eventually leading to failure. Silicone oil will not penetrate wood and does not damage it over time. Your expensive wood furniture is safe around silicone oil.

Check out the videos from the boyz at Abbeys which some great tips and how to use the gas.

products.name: Leviathan – V3 Optical Mosfet
products.short_description:
PACKING:
– Leviathan – NGRS drop-in electronic module with complete wiring to front or above the gearbox
– 2x Screw with washer for securing device in the gearbox
– 2x foams for hair-trigger mode (2x 1mm height and 2x 2mm height)
– Real feel trigger system (RFTS) spring
– Sheet with selector plate stickers
– Black Leviathan sticker 40 mm
– Installation manual in English
products.description:
The Leviathan – V3 optical is one of the most advanced ETU (electronic trigger unit) on the market

It has all optical sensors for better handling and durability

Built-in wireless communication for quick setup using iOS or Android smartphones!

Foam on the trigger makes great hair trigger mode

Unique Real feel trigger system (RFTS), spring simulates trigger resistance like in the real AK74. It adds secondary resistance with release after the fire. RFTS was designed by professional gunsmith for more realistic feel from shooting

External input port and output pads serves for custom accessories

Real time response for change settings -> immediately test result

Easy installation into the gearbox instead of the original trigger contacts

Completely made wiring allows the fastest and the easiest installation into the gun. No soldering is needed

New functions are for free for every user via online update

 

MAIN FUNCTIONS:
– Adds new shooting modes independent for every position on the fire selector (SAFE – SEMI – AUTO)
– Three adjustable bursts (range 2 – 20 shots)
– It preserves empty magazine detection like the original gun
– Rate of fire can be reduce to 40%. It add breaks between shots to reduce RoF. It gives fast trigger response even with very low rate of fire, just like in a real gun
– Adjustable strength active braking (can be disabled)
– Pre-cocking function for instant shot on SEMI fire
– Delay between shots adds time in which isn’t possible to shoot, it simulates the delay from gun reload or recoil (range 0,1 – 4,0 seconds)
– Electronic fuse set sensitivity for high current detection to avoid any damage if something goes wrong
– Low battery indication for 2S – 4S li-pol and 3S – 4S li-fe
– Virtual magazine simulates low capacity magazines, it will force the gun to stop shooting when it reach 0. There can be set warning after shot before empty magazine and how it will be reloaded
– On the board is input port for controlling external devices or Leviathan and output pads for powering the hop-up chamber BBs illumination, powering electric magazine, flashlight, etc.
– Statistics screen shows shooting output with cycle timing, motor current consumption, rate of fire and temperatures. It allows you to do fine-tune gearbox upgrade
– Application shows actual battery voltage value. Color lines indicates battery charge status where green is OK, orange will warn after each shot and red will not allow to shoot
– User can save multiple settings under profiles
– Update function fixes bugs and adds new features to the device
– There are three shot counters. Total count every shot during the device lifetime. User counter can be reset by user anytime. Power-up counter is reset by battery connection
– Error log shows errors made during the device life also can be erased by user
– For better security wireless connection can be disable by the selector switch (can be deactivated)
– Leviathan monitors current, voltage and temperature to avoid any damage when something go wrong.
– Motor vibrates and beeps as a feedback for user
– Programmed settings are saved in the Leviathan memory immediately after their change, so you can immediately test it and settings aren’t lost when is battery disconnected or lost connection with smartphone
– New functions are for free for every user via online update function

 

SAFETY WARNING:
– Installation of this device into the gearbox requires advanced technician skills!
– Please read these informations before installing your device to prevent any damage.
– Short circuit or incorrectly connected battery will cause immediate damage to the device which is not covered by the warranty. It can lead to fire or even battery explosion.
– Disconnect battery, when you aren’t using the gun! Otherwise you will fully discharge the battery. Because the device drains small amount of current from the bettery all the time.
– Do not connect battery when gun pointing towards you, another person or an animal.
– Do not modify, repair and put into any kind of liquids or thermal shock the Leviathan – V3.

products.name: UDL Benelli XM1014 Shotgun Gel Blaster
products.short_description:
UDL Benelli XM1014 Shotgun Gel Blaster

Type: The ultimate Wall Hanger or Collectable Shotgun Gel Blaster

Material: Nylon and metal

Uses: 7 – 8 mm gel
products.description:
UDL Benelli XM1014 Shotgun Gel Blaster

The UDL Benelli XM1014 Shotgun Gel Blaster is a 1:1 ratio shotgun build, shell eject, full nylon construction with some metal parts.  Not a strong performer but awesome looking John Wick shotgun for those that like to cosplay or just collect.

Channel cinematic style with the UDL Benelli XM1014 Shotgun Gel Blaster — a faithful 1:1 scale, shell-ejecting pump-action replica ideally built for cosplay, wall-hanger display and can be used for light field use, but it’s low FPS would be a disadvantage. Constructed primarily from durable nylon with selected alloy (metal) components, the XM1014 nails the look and feel of the real Benelli XM1014 while remaining safe and legal when used with standard gel balls and in accordance with local field rules.

This mechanical, spring-powered pump-action fires a single shell at a time; each shell propels a small burst (factory spec: from1 to 3 gel balls per shell), giving a tactile, staged shooting experience rather than high-volume suppressive fire. Shell-ejection and the true-to-scale profile make it an exceptional prop for reenactments, film work or John-Wick-style cosplay — and a handsome addition to any collector’s rack. Performance is modest (≈100–120 FPS) with an effective practical range of 10–15 metres, so the XM1014 is best used as a themed CosPlay Prop or display piece rather than a primary skirmish weapon.

We recommend genuine gel balls and eye protection at all times, and checking your local fields and state legal requirements before purchase and use. The blaster ships with user instructions and typical retail packaging; spare shells and very basic eyewear. If you want authentic looks first and foremost — and a safe, tactile shooting prop — the UDL XM1014 is a top choice.

UDL Benelli XM1014 Shotgun Gel Blaster

  • 1:1 scale Benelli XM1014 replica — authentic silhouette and ergonomics.
  • Mechanical spring-powered pump-action with shell ejection.
  • Each pump fires one shell (factory fill: 3 gel balls per shell).
  • Primary construction: nylon body with selected alloy/metal parts for key wear points.
  • 100–120 FPS (manufacturer average) — ideal for cosplay & casual field use.
  • Effective shooting range: 10–15 metres.
  • Great as a prop for cosplay, film, display or light, themed skirmishes.
  • Spare shells, gel beads and safety gear sold separately.

UDL Benelli XM1014 Shotgun Gel Blaster features:

  • Manufacturer: UDL
  • Model: Benelli XM1014 (replica gel blaster)
  • Type: Mechanical, spring-powered, pump-action, shell-ejecting
  • Scale: 1:1 ratio (full scale)
  • Ammo / Shell: Shell cartridge system — 3 gel balls per shell (typical)
  • Power: ~100–120 FPS (factory figure)
  • Effective Range: 10–15 m
  • Primary Materials: Nylon body / alloy (metal) components
  • Overall Length: 89 cm (manufacturer listing)
  • Toy gun size (listed): 66 × 31 × 79 cm
  • Package size: 76 × 29 × 8 cm
  • Includes:
    • 1 × UDL Benelli XM1014 gel blaster
    • 6 x Gel Balls Shotgun Shells
    • 1 x pair basic safety eyewear.

We chose to stock the UDL Benelli XM1014 Shotgun Gel Blaster because it delivers museum-quality looks and prop realism at an affordable price — ideal for players who prioritise appearance, cosplay, accurate appearance and collectible value, over raw field performance and high FPS figures.

Please note: This Gel Blaster shotgun is practically impossible to upgrade to higher FPS and is ideally suited for CosPlay, themed events and TV Work, rather than for high powered skirmish action.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

MI-Style AK Metal Side Mount Picatinny Scope Rail (no markings)

The MI-Style AK Metal Side Mount Picatinny Scope Rail is a robust optics mounting solution designed for AK-style platforms fitted with a side receiver rail. Built from durable metal construction, this mount clamps securely to the factory side dovetail and provides a stable 20mm Picatinny top rail for red dots, scopes, magnifiers and other tactical optics.

This side-mounted system allows users to modernise their AK platform without replacing the dust cover or making permanent modifications. Once installed, the mount positions your optic centrally over the bore axis, improving sight alignment and maintaining consistent zero when properly secured.

Unlike lightweight alloy or stamped alternatives, this MI-style mount delivers increased rigidity and stability. The reinforced metal construction helps minimise movement under recoil and supports a wide range of optic weights. The integrated Picatinny rail accepts most standard 20mm Weaver/Picatinny compatible optics, making it a versatile upgrade for range shooting, tactical training or modern AK builds.

Installation is straightforward via the side clamp system, allowing the mount to be removed and reinstalled when required.

Key Features of the MI-Style AK Metal Side Mount Picatinny Scope Rail

  • Durable full metal construction
  • Side dovetail clamp attachment system
  • Integrated 20mm Picatinny / Weaver rail
  • Positions optic above dust cover
  • Secure lock-up for improved stability
  • Compatible with AK platforms featuring side receiver rail

Traditional AK platforms rely on iron sights, but modern optics significantly improve target acquisition speed and shooting precision. A side-mounted Picatinny rail provides a stable mounting platform without replacing the dust cover or modifying the receiver.

Side rail mounts generally offer better stability than dust cover rail systems, helping maintain zero and improving repeatability if removed and reinstalled correctly.

products.description:
Abbey Silicone Gun Grease is our high-viscosity silicone lubricant, designed specifically for use in gel blasters, air guns and firearms. Silicone Gun Grease is perfect for reducing the friction within fast moving plastic parts of the rifle or pistol.

Our silicone grease does not degrade over time, it won’t harden or reduce its effectiveness. It maintains a consistent and fluid covering over friction surfaces and because silicone is inert, it won’t damage their surfaces.

Abbey Silicone Gun Grease comes in 20ml handy pots for your tool box or bag. If you’re looking for a lubricant to lubricate the metal parts of your firearm or airgun, you’ll need our moly gun grease.

Nourishes O-Rings

Versatile Lubrication
Our Silicone Grease is a low load, high-viscosity grease that clings to surfaces, making it perfect for parts which move or rotate quickly. The lubricant is particularly well suited to reducing friction between plastic parts or between metal and plastic.

products.short_description:
Abbey Ultra Gas is our mid-power airsoft gas designed to keep your rifle’s muzzle energy under control in those warmer climates. It’ll also help elevate the muzzle energy of lightweight plastic pistols in the colder weather where it may be too cold for a less powerful gas, such as 144a.

Bottles are available in 700 ml large bottles. These bottles also come with an o-ring friendly polymer fill nozzle. This helps protect fill valve o-rings from damage when filling in cold climates.
products.description:
Abbey Ultra Gas is our mid-power airsoft gas designed to keep your rifle’s muzzle energy under control in those warmer climates. It’ll also help elevate the muzzle energy of lightweight plastic pistols in the colder weather where it may be too cold for a less powerful gas, such as 144a.

Medium Pressure 
Ultra Gas is the perfect pressure to reduce the muzzle energy of an airsoft rifle that’s firing too high on a hot day when using a stronger airsoft gas, like Abbey Vertex.

However, it’s strong enough to keep light plastic airsoft pistols cycling when it gets too cold for lighter airsoft gases, such as Abbey 144a.

Suspended Lubricant

Abbey airsoft/gel blaster gases feature a suspended lubricant. This lubricant is designed to remain suspended in the gas and doesn’t settle in the bottle or magazine. This means there’s no need to shake the bottle before refill, and the lubricant constantly keeps o-rings fresh and sealed whilst the magazine is charged.

Other lubricants found in gases, such as silicone, will settle to the bottom of the can and magazine and cause potential operation problems between metal components.

Skirmishable Size

Abbey Ultra Gas comes in our standard 700ml size for maximum refills.

products.description:
Abbey Sniper Gas is our specialist gas designed specifically for use in sniper rifles and DMRs. It’s our highest-pressure gas,  so it’s perfect for producing high and consistent FPS.

However, our Sniper Gas Contains no lubricant, so there’s no chance for the lubricant to affect accuracy. Sniper gas comes in our 700 ml gas bottles for plenty of refills and features a metal fill nozzle for additional strength.

 

Please Note: The product contains No Lubricant mixed with the gas.
Abbey Sniper Gas has absolutely no lubricant in it. Whilst the lubricants in our gases are designed not to make their way into your hop-up, there’s always a chance, and that can affect accuracy. Our sniper gas is completely dry, therefore there’s absolutely no chance of lubricant getting into your hop-up and affecting accuracy and range.

Because of this, we recommend you service your magazines regularly, or store them using Abbey Maintenance Gas.

High Pressure

Sniper Gas is one of the highest-pressure gases we produce. It’s formulated to maintain FPS even at the lower temperatures that more airsoft gases struggle with. The high pressure means that the gas is stable for longer, your follow up shots are consistent FPS and accurate.

Resistant to Cool Down

The higher pressure means that the gas is less susceptible to the cool down affect and colder temperatures. Your FPS remains stable even in the cooler temperatures where other gases would struggle.

products.name: Abbey Silicone Gun Oil 35 (30ml)
products.short_description: Type: Gun Oil for your gas powered gel blasters
products.description:
Abbey Silicone Gun Oil is our high-quality, low-viscosity silicone-based lubricant perfect for gas, electric and spring gel blasters. Silicone Gun Oil has multiple uses, from forming a protective barrier against the elements, through to rejuvenating o-rings and lubricating plastic components.

The lubricant is silicone based, so unlike mineral oils it won’t dry out over time and it’s low-viscosity means it easily forms a protective barrier across any surface.

It comes in small 30ml dropper bottles.

Keep O-Rings Sealed

O-rings need oil to keep up a perfect seal. Our dropper bottles are perfect to apply small amounts directly onto o-rings during disassembly, cleaning and maintenance. Alternatively, our spray bottles are great for getting into tight spaces, or dousing valves in oil.

Protective barrier

A small protective barrier of Silicone Gun Oil can be applied to exposed raw metal to inhibit corrosion. The protective oil barrier rejects moisture, grease, and dirt, and prevents rust and oxidation from penetrating the metal. Apply directly to the metal or liberally onto a cloth for wiping down.

Plastic Lubricant

Lubricants designed for use where two metals contact are ineffective when used on plastic. The low viscosity of our Silicone Gun Oil means it can eliminate friction on plastic components such as tappet plates, triggers, blowback-housings etc.

Non-harmful to Wood

Wood furniture on your gun can easily be damaged by mineral oils. The mineral oil soaks in and compromises the strength, eventually leading to failure. Silicone oil will not penetrate wood and does not damage it over time. Your expensive wood furniture is safe around silicone oil.

products.short_description:
Type:

Abbey Predator Gun Gas 144 A is a high performance gas for lighter guns and indoor games

It provides ideal power and performance without damaging guns.

It’s specially blended lubricant UPL ensures all seals and moving parts are kept in top condition to provide improved power and performances.

Abbey Predator Gun Gas 144 A is the environmentally friendly and safe alternative to 134 A gas.

Ultimate gas for power and performance in warm weather
products.description:
Abbey Maintenance Gas is designed for the maintenance and storage of your gas gel blaster magazines. It’s highly lubricated, low pressure and specifically designed to refresh and revive the internals of your gas magazines. Maintenance Gas comes in our small 270ml bottles, perfect for slipping into a tool box or kit bag.

Storage
Abbey Maintenance Gas is low pressure and filled with our suspended lubricant. The lubricant stays dissolved in the gas and constantly nourishes the o-rings and seals within the magazine, regardless of whether your store it upside-down or on its side. The gas prevents your magazines from drying out and developing a leak during storage.  Note:  Great idea to leave a small amount of gas in your mag when once finished using it and in storage to keep your o-rings lubed up.

Maintenance

If you’re constantly using a dry gas, like our Sniper Gas, or raw propane, you will need to occasionally self-lubricate the o-rings between uses. This can be a laborious process and you’re not always guaranteed to lubricate 100% of the seals and o-rings. Our Maintenance Gas has the lubricant dissolved in the Gas, anywhere the gas goes, so does the lubricant. This means it’s the perfect gas to re-lubricate and seal internal o-rings, valves and seals within gas magazines.

Repair

If you’re already suffering from a magazine that leaks, there’s a good chance that it’s because the o-rings have dried and are no-longer holding their seal properly. Maintenance Gas works its way to these o-rings and nourishes them with oil, causing them to re-seal. A quick and simple way of bringing your Gel blasters back to life.

Check out the videos from the boyz at Abbeys which some great tips and how to use the gas.
