Abbey Predator Gun Gas 144 A is the environmentally friendly and safe alternative to 134 A gas.

Ultimate gas for power and performance in warm weather
products.description:
Abbey 144a Gas is our lightweight gas. Its low-pressure formula means it’s perfect for gel blasters that require a lower pressure gas due to their plastic construction, whilst still maintaining a skirmishable FPS. It’s also fantastic for keeping your FPS within site limits on those particularly hot days.

Available in our 700ml gas bottles and features a polymer fill nozzle to protect fragile o-rings in colder conditions.

Gel Blasters

Low Pressure for Lightweight Gel Blasters144a gas is an environmentally responsible alternative to 134a gas. It’s a lower pressure than our other gases, like Ultra and Vertex gas, which means that it’s suitable for plastic gel blasters or use during hot weather to keep your FPS under site limits.

Suspended Lubricant

Our gases feature a lubricant that dissolves within the gas, unlike silicone, which sits in the bottom of the tin and magazine. Since the lubricant stays suspended in the gas, it’s constantly nourishing the o-rings within the gel blaster, regardless of magazine’s orientation, meaning there’s a more consistent air-seal and less chance of an o-ring failure.

Hot Weather Gas

Higher pressure gases have the tendency to have too much pressure in hot weather, it increases FPS and puts unnecessary stress on a gel blasters internal components. By using a lower pressure gas like our 144a gas, you can maintain a site-legal FPS and reduce the stress on internal parts of your gel blaster without needing to take your gun apart to change parts.

NOTE:  DUE TO BEING A FLAMMABLE MATERIAL WE CAN NOT SHIP THIS EXPRESS BY AIR, IF YOU CHOOSE EXPRESS WE WILL STILL SEND IT STANDARD SHIPPING.

WADSN Black TGD QD Long Shrapnel Foregrip

The WADSN Black TGD QD Long Shrapnel Foregrip gives Gel Blaster users a full-length vertical grip for rifles equipped with a standard 20mm Picatinny or Weaver-style accessory rail. WADSN lists this model as the TGD QD Long Vertical Grip, while the Black version carries manufacturer part number MP01007-BK

WADSN closely follows the well-known TangoDown BGV-QD series of vertical foregrips with this distinctive design. In this product family, TGD commonly refers to the TangoDown-style design, while QD stands for Quick Detach. WADSN produces this grip as an aftermarket reproduction rather than a genuine TangoDown product.

The side-mounted quick-detach lever provides one of the grip’s most useful features. Its layout follows the locking throw-lever concept used on genuine TangoDown BGV-QD grips. products.name: Perun V2 Hybrid Mosfet
products.short_description:
Type: Mosfet for gel blastershybridv2

Materials: electrical wire/circuit board
products.description:
Perun V2 Hybrid replaces mechanical contacts in your airsoft replica or gel blaster and provides lots of useful features. Optical and magnetic sensors allow to eliminate many moving parts that are prone to damage, thus increasing the reliability. Adaptive trigger control allows switching from a very short trigger travel to a long one even in the field, with almost any trigger, including stock ones.
Works without the need for any modification with most V2 gearboxes in Tokyo Marui standard. For details and exceptions please refer to the manual.

Perun V2 Hybrid Mosfet Features;

  • Adjustable trigger sensitivity – The trigger can be set to 5 sensitivity levels, ranging from very short pull needed to fire a shot, to a very long one. No modification to the trigger or the gearbox is needed and the trigger sensitivity change is possible even in the field.
  • Independently programmed firing modes – Program the firing modes any way you like, setting safe, semi, burst or auto on both selector positions.
  • Active brake – active brake stops the motor after each shot preventing spring compression or in case of replicas with high rate of fire, over spin (double shot problem).
  • Pre-cocking – Fast trigger response can be a matter of victory or defeat, especially in CQB situations. With pre-cocking enabled, piston will remain in rear position after each shot with the spring already compressed, ensuring that next shot will be fired immediately after you pull the trigger. To release the spring after using pre-cocking, pull the trigger and hold it for 2 seconds, after which a second shot will be fired, this time with no pre-cocking and fully braked.
  • 2-stage trigger – Light trigger pull results with a single shot or burst, while a deeper pull will cause a burst or fully automatic fire. Following modes are available: semi – burst, semi – auto and burst – auto.
  • Binary trigger – Allows for easy double shots in semi-automatic setting. After enabling this mode, if semi-automatic fire is set, shots will be fired not only when the trigger is pulled, but also when it is released.
  • Rate of fire reduction – Reduce the rate of fire in automatic or burst fire to save ammo or make the replica shoot in a more realistic fashion.
  • DMR mode – Introduces intervals between semiautomatic shots to comply with DMR rules on some fields.
  • Low battery voltage alarm – Dedicated for Li-Po and Li-Ion batteries. Should the battery voltage fall to a dangerously low level, user will be notified by short sound signals that are repeated every minute. This may also be freely switched on and off.
  • DSG – a sector gear detection mode specially prepared to work with dual sector gears.
  • Diagnostic system – Constantly monitors the replica and the mosfet itself. In case of any problems, immediately lets you know what it might be, making troubleshooting much easier.
  • Electronic fuse – Will save your replica and battery in case of a major malfunction. It will automatically disconnect the battery when a short circuit or blocked motor is detected.

Programming of all the settings is done solely by using quick and easily memorable sequences of fire selector switching and trigger pulls supported by sound signals and multicolour LED diode. That allows changing the settings in any moment, in a matter of seconds, even under enemy fire. All settings are set independently for each selector position, so you can program the mosfet exactly the way you want, for example semi on semi and binary trigger on auto.
Perun V2 Hybrid works without problems with any battery from 7V do 17V. It can also be used with most extreme setups.

The 6–9 Inch Harris BR2 Metal Bipod is a durable, spring-loaded rifle bipod designed for stable prone and bench shooting. Featuring quick deploy legs and adjustable height from 6 to 9 inches, it delivers reliable support for gel blasters, airsoft rifles and rimfire-style platforms using sling swivel stud mounting.

Stable. Adjustable. Reliable. The 6–9 Inch BR2 Metal Bipod delivers rapid deployment and rock-solid support for precision-focused builds.

6–9 Inch Harris BR2 Metal Bipod Specifications:

products.description:
6–9 Inch Harris BR2 Metal Bipod with Quick Deploy Spring Legs – Adjustable Rifle Mount

The 6–9 Inch Harris BR2 Metal Bipod with Quick Deploy Spring Legs gives your rifle a stable, controlled shooting platform the moment you need it. Built in the classic BR2 style, this bipod keeps your setup low to the ground, making it ideal for prone and bench shooting. Precision-focused gel blaster and airsoft players rely on this height range for consistent front-end support without adding bulk.

Solid metal construction delivers strength and long-term durability while keeping overall weight practical for field use. With a simple press of the release button, the spring-loaded legs snap down instantly. You can adjust the height between 6 and 9 inches to match terrain, shooting benches, or uneven ground. This fast adjustment helps you stay on target and ready for follow-up shots. It is a dual fit design, to either clamp directly onto the dome style sling mount on old-school long rifles, or has a Picatinny Adaptor Mount, to add the dome mount to a modern Picatinny-equipped DMR setup.

The fixed BR2 base eliminates unnecessary movement and keeps your rifle steady during firing. Rubberised feet grip hard surfaces and outdoor terrain, improving control across multiple environments. When you finish shooting, fold the legs forward for compact transport and storage. Whether you run a DMR-style gel blaster or a precision airsoft rifle build, this bipod adds practical stability without overcomplicating your setup.

At X-Force Tactical in Brisbane, we recommend the 6–9 inch BR2 bipod for players who want reliable support and clean integration with sling swivel stud mounts. It delivers simple mechanics, proven stability, and dependable performance every time you deploy it.

6–9 Inch Harris BR2 Metal Bipod Key Features

  • Adjustable height from 6 to 9 inches
  • Quick-deploy spring-loaded legs
  • Durable all-metal construction
  • Fixed BR2 base for a stable shooting platform
  • Rubberised non-slip feet
  • Foldable legs for compact transport
  • Sling swivel stud mounting system, with Picatinny adaptor mount included.
  • Suitable for Gel Blaster sniper and DMR builds.

6–9 Inch Harris BR2 Metal Bipod Technical Specifications

  • Height Range: 6–9 inches (approx. 15–23cm)
  • Material: Aluminium Alloy Metal construction
  • Leg Type: Spring-loaded quick deploy
  • Mount Type: Sling swivel stud attachment or Picatinny adaptor mounting
  • Base Type: BR2 fixed base
  • Leg Finish: Black
  • Feet Type: Rubberised anti-slip
Compatible with:
  • Gel blasters fitted with sling swivel stud mounts
  • Airsoft rifles using traditional stud mounting
  • Rimfire-style platforms with standard stud configuration
Not compatible with:
  • Rifles that do not have the Sling swivel stud mounting system, or the ability to use or fit Picatinny rails to the bottom of the handguard, so that the Picatinny Mount Adaptor can be used.
  • Gel Blaster Pistols
  • Gel Blaster Shotguns

The 6–9 Inch Harris BR2 Metal Bipod is a spring-loaded adjustable rifle bipod designed for prone and bench shooting. It features a fixed BR2 base, sling swivel stud mounting, and height adjustment between 6 and 9 inches. It is commonly used on gel blasters and airsoft rifles requiring stable front-end support.

This model is best suited for low-profile precision shooting builds and DMR-style setups.

products.name: MINI Mauser C96 Replica Manual Soft Dart Toy Pistol
products.short_description:
MINI Mauser C96 Replica Manual Soft Dart Toy Pistol

Type: Spring Powered Manual “MINI” version of the Mauser C96
Material: Metal and Polymer body, with “Wood Effect” Plastic pistol grips and plastic accessories
Uses: Spring Loaded Imitation bullets shells, with soft foam darts.
Scale: Approximately 1 : 0.5
products.description:
MINI Mauser C96 Replica Manual Soft Dart Toy Pistol

The original, real steel, Mauser C96 was a semi-automatic pistol that was originally produced by German arms manufacturer Mauser from 1896 to 1937. Unlicensed copies of the gun were also manufactured in Spain and China in the first half of the 20th century

Discover the unique features that set the C96 apart from the rest. Famous for the integral box magazine situated in front of the trigger, the extended barrel for enhanced precision, and the versatile wooden pistol grips that not only provides stability akin to a short-barrelled rifle but also transforms into a convenient holster or carrying case. The distinctive grip, resembling the handle of a broom, earned this firearm the endearing moniker “broom handle” in the English-speaking world. In China, it garnered the nickname “box cannon” due to its rectangular  magazine and the ability to be holstered within the magazine in place, reminiscent of a wooden box. Experience innovation and craftsmanship like never before with the C96.

Our Mini Mauser C96 is a faithful replica of the original, but at around a 50% scale size. The magazine loads easily with the red tipped foam darts. To shoot the Mini Mauser, simply rack the slide, to chamber the first dart and compress the firing spring, and pull the trigger. To fire the next dart, simply re-rack the slide and repeat. Slide needs to be racked back for each shot.

 Features:

  • Metal and Polymer Construction
  • Mauser Style Box Magazine
  • Single shot
  • Instruction details Printed on the under-side of the box
IN THE BOX
  • 1 x Mini Mauser c96 Replica.
  • 1 x Mauser Box Magazine (Mini)
  • 20 x Foam Darts
  • English instructions. (Technically, not in the box. They’re printed on the bottom of the box LOL)

Special Note: This item cannot shoot Gel Balls, nor can it be modified to do so.

Please note, this is a Mini Foam Dart firing  Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

products.description:
RX Desert Eagle V2 Electric Gel Blaster

One of the most popular pistols out on the market has now had an upgrade to nylon casing.  The Desert Eagle has been featured in more than 600 films, television shows and video games, making it well known in popular culture. The commercial success of the pistol is due in part to its use in films. According to a 1994 newspaper article, the company actively solicited prop houses to use the gun. By 2000, it had been used in over 40 films, including The Matrix, Eraser, Red Heat, Last Action Hero, Cliffhanger, Demolition Man, Assassins, The Last Boy Scout, Double Impact, and Austin Powers.   So if you are looking to get into the gel blaster hobby then this is a great entry level blaster with a high quality nylon shell,  metal grips, simulated blowback and a great rate of fire, topped with one of the best shooting electric pistol on the market.  We highly recommend the RX Desert Eagle and hope you’ll enjoy it.

RX Desert Eagle V2 Electric Gel Blaster Features:

  • Full Nylon shell
  • Black nylon trigger
  • Magazine feed
  • Full Auto
  • Picatinny rails so you can add extra accessories
  • Removable mag
  • Metal grips

RX Desert Eagle V2 Electric Gel Blaster Included:

  • 1 x Desert Eagle Mag Fed Nylon
  • 1 x Packet of Extra Gel Balls. (5000) [Though we recommend using the X-Force Tactical Pink Gels as a better option]
  • 1 x Rechargeable Battery.
  • 1 x USB Charging Cable.
  • 1 x Pair Safety Glasses
  • 1 x Instruction Manual
Performance:
  • Approximately 150 FPS
Firing Range:
  • 20+ Meters/ 65+ feet

Please note: We highly recommend purchasing our high quality Hardened Gel Balls for the best performance

A really  cool add-on, would be a pistol speed loader, takes all the fiddly-ness out of getting the gels into the end of each of the shells.

Pistol Speed Loader, ad definite timer saver

Gels must be soaked in clean, cold water for approximately 3 to 4 hours, so they swell to the correct size of about 7.4mm. Do not use them straight out of the packet, without soaking them to swell to the working size.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

products.description:
Black Label Ultra Hard Gel Ball by X-Force

Black Label Ultra Hard Gel Ball for Gel Blasters – High-Impact, Ultra Durable Ammo

Upgrade your gel blaster experience with the Black Label Ultra Hard Gel Balls. Designed for maximum impact and durability, these high-quality gel balls are perfect for extended gameplay and intense firepower. Crafted with precision to ensure reliable performance, smooth loading, and consistent accuracy. Ideal for outdoor battles, tactical games, and gel blaster enthusiasts.

Black Label Ultra Hard Gel Ball Features:

  • Ultra-hard, high-impact gel balls for increased durability
  • Perfect size for gel blasters for seamless loading
  • Designed for consistent accuracy and performance
  • Safe, eco-friendly, and non-toxic material
  • Suitable for outdoor tactical gaming and competitions

Why Choose Black Label Ultra Hard Gel Balls?

Experience superior strength and reliability with gel balls built to withstand intense impacts. Elevate your gel blaster battles with high-impact ammunition that ensures a fun, safe, and engaging experience. Perfect for enthusiasts who demand quality and performance.

Order now and dominate your gel blaster battles with Black Label Ultra Hard Gel Balls!

How to Use our Black  Label Ultra Hard Gel Balls – Instructions:

1: Hydrate the Gel Balls
  • Place the dry gel balls in a container filled with clean water.
  • Soak them for at least 4 hours to allow full expansion.
  • For best performance, hydrate only what you’ll use within a few days.
2: Drain and Store
  • Once fully grown (7–8mm), drain the excess water.
  • Store the hydrated gel balls in an airtight container.
  • Do not let them dry out—dehydrated balls can shrink and jam your blaster.
3: Load the Blaster
  • Gently load the hydrated gel balls into the hopper or magazine of your gel blaster.
  • Avoid overloading or forcing them in, as this may damage the blaster.
4: Fire Safely
  • Always wear eye protection when using your gel blaster.
  • Use the blaster in safe environments like designated gel ball fields or backyard.
  • Do not aim at eyes, face, or animals.
5: Clean and Maintain
  • After use, empty any unused gel balls from the blaster.
  • Clean the blaster as per the manufacturer’s instructions to prevent residue build-up or jams.
  • Never use dried, damaged, or improperly hydrated balls—they can harm your blaster.

Note: Ultra-hard gel balls are designed for higher-performance blasters. Ensure your blaster is compatible with them before use.

products.description:
White Ghosts Ammo – 7-8 mm Milky White Harden Gel balls

White ghosts ammo are a classic milky-white gel ball desined for the players looking for reliable, consistent ammunition with excellent visibility during gameplay.

These 7-8 mm harden gel balls hydrade into a smooth, round milky-white projectile that feeds reliably through compatible gel blasters.  Their distinctive white appearance makes them easy to see in flight and gives them the unmistakable White Ghost look on the field.

Whether you’re heading to a weekend skirmish, setting up a backyard target session, or simply stocking up on ammunition, White Ghosts are an excellent all-round choice.

Why Choose White Ghosts?

  • 7-8 mm hydrated size for compatibility with most standard gel blasters.
  • Milky White appearance for excellent visibility during play
  • Hardened gel construction for improved durabitily over softer standard gels
  • Consistent round shape for reliable feeding
  • Suitable for compatible AEG and spring powered gel blasters.
  • Excellent choice for CQB, outdoor skirmishes and target shooting.
  • Convinient pre-packed ammunition.
  • Aproximately 10,000 gel balls in a pack
  • Non toxic and biodegradable gel material when used as intended.

Preparation

Simply place the required quntity of gel balls into clean water and allow them to fully hydrate.  We prefer using milk or cordial bottoles for easy storage and transportation.  Growth time can vary depending on the water temperature and conditions, so check the gels regularly and allow them to reach their recommended 7-8 mm finished size before use, in general around 4-5 hours.

For best performance, use clean water and avoid over-growing the gels.  Properly hydrated ammunition will generally provide better feeding and more consistent performance.

 

Built for Gel Ball Action

White Ghosts offer a great balance between durability and playability. The hardened construction makes them a popular option for players who want something tougher than basic gels without necessarily moving into the hardest gel grades.

Their milky-white colour also makes them particularly distinctive on the fields.  Once fired, the white gels are easy to track visually, making them a great option for players who like to see their shots.

Please check your gel blaster manufacturers recommended gels size and hardness before use.  Different blasters have different barrel, magazine and feeding requirements.

 

White Ghosts – See them fly, feel the difference.

 

Keep out of reach from children.

Can be a choking hazard.

The CowCow B01 Dynamic Blowback Housing – CCT-TMHC-022 is an ultra-lightweight 18 g CNC-machined 7075 aluminium housing for TM-spec Hi-Capa and 1911 gas blowback platforms. Its lightweight design, specialised piston head and interchangeable O-rings help support smooth cycling, stable nozzle movement and an effective gas seal.

Type: B01 Dynamic Blowback Housing – TM Hi-Capa
Platform: TM Spec Hi-Capa Gel Blaster Pistols
Material: CNC machined Aluminium 7075
Colour: Black
products.description:
CowCow Black B01 Dynamic Blowback Housing – TM Hi-Capa

Upgrade your compatible TM-spec Hi-Capa Gel Blaster with the CowCow B01 Dynamic Blowback Housing. CowCow precision CNC machines the housing from 7075 aluminium, combining excellent durability with an ultra-light 18-gram design.

Reducing reciprocating mass can help improve blowback cycling response. Meanwhile, CowCow’s specialised piston-head design helps keep the sealing O-ring correctly positioned, reducing unwanted air leakage and nozzle movement during cycling.

CowCow supplies three different black O-ring sizes to improve compatibility with commonly used nozzles:

  • 9.5 mm × 2 mm
  • 9 mm × 1.9 mm
  • 9 mm × 2 mm

The housing’s rigid 7075 aluminium construction also helps resist flexing and warping during demanding use, while its lightweight design supports stable and smooth blowback operation.

products.name: Action Army AAP-01 Assassin GBB Gel Blaster – Black
products.short_description:
• Brand: Action Army
  • Model: AAP-01 (AAP01)
  • Material: Plastic/ABS/Aluminium Alloy/Steel
  • Uses: 7 – 8 mm/0.2g gel ammo
  • Source: Green Gas
  • Capacity rounds: 14
  • Power FPS: up to 300
  • Velocity: 90 m/s
  • Hop Up: N/A
  • Overall length: 230 mm
products.description:
Although the AAP-01 Assassin is Action Army’s own design, its rather unique looks are based largely on the Ruger Mark IV, a 22 caliber target pistol known for its vintage shape and competition-level accuracy.   Unlike the Mark IV, however, Action army has cut various grooves and channels into the AAP-01’s frame and outer barrel, making it a little easier to grip when racking and gives it a little bit more of an angular look.   The gun itself is a little shorter and, being made of polymer rather than metal, is considerably more lightweight  but good use of metal internally in the bolt, barrel and magazine giving it decent weight but not making it too heavy.

German StG44 WWII MP44 Full Metal Sturmgewehr Gel Blaster

The StG 44 (abbreviation of Sturmgewehr 44, “assault rifle 44”) is a German assault rifle developed during World War II by Hugo Schmeisser. It is also known by its early designations as the MP 43 and MP 44 (Maschinenpistole 43 and 44). The StG 44 was an improvement of an earlier design, the Maschinenkarabiner 42(H).

The StG 44 was the first successful assault rifle, with features including an intermediate cartridge, controllable automatic fire, a more compact design than a battle rifle with a higher rate of fire, and being designed primarily for hitting targets within a few hundred meters, rifles at the time were designed to hit targets of over a thousand meters, but this was found to be in excess of the range in which most enemy engagements actually took place.

The StG 44 fulfilled its role effectively, particularly on the Eastern Front, offering a greatly increased volume of fire compared to standard infantry rifles. The StG largely influenced the Soviet AK-47, introduced three years after the war concluded. The StG’s influence can still be seen in modern assault rifles, which, after World War II, became the global standard for infantry rifles.

products.name: Mosfet by Jefftron – V2 with wiring
products.short_description:
Description

Professionally made mosfet designed for Gel blaster electric.
Device increases gun rate of fire and battery holds longer, than with basic wiring.
It is fully integrated inside the gearbox version 2 instead of the original trigger contacts, compatible with Tokyo Marui standard.
products.description:
SPECIFICATIONS:
– Mosfet build on trigger contacts from SHS company
– Easy installation inside the gearbox version 2
– Presoldered wires allows faster and easier installation into the gun, it is long enough for all kind of weapons. Simply cut wires to the required length and attach connectors (included in package)
– On the devices are presoldered high quality 2 black wires 1,5 qmm (AWG16) with with thin and hard MPPE insulation, length 300 mm to the motor and 700 mm to the battery. The blue wire 0.34 qmm (AWG24) with a length 1000 mm is used for connection anywhere on the red cable
– In package is included 1000 mm red wire 1,5qmm (AWG16) with with thin and hard MPPE insulation
– Wiring is designed to lead into the stock, but it can go to the front under condition to turn around black battery wire on the board (resolder it)
– Board covered by conformal coating, it protect device against water
– If you want to use your own wires, choose device without wiring
– Designed for spring up to M160 (equivalent for current 75A single shot fire or 25A burst fire for max. 30s). For higher load please use Mosfet II (it is outside gearbox)
– Specified for common batteries up to 17V (Ni-xx 8.4 – 12V, lipol 7.4 – 14.8V)
– No current consumption in the idle mode
– No sparking on switch contacts
– In auto fire mode piston stops in random position due the mechabox design
– For right function is necessary to have a functional gearbox cut off lever, selector plate, reverse latch, trigger and trigger block, as it has the standard gearbox

DEVICE INSTRUCTIONS: you can download installation manual in English here [PDF, 761.42 kB]
PACKING:
– mosfet on trigger contacts with wiring
– trigger switch
– screw, pad (for screw to keep device in the position)
– DeanT connector male
– 30A mini fuse
– 4x faston female 2,8mm
– 6x black heat shrink tube 3,2mm – length 20mm
– 3x black heat shrink tube 4,8mm – length 20mm
– installation manual in English

WARNING: Installation of this device leave to expert, who could solder and disassemble airsoft gun. Never user soldering gun!
We can’t guarantee 100% compatibility with all gearboxes, but Mosfet – V2 will fit into standard and common brand’s gearboxes without larger modifications.

The M1911 from WE is a full-metal, semi-auto replica of one of the most iconic pistols in the world. the aggressive HEX patterned lightening cuts and serrations give the Hex Cut a unique and intimidating look
Outside, construction was made entirely from metal – on the hex even the grip panels are metal. Moving slide and strong gas blowback system gives the user a very realistic experience.

The M1911, also known as the Colt 1911, or the Colt Government, is a single-action, semi-automatic, magazine-fed, recoil-operated pistol chambered for the .45 ACP cartridge. It served as the standard-issue sidearm for the United States Armed Forces from 1911 to 1985. It was widely used in World War I, World War II, the Korean War, and the Vietnam War.

Designed by John Browning, the M1911 is the best-known of his designs to use the short recoil principle in its basic design. The pistol was widely copied, and this operating system rose to become the preeminent type of the 20th century and of nearly all modern centrefire pistols.

Make sure you own one for your collection or on the field.

The Winchester Model 1894 rifle (also known as the Winchester 94 or Model 94) is a lever-action repeating rifle that became one of the most famous and popular hunting rifles of all time. It was designed by John Browning in 1894.

The 1894 was produced by the Winchester Repeating Arms Company through 1980 and then by U.S. Repeating Arms under the Winchester brand until they ceased manufacturing rifles in 2006. Reproductions are being made by the Miroku company of Japan and imported into the United States by the Browning Arms company of Morgan, Utah.

The Model 1894 has been referred to as the “ultimate lever-action design” by firearms historians such as R. L. Wilson and Hal Herring. The Model 1894 is the rifle credited with the name “Winchester” being used to refer to all rifles of this type and was the first commercial sporting rifle to sell over 7,000,000 units.

The M1911, also known as the Colt 1911, or the Colt Government, is a single-action, semi-automatic, magazine-fed, recoil-operated pistol chambered for the .45 ACP cartridge. It served as the standard-issue sidearm for the United States Armed Forces from 1911 to 1985. It was widely used in World War I, World War II, the Korean War, and the Vietnam War.

Designed by John Browning, the M1911 is the best-known of his designs to use the short recoil principle in its basic design. The pistol was widely copied, and this operating system rose to become the preeminent type of the 20th century and of nearly all modern centrefire pistols.

products.name: KELe Beretta 93R Manual Springer Gel Blaster Pistol – Black
products.short_description:
KELe Beretta 93R Manual Springer Gel Blaster Pistol – Black

Type: Manual (Spring Powered) Gel blaster pistol

Material: Metal body /polymer grip faces.

Colour: Black with brown grips
products.description:
KELe Beretta 93R Manual Springer Gel Blaster Pistol – Black

In the real world, The Beretta 93R is an Italian selective-fire machine pistol, designed and manufactured by Beretta in the late 1970s for police and military use, that is derived from their semi-automatic Beretta 92. The “R” stands for Raffica, which is Italian for “volley”, “flurry”, or “burst” (sometimes spoken “R” as “Rapid” in English).

The Beretta 93R was designed to be used by the Italian counter-terrorism forces of the National Police and Carabineri (both formed in the late 1970s in response to terrorism) but was also adopted by other police and military forces who required a concealable weapon with rapid fire capabilities. The pistol is a development of the Beretta 92 design. The 93R has also been seen a lot in popular culture, in films like Virtuosity (Denzel Washington 1995), Broken Arrow (John Travolta 1996) and was the basis for Robocop’s Auto 9 gun in the film Robocop (1987)

The KELe Beretta 93R Manual Springer Gel Blaster Pistol is an incredibly authentic looking replica of the Beretta 93R, the obvious differences being that it is a single shot, spring powered Gel Blaster, and doesn’t have semi auto of full auto functions. In the hand the The KELe Beretta 93R Manual Springer Gel Blaster Pistol feels suitably weighty, making it a very realistic replica of the original. The firing selection is single shot, per rack of the slide. The Blaster can also be “stripped down” just like it’s rear world counterpart, with the slide being removable from the lower. The fold down fore grip is sturdy and well constructed. Though this blaster does come with 10 mini foam nerf darts, it operated best using Gel balls.

KELe Beretta 93R Manual Springer Gel Blaster Pistol Features:

  • Model: KELe Beretta 93R Manual Springer Gel Blaster Pistol
  • Type: Manual, Mechanical, Spring-Powered (Single shot, rack the slide for each re-load)
  • Single-Shot Pull-Back Type
  • 1:1 Ratio
  • Full Metal Construction
  • Screw in Flash Hider (Muzzle Break)
  • Mag Fed
  • Magazine Capacity: Approx. 15 Gel Balls (Even though this looks like an extended magazine, due to the position of the Gel feeding hole, it only hold the same number of gels as a standard magazine would)
  • Uses 7-8mm Gel Balls (sold Separately)
  • Comes with 10 Foam mini Nerf darts

KELe Beretta 93R Manual Springer Gel Blaster Pistol – Black Performance:

  • Up to 140 Feet per Second
  • Up to 20m Firing Distance
  • 1 Shot per Pull Back of Slide

Remember, one mag is never enough. Why not add an extra mag, or two, to your order and make the most of the free freight.

Click the image to add the right spare mag, for your KELe Beretta 93R

What’s the thing everyone loses? Yep, the little foam darts. Why not add an extra 10 pack, or two, of foam darts while you’re here.

Get some Spare Darts, ya know you’ll lose some 🙂

Please note: We highly recommend purchasing our high quality Hardened Gel Balls for the best performance, like our Tenacity AKA’s

Grab some Gels, while you’re here. You don’t have to pick these up, like you do the darts.

A really  cool add-on, would be a pistol speed loader, takes all the fiddly-ness out of getting the gels into the Magazine.

Pistol Speed Loader, a definite timer saver. Click image to add to order.

Only load Gel Balls into the magazine, DO NOT try to load mini darts into the Magazine, this will damage the gun and magazine. Mini darts should be pushed into the barrel only, in from the front of the pistol muzzle.

Manual pistols may not always feed gels consistently from the magazine into the barrel. You might experience issues such as double feeds (two gels at once), empty feeds (no gels), and normal feeds (one gel). These problems are quite common with manual pistols and are not defects; they are simply part of owning, manual spring fed Gel Blasters.

Always read the instruction on the gel packaging, and soak the gels in clean cold water for the specified time. Do not attempt to use Gels, that have not been soaked and have grown to their operational diameter.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

products.description:
The MP7 is a new Gas Blowback .  It has a selector switch which allows safe, semi automatic, or fully automatic fire.   Load up the magazine, insert it into the rifle, pull the charging handle and you’re ready to rock.  Every time you pull the trigger, the gun will fire and cycle the bolt, accurately replicating the real firearm.  On the last round, the bolt will lock back, letting you know it’s time to insert another magazine.

Externally the MP7 is packed full of features.  It has a telescoping stock which can fully collapse to allow the gun to be used like a pistol.  There is a single picatinny rail on top of the gun that runs the entire length.  Mounted on the rail are detachable iron sights that can be used as a low profile sight when folded down, or flipped up for a higher sight that is designed to pair with a red dot sight.  There are also 4 sling mount points allowing for single point or 2 point slings for left or right handed shooters.

As with all gas blowback guns, they do need regular cleaning and basic maintenance to keep them in top notch firing condition.  It’s essential that you clean your barrel and clean and lubricate the critical components as described in your owners manual.  We recommend using Slip 2000 Airsoft Lubricant to maintain your rifle.  When you are done using the gun for the day, make sure your magazine has a slight amount of gas inside the magazine – this will keep just enough pressure to keep the seals snug.  Always follow the manufacturer’s recommendation for storing your rifle in a cool dry place that is out of direct sunlight.

products.short_description:

tested and approved by a number of Australian gel blaster modders

wire slots have been designed to accept up to ø3 mm wire

products.description:
M stands for Modular.
Machined from Aircraft grade Aluminium and boasting all the same features as the standard MKTH v2 gearbox shell, “M” introduces more to love…

Modular design separates compression from the gearing section allowing for easy maintenance whilst retaining full rigidity of standard box.

It also makes shimming much easier.

Advantages over split design:

  1. Modular is the only gearbox design to allow for AOE tune under full compression.
  2. Because the lower half of the gearbox remains solid, it maintains much better rigidity and is, therefore, more suitable to high stress and DSG builds.
  3. Additionally, it introduces 0 new tolerances over standard design and there is no need for the receiver pin to hold compression and gearing sections together, no wiggle, no changes to AOE.

For blaster and receiver compatibility check the standard V2 gearbox page

CNC machined v2 gearbox shells designed and manufactured specifically for gel blasters.

This gearbox is designed and manufactured in QLD, Australia from locally sourced materials. It is CNC machined from a single block of Aircraft grade Aluminium. Characterized by high corrosion resistance, light weight and high strength of 310 MPa (45 ksi).

CNC machining process produces highly accurate parts with tolerances of 0.001 mm so this gearbox shell is not to be confused with cheap cast metal conversions that simply cannot match the strength or tolerances achieved through CNC machining.

Additionally, this gearbox shell was designed specifically for gel blasters to be used as a replacement of stock gearbox casings that are often the most unreliable part on stock blasters.
We shouldn’t need to emphasize this but unlike some AS V2 gearbox adaptations our box is a true gel blaster gearbox and it, therefore, has the nozzle stroke required for gel ball feed and seal.

V2 Receivers compatibility:

SLR
X-Power (BD556, Maopul)
TTM
War interest (LDT)
Hawkex MK1
Blaster compatibility:

Wells M401 (minimum modification)
JM Gen9 (some modification)
JM ACR J10 (some modification)

mag adapter plate

Here at X-Force we love bringing you gel blasters that are our of the ordinary. It’s finally here with it’s woodgrain stock and handles and big round mag, the Chicago Typewriter. With that said the Thompson submachine gun was one of the most iconic gun of all time.   Make sure you grab one today and fulfil that nostalgic void in your heart.

The Thompson submachine gun is an American submachine gun first invented by John T. Thompson in 1918 during World War I and became infamous during the Prohibition era, being a signature weapon of various organized crime syndicates in the United States. It was a common sight in the media of the time, being used by both law enforcement officers and criminals.  The Thompson submachine gun was also known informally as the “Tommy Gun”, “Street Sweeper”, “Annihilator”, “Chicago Typewriter”, “Trench Broom”, “Chicago Submachine”, “Chicago Piano”, “Chicago Style”, “Chicago Organ Grinder”, “Drum Gun”, “the Chopper”, “the Tommy Boy” or simply “the Thompson”.

The Thompson was favoured by soldiers, criminals, police, the FBI, and civilians alike for its fully automatic fire, while still being relatively lightweight, portable and easy to use. It has since gained popularity among civilian collectors for its historical significance. It has considerable significance in popular culture, especially in works about the Prohibition era and World War II, and is one of the most well known and recognized firearms in history. The original fully automatic Thompsons are no longer produced, but numerous semi-automatic civilian versions are still being manufactured by Auto-Ordnance. These retain a similar appearance to the original models, but they have various modifications in order to comply with modern firearm laws.

This Thompson gel blaster is truly a first for the gel blaster industry.  It comes with:

  • Drum mag
  • proprietary Thompson gearbox

Colours available may vary please note only light wood available.

Construction is of nylon with some metal parts(metal drum mag and switches).

Please note: This product contains timber (wood) as part of it’s design. Timber, being a natural product, does not always provide a 100% smooth and consistent finish and may have irregularities dues to grain direction, knot imperfections and general “softness” of timber, which makes it prone to marking easily. Also, in our harsh Australian climate, products containing timber should be stored out of direct sunlight, away from extremes in temperature fluctuations and protected from excessive exposure to humidity.

Care should be taken to keep timber in it’s best condition, timber needs to be maintained and “fed” using suitable timber oils, without any colourant of pigment, we suggest using Abbey Gun Solutions – Stock Finish. Click image below to add to your order.

Looking at this Manual Springer replica, against the real steel counterpart and it is hard to spot any differences. This is a must for collectors, who are looking for authenticity in their replicas. And, as a couple of our competitive staff members often say, the look of amazement on the face of a player at a Gel Soft skirmish, who has spent thousands on an HPA super gun set up, that shoot 25+ gels per second, at over 300 fps, then you creep up on them and take them out with a single shot from a springer, is priceless. products.description:
KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II Manual Springer Gel Blaster – Silver

We’re proud to introduce this awesome replica, of the Kimber Ultra Carry II.

This full metal and beautifully weighted replica feels great in the hand. Its weight gives it the sense of being something more than just a simple toy, but more of an authentic replica of the real Kimber Ultra Carry II. KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II is constructed with a full metal, aluminium alloy, body with imitation wood (Nylon) grips. Some of the really cool attention-to-detail touches on this blaster, are the etched “Kimber” logo on the handle, plus the Kimber Model Number, engraved just above the trigger. Looking at this Manual Springer replica, against the real steel counterpart and it is hard to spot any differences. This is a must for collectors, who are looking for authenticity in their replicas. The only slight deviation from the real deal, is the inclusion of the word “stainless” on the black version, whereas this only appears on the silver version in real life. Other feature that definitely make this such a great replica, is the functioning beaver tail (grip) safety, and a thumb safety that prevents the slide from being racked.

The KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II is a manual “springer” style blaster, which means the slide needs to be racked for each shot and make the firing configuration technically a single-shot manual device. And, as a couple of our competitive staff members often say, the look of amazement on the face of a player at a Gel Soft skirmish, who has spent thousands on an HPA super gun setup, that shoots 25+ gels per second, at over 300 fps, then you creep up on them and take them out with a single shot from a springer, is priceless. Well, there’s no feeling quite like that!!!

KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II Manual Springer Gel Blaster – Silver Features:

  • Model: KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II Manual Springer Gel Blaster
  • Type: Manual, Mechanical, Spring-Powered (Single shot, rack the slide for each re-load)
  • Single-Shot Pull-Back Type.
  • 1:1 Ratio
  • Full Metal (aluminium Alloy) with Imitation wood grips.
  • Built-in Hop-up
  • Spring fed, single stack, Magazine.
  • Magazine Capacity: Approx. 9 to 10 Gel Balls (dependant on Gel brand and variance in grown size)
  • Uses 7-8mm Gel Balls (sold Separately).

KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II Manual Springer Gel Blaster – Silver Performance:

  • Up to 140 Feet per Second (Dependant on Gels)
  • Up to 15m Firing Distance
  • 1 Shot per Pull Back of the Slide, then to load the next gel the slide needs to be racked again.

Remember, one mag is never enough. Why not add a spare mag, or two, to your order and get your cart total over the free freight threshold.

Click the image, to add the correct mag for your KELe Kimber Ultra Carry II to your order.

Please note:  We highly recommend purchasing our high-quality Hardened Gel Balls for the best performance, like our Tenacity AKA’s

Grab some Gels, while you’re here. You don’t have to pick these up, like you do the darts.

A really  cool add-on, would be a pistol speed loader, that takes all the fiddly-ness out of getting the gels into the Magazine.

Pistol Speed Loader, is a definite timer saver. Click the image to add to the order.

Only load Gel Balls into the magazine, DO NOT try to load mini darts into the Magazine, this will damage the gun and magazine. Mini darts should be pushed into the barrel only, in from the front of the pistol muzzle.

Manual pistols may not always feed gels consistently from the magazine into the barrel. You might experience issues such as double feeds (two gels at once), empty feeds (no gels), and normal feeds (one gel). These problems are quite common with manual pistols and are not defects; they are simply part of owning, manual spring fed Gel Blasters.

Always read the instruction on the gel packaging, and soak the gels in clean cold water for the specified time. Do not attempt to use Gels, that have not been soaked and have grown to their operational diameter.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

Always “Stop and Think” when using your blaster, and carry it in a suitable bag or case between home, the car and to the Gel Ball Battle fields. Never point, or shoot your Blaster at animals, or people without their permission. Always use suitable eye protection, when using your Gel Blaster.

products.name: Abbey Gun Grease LT2
products.short_description:
Type: Gun grease for your gel blasters

Metal to Metal Grease for your blasters
products.description:
Gun Grease LT2 is a molybdenum based heavy grease designed for heavy-load applications, between metal parts.

Gun Grease LT2 is designed for use in high-pressure applications such as; inside an AEG Gearbox between gears and pistons; inside the bolt carriage of a GBBR; or on the metal slide of a Gas Blow Back Pistol. The grease stays in the friction area and reduces friction, rather than being squeezed out.

Our grease comes in 50ml pots, perfect for toolboxes and gun bags.

Molybdenum Based

Molybdenum fills in microscopic surface pores in metal, such as in gears, piston sliders or gas blow back bolts and leaves a smooth surface, reducing friction and increasing efficiency.

High-Temperature Stability

Our LT2 grease is stable under heat, meaning regardless of how hot your gearbox gets, it’s not going to seize up and it’s going to continue to provide a high level of lubrication and protection.

Anti-Corrosion

The anti-corrosion additives in our grease ensure that there’s no chance of rust or pitting damaging the internals of your airsoft gun and causing a failure over time.

Check out the videos from the boyz at Abbeys which some great tips and how to use the gas.

Jianfeng G18 Manual Hopper Fed Gel Blaster Pistol Included in each Box:

  • 1 x Jianfeng Manual Hopper Fed G18 Gel Ball Pistol
  • Factory 7.0-8.0 mm Dehydrated gels

Operation of this blaster

  • The manual Hopper Fed Jianfeng G18 needs to be operated in a specific way.
  • Always use 7-8 mm gels that have been well hydrated for at least 6 hours, fresh out of water and not too dry.
  • Different brands of gels will vary performance of this product.
  • Load the fully hydrated gels into the top hopper and close the hopper door.
  • When you load each gel to be fired, point the gel blaster slightly upwards and then load the blaster with a quick action and then release.
  • When you first load the blaster, it may take a few times to fire the blaster before gels are fired out of the blaster.
  • The blaster will not fire a gel for every shot (pull of the trigger), this is common and normal for this blaster.
  • At times, the Gel Blaster may fire two gels during one shot, again this is common and normal for this blaster.
  • Before purchasing, please ensure you understand the above points and understand that this blaster is a budget, manual item and not perfect.
  • It may not fire a gel every time you pull the trigger, and gel firing distance and accuracy will vary with every shot.
  • Two gels may be fired with one shot. This is how most manual gel blasters function and is normal for them and this type of product.

BATTERY?

This Product is a manual spring-powered item and so requires no batteries.

Please note, this is a Gel Blaster Toy and not a Real firearm

products.description:
HANKE M97 PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN GEL BLASTER

The HANKE M97 Pump Action Shotgun Gel Blaster delivers classic shotgun styling combined with simple, reliable gel-blaster performance. Inspired by traditional pump-action shotgun designs, the M97 offers a rugged look, realistic pump operation, and straightforward spring-powered mechanics, making it an excellent choice for casual skirmishes, backyard target shooting, or entry-level gel blaster enthusiasts.

Designed for ease of use and durability, the HANKE M97 requires no batteries or gas to operate. Each shot is manually chambered using the pump-action fore-end, providing a satisfying and immersive shooting experience. Its lightweight polymer construction keeps handling comfortable, while the long barrel and fixed stock contribute to stable aiming and consistent performance.

Perfect for players who value simplicity, reliability, and authentic styling, the HANKE M97 Pump Action Shotgun Gel Blaster is a solid addition to any gel blaster collection—especially for those wanting a no-fuss, mechanically driven blaster that performs straight out of the box.

  • Scale: 1:1 ratio
  • Construction: High-quality nylon build
  • Clean, solid design
  • No battery or gas required

  • Hopper fed (internal hopper design)

  • Dust cover slides open with every pull back

The HANKE M97 is ideal for players who want a simple, dependable gel blaster without the complexity of batteries, wiring, or gas systems. Its pump-action design provides hands-on engagement, making every shot deliberate and satisfying. This makes it especially popular for beginners, younger players under supervision, or anyone looking for a classic mechanical gel blaster experience.

products.short_description:
Product information and specifications;

tested and approved by a number of Australian gel blaster modders
cylinder and piston housing is reinforced with additional material
compatibility with both Wells and standard v2 cylinder, cylinder head and nozzle
wire slots have been designed to accept up to ø3 mm wire
additional wire guide to “tuck” the wire under the motor head
8 mm bearings/bushings sockets are intentionally tighter to prevent slipping
quick spring exchange
all threads are form tapped which creates a much stronger thread
fully integrated non-conductive mag connector plate
Aussie made and covered by Australian Warranty!
products.description:
CNC machined v2 gearbox shell designed and manufactured specifically for gel blasters.

This gearbox is designed and manufactured in QLD, Australia from locally sourced materials. It is CNC machined from a single block of Aircraft grade Aluminium. Characterized by high corrosion resistance, light weight and high strength of 310 MPa (45 ksi).

CNC machining process produces highly accurate parts with tolerances of 0.001 mm so this gearbox shell is not to be confused with cheap cast metal conversions that simply cannot match the strength or tolerances achieved through CNC machining.

Additionally, this gearbox shell was designed specifically for gel blasters to be used as a replacement of stock gearbox casings that are often the most unreliable part on stock blasters.
We shouldn’t need to emphasize this but unlike some AS V2 gearbox adaptations our box is a true gel blaster gearbox and it, therefore, has the nozzle stroke required for gel ball feed and seal.

V2 Receivers compatibility:

SLR
X-Power (BD556, Maopul)
TTM
War interest (LDT)
Hawkex MK1
Blaster compatibility:

Wells M401 (minimum modification)
JM Gen9 (some modification)
JM ACR J10 (some modification)
What’s included with the shell/case?

mag adapter plate
M 3 screws
